File: These stone-faced guards must have been trained not to converse with anybody.  They ignore you, Sir Graham.
檔案: 這些面無表情的衛兵，想必受過訓練不與任何人交談。他們對你視若無睹，格拉漢爵士。

File: The guards are well provided-for by King Edward.  They are not interested in any of your belongings.
檔案: 愛德華國王待衛兵不薄，他們對你的任何物品都沒興趣。

File: These are the guards of your king, King Edward.  It would be very unwise to make enemies of them, Sir Graham.
檔案: 這些是你的國王——愛德華國王的衛兵。格拉漢爵士，與他們結怨可不是明智之舉。

File: These stone-faced guards must have been trained not to show any type of affection.  They ignore you, Sir Graham.
檔案: 這些面無表情的衛兵，想必受過訓練不表露任何情感。他們對你視若無睹，格拉漢爵士。

File: These guards protect the King's castle.
檔案: 這些衛兵負責守護國王的城堡。

File: Just walk up to the portcullis and open it.
檔案: 只要走到閘門前把它打開就行了。

File: This portcullis is the only entrance to the King's castle.
檔案: 這道閘門是通往國王城堡的唯一入口。

File: These beautiful urns adorn the front of the castle.
檔案: 這些精美的甕裝飾著城堡的正面。

File: You never know what sort of fierce creatures lie just beneath the surface of the moat.
檔案: 你永遠不知道護城河水面下潛伏著什麼兇猛的生物。

File: There is a hole where the rock once was.
檔案: 石頭原本所在的地方，現在留下一個洞。

File: You're in a shady forest clearing.  A large rock rests in the middle of the clearing next to a shallow hole where the rock used to sit.
檔案: 你身處一片林蔭下的空地。空地中央有塊大石頭，旁邊有個淺洞，正是這塊石頭原本擺放的地方。

File: You're in a shady forest clearing.  A large rock rests in the middle of the clearing.
檔案: 你身處一片林蔭下的空地，空地中央有塊大石頭。

File: There is a shallow hole where the rock once rested in.
檔案: 石頭原本擺放的地方，現在留下一個淺洞。

File: There is an intricately carved dagger in the hole.
檔案: 洞裡有一把雕工精細的短刀。

File: You see a large rock resting in the middle of the clearing.
檔案: 你看見空地中央擺著一塊大石頭。

File: There's not a lot to see except for the grass beneath your feet and a couple of large rocks.
檔案: 這裡沒什麼好看的，只有腳下的草地和幾塊大石頭。

File: There is nothing in this hole but dirt.
檔案: 這個洞裡除了泥土什麼也沒有。

File: You are too far away from the hole to see into it.
檔案: 你離那個洞太遠，看不清裡面。

File: There is no hole here.
檔案: 這裡沒有洞。

File: There's nothing interesting about the dirt.
檔案: 這些泥土沒什麼特別的。

File: You could see it better if you picked it up.
檔案: 把它撿起來，你會看得更清楚。

File: You do not have a dagger to look at.
檔案: 你身上沒有短刀可以看。

File: You can't read the runes, but it appears to be an elvish dagger of great antiquity.
檔案: 你看不懂上面的符文，但這似乎是一把年代久遠的小精靈短刀。

File: You don't have any carvings to look at.
檔案: 你身上沒有任何雕刻品可以看。

File: You are already standing in the hole.
檔案: 你已經站在洞裡了。

File: You can just walk right over into the hole.  It's very shallow.
檔案: 你可以直接走進那個洞，洞很淺。

File: You don't see a hole.
檔案: 你沒看到洞。

File: You have thrown the dagger and it is lost forever.
檔案: 你已經把短刀扔出去了，永遠找不回來了。

File: You've already accomplished that task.
檔案: 你已經完成過這件事了。

File: You can't pick up the dagger while you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法撿起短刀。

File: You might be able to do that if you weren't ducking!
檔案: 要是你沒蹲著，也許就能做到！

File: You are too far away to get the dagger.
檔案: 你離得太遠，拿不到短刀。

File: There is no dagger here.
檔案: 這裡沒有短刀。

File: The rock is much, much harder than your foot.  You'd injure yourself.
檔案: 這塊石頭比你的腳硬得多，你會弄傷自己的。

File: It is a large rock.  There is a shallow hole in the ground where the rock used to sit.
檔案: 這是一塊大石頭，地上有個淺洞，正是這塊石頭原本擺放的地方。

File: You see a large, grey rock.
檔案: 你看見一塊灰色的大石頭。

File: There's nothing useful or interesting about this rock.
檔案: 這塊石頭沒什麼有用或有趣的地方。

File: This rock is far too heavy for you to carry.
檔案: 這塊石頭太重了，你搬不動。

File: You are much too far away to even attempt getting the rock.
檔案: 你離得太遠了，根本不用嘗試去拿那塊石頭。

File: The rock is far too heavy to be picked up.
檔案: 這塊石頭太重了，撿不起來。

File: It will be very difficult to move the rock from here.
檔案: 從這裡要移動這塊石頭會很困難。

File: After moving that rock once, just the thought of moving it again exhausts you.
檔案: 你已經搬過那塊石頭一次，光是想到要再搬一次就讓你筋疲力盡。

File: It's pretty hard to move the rock while you're invisible.
檔案: 隱形的時候，要搬動石頭相當困難。

File: With a small shove, you manage to push the rock a few feet... revealing a shallow hole underneath.
檔案: 你輕輕一推，把石頭推開了幾步……底下露出一個淺洞。

File: You reach into the hole and grasp the dagger, being careful not to cut yourself.
檔案: 你伸手進洞裡抓住短刀，小心翼翼不讓自己受傷。

File: There are many smooth pebbles next to the lake.
檔案: 湖邊有許多光滑的鵝卵石。

File: You're standing on a pebble strewn patch of sand on the river bank.
檔案: 你站在河岸上一片滿是鵝卵石的沙地上。

File: You see your own boot-clad feet.
檔案: 你看見自己穿著靴子的雙腳。

File: There is a beach of pebbles on its edge.
檔案: 邊上有一片鵝卵石灘。

File: The sandy beach along the side of the lake is strewn with small pebbles.
檔案: 湖邊的沙灘上散落著許多小鵝卵石。

File: The only rocks of interest are some pebbles on the beach.
檔案: 唯一值得注意的石頭，就是沙灘上的那些鵝卵石。

File: From here it looks like an ordinary beach of pebbles.
檔案: 從這裡看，這只是一片普通的鵝卵石灘。

File: The only rocks worth getting are some pebbles on the beach.
檔案: 唯一值得撿的石頭，就是沙灘上的那些鵝卵石。

File: You are not close enough to the pebbles to get them.
檔案: 你離鵝卵石不夠近，撿不到。

File: Your pockets cannot hold any more pebbles.
檔案: 你的口袋裝不下更多鵝卵石了。

File: You can't pick up any of the pebbles while you are invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法撿起任何鵝卵石。

File: You grab a handful of pebbles.
檔案: 你抓了一把鵝卵石。

File: You grab a pebble.
檔案: 你撿起一顆鵝卵石。

File: You grab some pebbles.
檔案: 你撿起幾顆鵝卵石。

File: As you slip into the water, the magic ring slips from your finger.
檔案: 你滑入水中時，魔戒從你的手指上滑落了。

File: That's one giant leap for the fish!
檔案: 對這條魚來說，這可是一大步啊！

File: Looks like all the fish are currently underwater.
檔案: 看來所有的魚現在都在水面下。

File: The fish would make your clothes smell and wouldn't be any help on your quest.
檔案: 那條魚只會讓你的衣服發臭，對你的冒險毫無幫助。

File: This is a serene mountain lake.
檔案: 這是一座寧靜的山中湖泊。

File: In the woods to the north, you can just see what looks like an old stone well.
檔案: 在北邊的樹林裡，你隱約看見一口像是古老石井的東西。

File: The sunlight glistens on the rippling water.
檔案: 陽光在粼粼水波上閃耀。

File: Do you see any fish here at the moment?
檔案: 你現在有看到任何魚嗎？

File: Perhaps you'll find a use for a fish in a different King's Quest, but not in this one.
檔案: 也許在另一款《國王密令》裡，魚會派上用場，但這一款不會。

File: You already have the pouch.
檔案: 你已經拿到皮袋了。

File: You found it already.
檔案: 你已經找到了。

File: Haven't you found it yet?
檔案: 你還沒找到嗎？

File: Inside the rotting stump you notice a small leather pouch.
檔案: 你在腐朽的樹樁裡發現一個小皮袋。

File: Inside the decaying tree stump, you see nothing interesting.
檔案: 在這個腐朽的樹樁裡，你沒看到什麼特別的東西。

File: Why don't you move closer to try that?
檔案: 你何不靠近一點再試試看？

File: You peer into the darkness inside the log, but there's nothing at all inside.
檔案: 你窺探樹幹內部的黑暗，但裡面什麼也沒有。

File: You're not close enough to see into the log.
檔案: 你離得不夠近，看不進樹幹裡面。

File: From here you can see the stump is very old and rotting away.
檔案: 從這裡你看得出這個樹樁又老又朽。

File: You can only vaguely see the stump from this distance.
檔案: 隔著這段距離，你只能隱約看見那個樹樁。

File: Next to you is an old fallen tree trunk.  It's crumbling and rotted, and holds no interest for you... unless you have a fascination with termites!
檔案: 你身旁有一根倒下的老樹幹，已經腐朽崩解，沒什麼好看的……除非你對白蟻特別著迷！

File: You can't see much of the log from over here.
檔案: 從這裡看不清楚那根樹幹。

File: You're in a quiet part of the forest.  There's an old rotted stump here.
檔案: 你身處森林一處僻靜的地方，這裡有個腐朽的老樹樁。

File: You can't see the termites unless you split open the log.  But that would be a waste of time.
檔案: 除非劈開樹幹，否則你看不到白蟻，但那只是浪費時間。

File: You're not that hungry.  You hope that you NEVER become that hungry!
檔案: 你沒那麼餓，你希望自己永遠都不會餓成那樣！

File: They're obviously more afraid of you than you are of them.  Leave them alone.
檔案: 顯然牠們比你還怕，別去招惹牠們。

File: There is no reason to take this old log with you.
檔案: 沒有理由把這根老樹幹帶在身上。

File: You are already carrying them in your leather pouch.
檔案: 你已經把它們裝在皮袋裡帶著了。

File: You already have the leather pouch.
檔案: 你已經有這個皮袋了。

File: There's no pouch here.
檔案: 這裡沒有皮袋。

File: You have to find it first.
檔案: 你得先找到它。

File: As you lift the pouch from the stump, you feel its contents shifting inside.
檔案: 你把皮袋從樹樁上拿起時，感覺得到裡頭的東西正在晃動。

File: You should try getting closer.
檔案: 你應該試著靠近一點。

File: A small, pleasant waterfall pours into a crystal clear lake.
檔案: 一道小巧宜人的瀑布，注入一座清澈見底的湖泊。

File: A small spring bubbles up from the rocks here and splashes into the lake.
檔案: 這裡的岩石間湧出一道小泉水，濺入湖中。

File: This is a peaceful little lake, fed by a nearby waterfall.
檔案: 這是一座寧靜的小湖泊，由附近的瀑布注入湖水。

File: Flowing into this peaceful lake is a small waterfall.
檔案: 一道小瀑布流入這座寧靜的湖泊。

File: The flowers are very beautiful.
檔案: 這些花朵十分美麗。

File: The fish are certainly getting their exercise today.
檔案: 這些魚今天倒是游得挺起勁的。

File: There is no fish here to look at!
檔案: 這裡沒有魚可以看！

File: You won't be needing any fish on your quest.
檔案: 你的冒險用不到魚。

File: You are standing in a clearing.  The view of the forest is most pleasant here.
檔案: 你站在一片空地上，這裡眺望森林的景色十分宜人。

File: There is no fairy here.
檔案: 這裡沒有仙女。

File: She is your fairy godmother.
檔案: 她是你的教母。

File: It is impossible to acquire a fairy godmother.
檔案: 你不可能得到一位教母。

File: There is no need to say, or do, anything.
檔案: 你不需要說什麼，也不需要做什麼。

File: FAIRY GODMOTHER: "Gentle Sir Graham, I am your fairy godmother."
檔案: 教母：「親愛的格拉漢爵士，我是你的教母。」

File: FAIRY GODMOTHER: "Your quest is indeed noble.  What little aid I can offer you is this protective magic spell, effective but a little while."
檔案: 教母：「你的任務確實崇高。我能給你的些許幫助，就是這道守護魔法，只是效力短暫。」

File: FAIRY GODMOTHER: "I shall be watching over you, Sir Graham."
檔案: 教母：「我會在一旁守護著你，格拉漢爵士。」

File: While you were wandering in the pen, the goat has wandered away.
檔案: 你在羊圈裡四處閒晃時，山羊已經跑走了。

File: The goat doesn't see you anymore.
檔案: 山羊再也看不見你了。

File: Silly!  Goats can't talk.
檔案: 傻瓜！山羊不會說話。

File: Why?  The goat seems to be following you quite nicely.
檔案: 為什麼？山羊看起來跟得挺乖的。

File: You wouldn't get very far carrying the goat.  Perhaps you can get him to follow you if you'd like to take him somewhere.
檔案: 抱著山羊走不了多遠。如果你想帶牠去哪裡，也許可以讓牠跟著你走。

File: You cannot do that from outside the fence.
檔案: 你在欄杆外做不到這件事。

File: What do you want to feed the old goat?
檔案: 你想餵這隻老山羊吃什麼？

File: You can try, but be careful.
檔案: 你可以試試看，但要小心。

File: Are you kidding? The goat would never let you!
檔案: 你在開玩笑嗎？山羊絕不會讓你這麼做！

File: You do not have a carrot.
檔案: 你身上沒有胡蘿蔔。

File: You are too far away.
檔案: 你離得太遠了。

File: You and all your belongings are invisible. The goat can't see your carrot.
檔案: 你和你身上所有的東西都是隱形的，山羊看不見你的胡蘿蔔。

File: Goats love carrots! The old goat quickly devours yours and stops following you.
檔案: 山羊最愛胡蘿蔔了！老山羊很快就把你的胡蘿蔔吃光，也不再跟著你了。

File: Goats love carrots! The old goat quickly devours yours.
檔案: 山羊最愛胡蘿蔔了！老山羊很快就把你的胡蘿蔔吃光了。

File: The goat is already following you.
檔案: 山羊已經在跟著你了。

File: You need to get into the goat pen.
檔案: 你得先進到羊圈裡。

File: You need to get a little closer.
檔案: 你得再靠近一點。

File: The goat, unable to see either you or the carrot, is not impressed in the slightest by the carrot.
檔案: 山羊既看不見你，也看不見胡蘿蔔，對這根胡蘿蔔絲毫不感興趣。

File: The goat must be on the other side of the goat pen.
檔案: 山羊一定在羊圈的另一頭。

File: He's already dead, it just wouldn't be the same.
檔案: 牠已經死透了，再做一次也沒什麼意思。

File: You can't do that while your invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法做這件事。

File: You don't have everything you need to do that.
檔案: 你身上東西不齊全，沒辦法做這件事。

File: Pelting the goat with pebbles would be a slow and painful way to kill him.  If you feel you absolutely must do away with him, use a quicker method.
檔案: 用鵝卵石砸山羊，是既緩慢又痛苦的殺法。如果你真的非除掉牠不可，用更快的方法吧。

File: You need to go into the pen to kill the goat.
檔案: 你得先進到羊圈裡，才能殺這隻山羊。

File: You should get closer to the goat first.
檔案: 你應該先靠近山羊一點。

File: You don't have a good weapon with which to kill the goat.
檔案: 你身上沒有適合殺死山羊的武器。

File: Since you are invisible, everything you own is invisible.  The goat cannot see the carrot.
檔案: 既然你是隱形的，你身上所有的東西也都是隱形的，山羊看不見那根胡蘿蔔。

File: There is no goat in the immediate area.
檔案: 附近沒有山羊。

File: The fence is too high for you to jump over.
檔案: 欄杆太高了，你跳不過去。

File: It would be easier to just open the gate.
檔案: 直接打開閘門會容易得多。

File: It is high enough to keep the old goat from jumping over it.
檔案: 這欄杆夠高，老山羊跳不過去。

File: The goat pen is crudely made of small tree limbs.  At the other end you see a gate.
檔案: 這座羊圈是用細小的樹枝簡陋搭成的，另一頭有一道閘門。

File: You are in the small goat pen.
檔案: 你在這座小羊圈裡。

File: Someone has built a small goat pen here.
檔案: 有人在這裡搭了一座小羊圈。

File: You see a gate at the other end of the goat pen.
檔案: 你看見羊圈的另一頭有一道閘門。

File: There must be a gate around here somewhere.
檔案: 這附近一定有一道閘門。

File: That would be very much like beating a dead horse, wouldn't it?
檔案: 那豈不是像鞭打死馬一樣，白費力氣嗎？

File: A gallant knight such as yourself would never attack an innocent goat.
檔案: 像你這樣英勇的騎士，絕不會攻擊一隻無辜的山羊。

File: The old goat shows some interest in the carrot.
檔案: 這隻老山羊對胡蘿蔔顯得有些興趣。

File: Very clever!  You tempt the goat with the carrot and he begins to follow you around.  You've made a friend!
檔案: 真聰明！你用胡蘿蔔引誘山羊，牠開始跟著你到處走。你交到一個朋友了！

File: Oh, no!  The goat has escaped through the gate that you left open behind you.  He could have wandered anywhere by now.
檔案: 糟了！山羊從你沒關上的閘門逃走了，現在牠可能跑到任何地方去了。

File: There is a small bush near the pen.
檔案: 羊圈附近有一叢小灌木。

File: There are several willowy shade trees around the goat pen.
檔案: 羊圈四周有幾棵柳枝搖曳的遮蔭樹。

File: This is the crude wooden fence that encloses the goat and his trough.
檔案: 這是圍住山羊和牠飼料槽的簡陋木欄杆。

File: The goat, unable to see either you or the carrot, doesn't react to your offering.
檔案: 山羊既看不見你，也看不見胡蘿蔔，對你遞出的東西毫無反應。

File: The goat seems to have left through the gate.

File: Don't be afraid.  Get close enough for a good look.
檔案: 別害怕，靠近一點好好看清楚。

File: The only response you get is the echo of your pounding.
檔案: 你得到的唯一回應，只有自己敲門聲的回音。

File: Wait for the goat while it tries to catch up.
檔案: 等等那隻山羊，讓牠跟上來。

File: There are no beavers here now.
檔案: 這裡現在沒有海狸。

File: This is a pretty little alpine lake.  There is a cool breeze here, and the lake shimmers softly in the quiet mountain air.
檔案: 這是一座美麗的高山小湖，這裡涼風徐徐，湖面在寧靜的山間空氣中輕輕閃爍著光芒。

File: It looks as though there were beavers around here at one time.
檔案: 看起來這一帶似乎曾經有過海狸。

File: Sunlight glistens on the rippling lake water.
檔案: 陽光在盪漾的湖水上閃閃發光。

File: The fish are pretty jumpy in Daventry, aren't they?
檔案: 戴凡確王國的魚還真是活蹦亂跳，不是嗎？

File: There aren't any fish here to see...at the moment.
檔案: 現在這裡……暫時看不到任何魚。

File: There's no witch here at the moment.
檔案: 現在這裡沒有巫婆。

File: This part of the forest is dark and creepy.  Shadows seem to jump out at you, and the trees are gnarled and misshapen.
檔案: 這一帶的森林陰暗又詭異，陰影彷彿隨時會朝你撲來，樹木也扭曲變形、奇形怪狀。

File: This is not your friendly-type witch.
檔案: 這可不是那種友善的巫婆。

File: Killing the witch would be very difficult right now, she is moving too fast!
檔案: 現在要殺死這個巫婆很困難，她動作快得很！

File: There is no witch here at the moment.
檔案: 現在這裡沒有巫婆。

File: The wicked witch is not interested in chitchat.
檔案: 這個邪惡的巫婆沒興趣閒聊。

File: It looks as though she's already caught YOU!
檔案: 看樣子，她已經抓住你了！

File: Are you kidding?
檔案: 你在開玩笑嗎？

File: There's no way you can do that.  The witch is holding you with supernatural strength.
檔案: 你不可能辦到這件事，巫婆正用超自然的力量抓著你。

File: You're too high for that.  You'd break your neck.
檔案: 你飛得太高了，這麼做會摔斷脖子。

File: The witch is mad enough already without you worsening her mood.
檔案: 巫婆已經夠生氣了，別再讓她的心情更糟。

File: With a screech and cackle, a witch swoops down from the skies above.  Look out!  She dips and turns and tries to catch you!
檔案: 伴隨著尖嘯與狂笑，一個巫婆從天而降。小心！她俯衝迴旋，想要抓住你！

File: It's a good thing you're invisible!
檔案: 幸好你是隱形的！

File: She's got you!  She grabs you by the neck with an iron grip, and carries you off to her cottage deep in the forest.
檔案: 她抓到你了！她用鐵一般的力道扣住你的脖子，把你帶往她深藏在森林裡的小屋。

File: The opening to the cave is dark and ominous.
檔案: 洞穴的入口幽暗又不祥。

File: You vaguely see the outline of a cave entrance.
檔案: 你隱約看見一個洞穴入口的輪廓。

File: A large cave is at the edge of this meadow.
檔案: 這片草地的邊緣有個大洞穴。

File: This is a large condor.  Its graceful flight appears effortless.  At times, it dives so low you can practically touch it!
檔案: 這是一隻巨大的兀鷲，牠飛行的姿態優雅、毫不費力。有時牠俯衝得很低，低到你幾乎可以摸到牠！

File: There is no bird here.
檔案: 這裡沒有鳥。

File: You could try getting it, if you could only reach it.
檔案: 要是你能搆得到，或許可以試著抓住牠。

File: The condor is out of your reach.
檔案: 這隻兀鷲你搆不到。

File: These rocks are a little too treacherous to climb.
檔案: 這些岩石有點太危險了，不好攀爬。

File: The bird is too high to kill.  Besides, why would you want to kill such a fine, friendly bird?
檔案: 這隻鳥飛得太高，殺不到。而且，你為什麼要殺這麼一隻優秀又友善的鳥呢？

File: The condor doesn't speak, but it's wiser than you probably suspect.
檔案: 這隻兀鷲不會說話，但牠恐怕比你想像的更有智慧。

File: The goat begins to reply, but then remembers that goats can't talk!
檔案: 山羊正想開口回答，卻猛然想起山羊根本不會說話！

File: As there's nobody here to speak to, the conversation quickly grinds to a halt.
檔案: 這裡沒有人可以交談，對話很快就冷場了。

File: The surrounding boulders and trees are reflected on the small, mirror-like lake.
檔案: 周圍的巨石與樹木，倒映在這面如鏡的小湖上。

File: The fish is simply trying to get a good look at you.
檔案: 這條魚只是想好好看看你。

File: Looks like all the fish have taken a dive.
檔案: 看來所有的魚都已經潛入水中了。

File: There's nothing fishy about this quest; you won't be needing any of them.
檔案: 這趟冒險跟魚一點關係也沒有，你用不到牠們。

File: There is a huge stalk growing here!
檔案: 這裡長著一根巨大的莖幹！

File: You see a fragrant patch of clover growing in this lush meadow.
檔案: 你看見這片茂盛的草地上，長著一片芬芳的三葉草叢。

File: Upon close examination, you see a four-leaf clover in the clover patch.
檔案: 仔細一看，你在這片三葉草叢裡發現了一株幸運草。

File: You see a clover patch.
檔案: 你看見一片三葉草叢。

File: A patch of clover catches your attention.
檔案: 一片三葉草叢吸引了你的注意。

File: You won't need to pick any of those, but they're very pretty to look at.
檔案: 你不需要摘這些，不過它們看起來很漂亮。

File: You've already picked the only four-leaf clover in the patch.
檔案: 你已經摘走了這片草叢裡唯一的一株幸運草。

File: You can't pick any clover while you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法採摘三葉草。

File: You've already picked the best clover in the patch.
檔案: 你已經摘走這片草叢裡最好的幸運草了。

File: The three-leaf clovers are neither interesting nor helpful to you.
檔案: 三葉草對你來說既沒意思也沒用處。

File: You can't climb this tree.
檔案: 你爬不上這棵樹。

File: Catching the butterfly will not get you any closer to your goal.  And it might hurt the butterfly.
檔案: 抓蝴蝶不會讓你更接近目標，還可能傷到牠。

File: Apparently the hot Daventry sun is getting to you.
檔案: 看來戴凡確王國的烈日曬得你頭昏了。

File: The butterfly doesn't talk.
檔案: 蝴蝶不會說話。

File: This is a charming little yellow butterfly.
檔案: 這是一隻迷人的小黃蝴蝶。

File: An unusual clover glistens in the middle of the patch.
檔案: 草叢中央有一株不尋常的幸運草閃閃發光。

File: You notice a patch of clover just a few short steps away.
檔案: 你注意到不遠處有一片幸運草叢。

File: A jumble of clover grows in this patch of the forest.
檔案: 森林這片區域雜亂地長著一叢幸運草。

File: A rough-hewn plank bridge spans the deep rushing river here.
檔案: 這裡有座粗糙的木板橋，橫跨湍急的深河。

File: There is no one to talk to here.
檔案: 這裡沒有人可以交談。

File: The trees flourish in the moist, healthy soil around the river.
檔案: 河邊潮濕肥沃的土壤讓樹木長得十分茂盛。

File: As you start to cross the bridge, a huge, hulking troll stomps into view and blocks your way.  Even though you are invisible, the troll can sense your presence and will not allow you to cross his bridge.
檔案: 你正要過橋時，一隻魁梧的矮精靈踏著沉重的腳步出現，擋住了你的去路。儘管你隱形著，矮精靈仍能感應到你的存在，不肯讓你過橋。

File: As you start to cross the bridge, a huge, hulking troll stomps into view and blocks your way.
檔案: 你正要過橋時，一隻魁梧的矮精靈踏著沉重的腳步出現，擋住了你的去路。

File: As the troll pushes you back your ring slips off and falls into the river. It's gone forever!
檔案: 矮精靈把你推了回去，戒指從你手上滑落，掉進河裡。永遠找不回來了！

File: It is a well known fact that goats hate trolls intensely.  You move aside and let the goat take care of this wretched, nasty troll.
檔案: 眾所皆知，山羊對矮精靈恨之入骨。你讓到一旁，讓山羊去對付這隻可惡的矮精靈。

File: The goat lowers his head and runs straight for the troll, butting him right off the bridge and into the river below.  That's the last you'll see of that troll.
檔案: 山羊低下頭，直直衝向矮精靈，一頭把牠撞下橋、掉進下方的河裡。你再也見不到那隻矮精靈了。

File: These rocks are worn smooth from countless years of swiftly flowing water.
檔案: 這些石頭被湍急的流水沖刷了無數年，已經磨得十分光滑。

File: TROLL: "Well, what've we got here?  You think yer gonna cross my bridge, do you?  Not for FREE, you ain't."
檔案: 矮精靈：「哼，這是什麼？你以為可以白白過我的橋？沒付錢，休想。」

File: TROLL: "Yer quite the little chatterbox, aintcha?  Well, lemmee warn ya, these bridges have been in my family for years and years, and nobody, especially not a puny little knight like yerself, has ever passed across one of our bridges without payin' our Troll Toll."
檔案: 矮精靈：「你話還真多啊？好吧，讓我警告你，這座橋在我家族手裡傳了好幾代，從沒有人，尤其不會是你這種弱不禁風的小騎士，不付『過橋費』就想通過。」

File: TROLL: "Quit gabbin'.  Are you plannin' on paying my toll, or does I hafta get tough?"
檔案: 矮精靈：「別廢話了。你到底要不要付過橋費，還是要我對你不客氣？」

File: A lovely tree overlooks a bend in the river.
檔案: 一棵美麗的樹俯瞰著河流的轉彎處。

File: The turbulent river surges over and around the rocks, down the bend to the north.
檔案: 湍急的河水衝過岩石，往北邊的彎道流去。

File: This is an attractive meadow.  A particularly large tree stands nearby.
檔案: 這是一片迷人的草原，附近矗立著一棵特別高大的樹。

File: They're not ready to leave the nest yet!
檔案: 牠們還沒準備好離巢！

File: The birds of Daventry prefer their food untouched by human hands.
檔案: 戴凡確王國的鳥兒偏好沒被人手碰過的食物。

File: The mother bird is feeding her young in the nest high above you.
檔案: 母鳥正在你頭頂高處的鳥巢裡餵食幼鳥。

File: The baby birds are very hungry.  It will be several weeks before they are able to start feeding themselves.
檔案: 雛鳥非常餓，還要幾個星期才能自己覓食。

File: The nest houses a mother bird and her brood of two hungry baby birds.
檔案: 鳥巢裡住著一隻母鳥和牠兩隻飢餓的雛鳥。

File: The windows are made from hardened sugar.   You can't see through them very well.
檔案: 窗戶是用硬化的糖做成的，你看不太清楚裡面。

File: The candy canes on the window block your view.
檔案: 窗上的柺杖糖擋住了你的視線。

File: Mmmmmm! The lovely aroma of baked gingerbread makes your mouth water.
檔案: 嗯～剛烤好的薑餅香氣四溢，讓你垂涎三尺。

File: This is the sweetest little gingerbread house you've ever seen.  The walls are cake, the roof is frosting, the chimney is made from gummy bricks, and the candy path and cookie fence are unbearably tempting!
檔案: 這是你見過最甜美的小薑餅屋。牆壁是蛋糕做的，屋頂是糖霜，煙囪是用軟糖磚砌成的，糖果小徑和餅乾圍籬更是誘人得讓人受不了！

File: You can't see much from here.
檔案: 從這裡看不到什麼。

File: You are near a little gingerbread house in a forest clearing.
檔案: 你來到森林空地中的一間小薑餅屋附近。

File: You must be getting nervous! There is no witch anywhere to be seen.
檔案: 你一定緊張起來了吧！四周根本看不到什麼巫婆。

File: The path leads to the door.
檔案: 這條小徑通往大門。

File: The whole house is made of candy.
檔案: 整棟房子都是用糖果做的。

File: It is made of delicious chocolate chip cookies!
檔案: 這是用美味的巧克力餅乾做成的！

File: The whole HOUSE is made of gingerbread!
檔案: 整棟「房子」都是薑餅做的！

File: The entire ROOF is made of frosting!
檔案: 整個「屋頂」都是糖霜做的！

File: Strangely enough, knocking on the door while invisible wouldn't make any sound!
檔案: 說也奇怪，隱形的時候敲門根本不會發出聲音！

File: The door is already closed.
檔案: 門已經關上了。

File: The windows are too hard to break.
檔案: 窗戶太硬了，打不破。

File: You would have to get closer to the windows.
檔案: 你得靠近窗戶才行。

File: You don't need to do that; opening the door would suffice.
檔案: 你不必這麼做，打開門就夠了。

File: The door is around the corner.
檔案: 門在轉角那邊。

File: The door is not locked.
檔案: 門沒有上鎖。

File: Yummy!
檔案: 好好吃！

File: You will have to move closer to do that.
檔案: 你得靠近一點才能這麼做。

File: The gingerbread house with its frosting looks tempting, but you need to get closer.
檔案: 覆著糖霜的薑餅屋看起來很誘人，但你得靠近一點。

File: As you begin to eat the house, a squeaky voice from somewhere says, "Nibble, nibble, little mouse.  Who is nibbling at my house?"
檔案: 你剛開始啃房子，就聽見不知從哪傳來一個尖細的聲音說：「啃啊啃，小老鼠，是誰在啃我的房子？」

File: Yum! The house tastes even better than it looks!
檔案: 好吃！這房子嚐起來比看起來還美味！

File: What candy would you like to eat? The whole house is made of candy.
檔案: 你想吃哪種糖果？整棟房子都是糖果做的。

File: The cookies look delicious, but the house looks even better!
檔案: 餅乾看起來很美味，但房子看起來更棒！

File: Eat a flower? That seems rather strange.
檔案: 吃花？這聽起來相當奇怪。

File: As good as it looks, you're just a little bit suspicious about where all that candy came from.
檔案: 雖然看起來很美味，你還是有點懷疑這些糖果是從哪來的。

File: It looks tempting, but you can't reach it from down here.
檔案: 看起來很誘人，但你在下面搆不到。

File: You don't know how long they have been standing there.  Eating them probably wouldn't be a wise thing to do.
檔案: 你不知道它們在那裡放了多久，吃下去恐怕不是明智之舉。

File: Something...or someone...must be cooking.
檔案: 一定有什麼……或者什麼人……正在做菜。

File: The door is made from candy canes.
檔案: 這扇門是用柺杖糖做成的。

File: As you knock on the candy cane door, a squeaky voice from inside the house says, "Who is there? I love visitors, especially young, tender ones! Come in, come in!"
檔案: 你敲了敲柺杖糖做的門，屋裡傳出一個尖細的聲音說：「是誰啊？我最喜歡訪客了，尤其是年輕又嫩的！進來吧，快進來！」

File: There is no answer from inside the house.
檔案: 屋裡沒有人回應。

File: The path to the front door is lined with little gingerbread boys and girls.
檔案: 通往大門的小徑兩旁排滿了小薑餅男孩和女孩。

File: Gnarled, ancient trees loom in this dark part of the forest.
檔案: 這片幽暗的森林裡，矗立著扭曲盤根的古老大樹。

File: These are some of the largest, plumpest walnuts you have ever seen.
檔案: 這些是你見過最大、最飽滿的胡桃。

File: There are some walnuts nearby, under the walnut tree.
檔案: 胡桃樹下附近散落著幾顆胡桃。

File: There are no more walnuts to be seen!
檔案: 已經看不到更多胡桃了！

File: There is a large walnut tree surrounded by several pine trees.
檔案: 一棵高大的胡桃樹被幾棵松樹環繞著。

File: If you've seen one pine tree, you've seen them all.
檔案: 看過一棵松樹，等於全都看過了。

File: The tree is loaded with walnuts.
檔案: 這棵樹上結滿了胡桃。

File: The walnuts are too hard to see from over here.
檔案: 從這裡很難看清楚那些胡桃。

File: Actually, you were quite lucky:  you picked the only gold walnut in the bunch!  The rest are of no use to you.
檔案: 其實你相當幸運：你摘到的正是這堆裡唯一的金胡桃！其餘的對你都沒有用。

File: You already have a gold walnut.
檔案: 你已經有一顆金胡桃了。

File: Where can you get a gold walnut?
檔案: 哪裡能找到金胡桃？

File: You've already picked the only walnut worth getting, though you may not have realized it!
檔案: 你已經摘走了唯一值得拿的那顆胡桃，只是你可能還沒發現！

File: You already have one walnut, let's not be greedy.
檔案: 你已經有一顆胡桃了，別太貪心。

File: You can't pick it up while you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法把它撿起來。

File: It looks like a walnut of some sort.
檔案: 看起來像是某種胡桃。

File: What are you throwing at?
檔案: 你想丟向什麼？

File: In the manner of a cruel schoolboy, you fling a pebble at the squirrel.  Fortunately, the squirrel is too quick for you.
檔案: 你像個殘忍的小男孩一樣，朝松鼠丟了一顆鵝卵石。幸好松鼠的動作比你快多了。

File: You don't have any rocks to throw.
檔案: 你沒有石頭可以丟。

File: There is no squirrel here.
檔案: 這裡沒有松鼠。

File: The squirrel doesn't want one that you've touched.
檔案: 松鼠不想要被你碰過的東西。

File: The squirrel seems hesitant about climbing its favorite walnut tree with you standing around!
檔案: 你站在旁邊，松鼠似乎不太敢爬上牠最愛的胡桃樹！

File: There is no squirrel here at the moment.
檔案: 這裡目前沒有松鼠。

File: Please don't bother the squirrel, it has a lot of work to do before next winter.
檔案: 請別打擾松鼠，牠在下一個冬天來臨前還有很多事要忙。

File: You don't have anything to shoot the squirrel with.
檔案: 你沒有東西可以拿來射松鼠。

File: You'll have to have some sort of small, hard projectile in order to use the sling.
檔案: 你得先有某種小而堅硬的投射物，才能使用投石器。

File: What would a knight have to gain by murdering such a cute, inoffensive creature as a tiny squirrel?
檔案: 殺死一隻可愛又無害的小松鼠，對一位騎士能有什麼好處？

File: It would be cowardly to kill the squirrel, and it would serve no purpose.  Act like a knight!
檔案: 殺松鼠既懦弱又毫無意義，拿出騎士的樣子來！

File: The squirrel took the walnut you wanted.
檔案: 松鼠拿走了你想要的那顆胡桃。

File: Pick another one instead.
檔案: 換摘另一顆吧。

File: There are no more walnuts to pick.
檔案: 沒有更多胡桃可以摘了。

File: You'll have to get closer to the nuts.
檔案: 你得靠近那些胡桃才行。

File: You choose a big, meaty-looking walnut from the bunch scattered around.
檔案: 你從散落一地的胡桃中，挑了一顆看起來大又飽滿的。

File: Naah, you'd get sticky sap and pine needles all over yourself.
檔案: 算了吧，你會沾得滿身黏答答的樹脂和松針。

File: They're doing quite nicely where they are, thank you.
檔案: 它們待在原地好好的，謝了。

File: There appears to be some sort of bowl sitting next to the tree.
檔案: 樹旁似乎放著某種碗。

File: There appears to be some sort of bowl on the ground.
檔案: 地上似乎放著某種碗。

File: From what you can see of it, it looks like a colorful bowl of some sort.
檔案: 從你看到的樣子判斷，這像是某種色彩繽紛的碗。

File: The ground all around Daventry is carpeted with lush, green grass.
檔案: 戴凡確王國四周的地面，鋪滿了茂盛翠綠的青草。

File: A gigantic beanstalk has grown here, stretching up until it disappears into the clouds above.
檔案: 這裡長出了一株巨大的豆莖，一路向上延伸，直到消失在頭頂的雲層裡。

File: This is a charming little wooded area of the forest. Pine trees and lush grass grow in the especially rich soil here.
檔案: 這是森林裡一小片迷人的林地，肥沃的土壤上長滿了松樹和茂密的青草。

File: Lovely pine trees abound in this forest.
檔案: 這片森林裡到處都是美麗的松樹。

File: You've already picked it up.
檔案: 你已經撿起來了。

File: You can't pick up the bowl while you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法撿起那個碗。

File: You are too busy.
檔案: 你正忙著呢。

File: On the far side of the river is a green meadow.
檔案: 河的對岸是一片綠色草原。

File: The meadow is on the other side of the river.
檔案: 草原在河的另一邊。

File: Water rushes swiftly around the bend and over the rocks.
檔案: 河水湍急地繞過彎道、越過岩石。

File: You see a lovely green meadow on the other side of the river.
檔案: 你看見河的另一邊有片美麗的綠色草原。

File: The swiftly-moving water is even more dangerous than it looks.
檔案: 湍急的河水比看起來還要危險。

File: The meadow is on the other side of the raging river.
檔案: 草原在這條怒河流的另一邊。

File: Around the rugged rocks the reckless river rages.
檔案: 洶湧的河水在崎嶇的岩石間肆虐奔騰。

File: High cliffs border a wild, raging river.
檔案: 高聳的懸崖夾著一條狂野洶湧的河流。

File: You notice an enchanting meadow.
檔案: 你注意到一片迷人的草原。

File: The meadow on the other side of the river looks very peaceful and enchanting.
檔案: 河對岸的草原看起來十分寧靜迷人。

File: Some of the rocks poke up from the riverbed.  These rocks are actually very tall and treacherous!
檔案: 河床上突出幾塊岩石，這些岩石其實又高又危險！

File: No way.  Who knows what squirmy, slimy creatures are lurking underneath?
檔案: 才不要。誰知道底下潛伏著什麼扭來扭去的黏滑生物？

File: There are craggy rocks scattered around the forest. You hate to think of what's underneath them.
檔案: 森林四處散落著崎嶇的岩石，你不敢去想岩石底下藏著什麼。

File: You are in an eerie, desolate part of the forest.
檔案: 你來到森林裡一處陰森荒涼的地方。

File: The trees are bent and stunted, making the forest look even gloomier.
檔案: 樹木彎曲又發育不良，讓森林看起來更加陰森。

File: There's nothing to be gained by reaching into the hole.
檔案: 把手伸進洞裡不會有任何收穫。

File: You would need to be much smaller to fit through that hole.
檔案: 你得小上許多，才能穿過那個洞。

File: You might just as well try to hold a moonbeam in your hand!
檔案: 你不如試試用手抓住一道月光算了！

File: This rock is firmly stuck in the ground.
檔案: 這塊石頭牢牢卡在地上。

File: Although you are very strong and healthy, this rock is too much even for you.
檔案: 雖然你身強體健，這塊石頭還是太重，連你也搬不動。

File: The hole appears to go deep down through the rock, into the ground below.  You can barely make out a faint greenish glow somewhere far inside.
檔案: 這個洞似乎深深穿透岩石，通往地底深處。你隱約能看見遠方深處有一絲微弱的綠光。

File: There seems to be a small hole at the base of one of the boulders.
檔案: 其中一顆巨石底部似乎有個小洞。

File: An extremely large jumble of boulders sits in the center of this heavily wooded area.  At the base of one, you see a small hole.
檔案: 這片茂密樹林的中央堆著一大堆巨石。你看見其中一顆的底部有個小洞。

File: You notice a small hole at the base of one of the craggy boulders in the center of the clearing.
檔案: 你注意到，空地中央嶙峋巨石的底部有個小洞。

File: It seems to have a green tinge to it, but it's so faint you can't tell for sure.
檔案: 它似乎帶著一抹綠色，但太過微弱，讓你無法確定。

File: What glow?
檔案: 什麼光芒？

File: The ancient, mossy rock has seen many winters.  There is a small hole at its base.
檔案: 這塊佈滿青苔的古老岩石，已經歷過許多個寒冬。它的底部有個小洞。

File: From where you're standing, it appears to be nothing more than a large rock.
檔案: 從你站的地方看去，它似乎只是一塊大石頭。

File: Congratulations!  You now have all three of Daventry's lost treasures!  Now don't waste any time; bring the treasures straight back to King Edward before it's too late.
檔案: 恭喜！你已經找齊了戴凡確王國失落的三件寶物！別再浪費時間了，趁一切還來得及，趕緊把寶物帶回去給愛德華國王。

File: You'll have to move closer.
檔案: 你得靠近一點才行。

File: Large moss-covered trees surround a shallow, swampy lake.
檔案: 長滿青苔的大樹，環繞著一座淺淺的沼澤湖。

File: Spotting the snake in the treetops you wisely decide that there are better trees to climb than this one.
檔案: 你發現樹梢上有條蛇，明智地決定去爬別棵樹。

File: You'll wind up with a useless dead snake and a guilty conscience.
檔案: 到頭來你只會得到一條沒用的死蛇，還有滿滿的罪惡感。

File: The snake's small red tongue flicks at the air, tasting your presence in the swamp.
檔案: 蛇的小紅舌頭在空氣中吐信，感應著你在沼澤裡的存在。

File: Even if the snake could hear you, it wouldn't have anything to say.
檔案: 就算蛇聽得懂你說話，牠也無話可說。

File: The huge snake is watching you very closely, and its intentions are less than friendly.
檔案: 那條巨蛇正緊盯著你，來意顯然不太友善。

File: Numerous flowers are growing in the fertile soil.
檔案: 肥沃的土壤裡開滿了各式花朵。

File: The flowers' fragrance is enticing.
檔案: 花朵散發出誘人的香氣。

File: It would be a shame to pick the lovely wildflowers.
檔案: 摘下這些美麗的野花實在太可惜了。

File: Lovely wildflowers grow profusely in this beautiful green meadow.
檔案: 這片美麗的綠色草原上，遍地盛開著可愛的野花。

File: A mighty beanstalk has sprouted from the magic beans you planted!  Around the beanstalk, several varieties of wildflowers are growing.
檔案: 你種下的魔豆長出了一株雄偉的豆莖！豆莖四周開著好幾種野花。

File: The wildflowers are very beautiful here.
檔案: 這裡的野花非常美麗。

File: A natural rock bridge crosses the steep, slippery banks of the river here.
檔案: 這裡有一座天然的石橋，橫跨過又陡又滑的河岸。

File: As the troll pushes you back your ring slips off your finger and into the raging river below. It's lost forever!
檔案: 矮精靈把你推了回去，戒指從你的手指上滑落，掉進下方湍急的河水中。它永遠消失了！

File: The water is particularly perilous as it passes downstream through this gully.
檔案: 河水流經這道溝壑往下游而去時，格外危險。

File: GNOME: "How in the world did you think of that?  That's not even close."
檔案: 矮人：「你到底是怎麼想到那個的？差得可遠了。」

File: You weren't invited into the gnome's house.
檔案: 矮人並沒有邀請你進去他家。

File: There's a rock over by the bush, but this rock is nothing compared to the one the gnome lives in!
檔案: 灌木叢旁有塊石頭，但跟矮人住的那塊比起來根本不算什麼！

File: The gnome's house is carved right into the rock between three trees.
檔案: 矮人的家就鑿在三棵樹之間的岩石裡。

File: The broad leaves provide shade for the gnome during the hot summer months.
檔案: 寬大的樹葉在炎熱的夏季為矮人遮蔭。

File: The roots of the three trees grow freely around the gnome's house.
檔案: 三棵樹的樹根，恣意地在矮人家周圍蔓生。

File: This hole, carved into the side of the rock, is the entrance to the gnome's home.  It's too dark inside to make out any details, and the gnome probably prefers it that way.
檔案: 這個鑿在岩壁上的洞口，就是矮人家的入口。裡頭太暗了，看不清任何細節，矮人大概也樂得如此。

File: The wizened gnome went inside his house.
檔案: 那位乾瘦的矮人走進了他家裡。

File: You see a wizened old gnome sitting in front of his house, whittling.
檔案: 你看見一位乾瘦的老矮人，坐在家門前削著木頭。

File: You are speaking with a wizened old gnome.
檔案: 你正在和一位乾瘦的老矮人說話。

File: You see a wizened old gnome walking to his house.
檔案: 你看見一位乾瘦的老矮人正走回家去。

File: Why?  The gnome has done nothing to you.
檔案: 為什麼？矮人又沒對你做過什麼。

File: The gnome isn't here.
檔案: 矮人不在這裡。

File: You won't need any straw on your quest.
檔案: 你的冒險用不到稻草。

File: The gnome spun that gold out of straw! You can't take it, but don't worry. If you needed it, the gnome would give it to you.
檔案: 矮人把那些黃金用稻草紡出來的！你不能拿走，不過別擔心，如果你需要，矮人自然會給你。

File: The spinning wheel helps the gnome make his living. Please don't take it.
檔案: 這台紡車是矮人賴以維生的工具，請別拿走它。

File: Only gnomes know how to do that.
檔案: 只有矮人才懂得怎麼做那件事。

File: Now what in the world would you do with a gnome?
檔案: 你到底要拿一個矮人來做什麼？

File: GNOME: "Ooooh, very close, very close!  But not quite right!"
檔案: 矮人：「噢～很接近了，很接近了！但還不完全對！」

File: The gnome is busy whittling, and doesn't notice you.
檔案: 矮人正忙著削木頭，沒注意到你。

File: What do you think I am, a car?  This also won't get you a raise.  Nice try.
檔案: 你以為我是什麼，一輛車嗎？這樣也加不了薪。想得美。

File: GNOME: "Please, keep guessing, won't you?"
檔案: 矮人：「拜託，繼續猜嘛，好不好？」

File: GNOME: "Really, Sir Graham!"
檔案: 矮人：「格拉漢爵士，真是的！」

File: The gnome momentarily pauses in response to the mysterious voice, then resumes his whittling.
檔案: 矮人聽到這個神秘的聲音，停頓了一下，接著又繼續削木頭。

File: GNOME: "You still haven't guessed my name!"
檔案: 矮人：「你還沒猜出我的名字呢！」

File: The gnome can't hear you from there!
檔案: 你站在那裡，矮人聽不見你說話！

File: GNOME: "Where did you get that idea?  That's not even close!"
檔案: 矮人：「你這想法是打哪來的？差得可遠了！」

File: GNOME: "You have only one guess left, Sir Graham!"
檔案: 矮人：「格拉漢爵士，你只剩最後一次機會了！」

File: The gnome momentarily pauses in response to the mysterious voice, then resumes his whittling
檔案: 矮人聽到這個神秘的聲音，停頓了一下，接著又繼續削木頭

File: The gnome is busy whittling, and doesn't hear your guess.  Move closer and give it another try.
檔案: 矮人正忙著削木頭，沒聽見你的答案。靠近一點，再試一次吧。

File: GNOME: "That's right!  Outstanding!  I didn't think you were THAT clever."
檔案: 矮人：「答對了！太厲害了！沒想到你有這麼聰明。」

File: GNOME: "As a reward for your sharp intellect, here are some beans.  They're no ordinary beans, but it's up to you to find out why."
檔案: 矮人：「為了獎勵你的機智，這裡有一些豆子。它們可不是普通的豆子，至於為什麼，就由你自己去發現吧。」

File: GNOME: "Somebody as smart as yourself should have no problem at all.  <giggle>"
檔案: 矮人：「像你這麼聰明的人，這應該難不倒你才對。〈竊笑〉」

File: GNOME: "Well, step over here so I can give them to you."
檔案: 矮人：「來，走過來這邊，讓我把它們交給你。」

File: GNOME: "You didn't guess my name, but I am still going to help you, Sir Graham."
檔案: 矮人：「格拉漢爵士，雖然你沒猜中我的名字，但我還是會幫你的。」

File: GNOME: "Take this golden key.  It will aid you on your quest, Sir Graham, but it's up to you to find out how!"
檔案: 矮人：「格拉漢爵士，拿去這把金鑰匙。它會在你的冒險中幫上忙，至於怎麼用，就由你自己去發現吧！」

File: GNOME: "Well, step over here so I can give it to you."
檔案: 矮人：「來，走過來這邊，讓我把它交給你。」

File: GNOME: "Here you are.  Good luck on your quest."
檔案: 矮人：「拿去吧。祝你冒險順利。」

File: GNOME: "Er, pardon me, Sir Graham, but you're blocking my home.  I have other adventurers to help and other puzzles to pose!"
檔案: 矮人：「呃，格拉漢爵士，不好意思，你擋住我家的門了。我還有其他冒險者要幫忙、還有其他謎題要出呢！」

File: GNOME: "Thank you, Sir Graham."
檔案: 矮人：「謝謝你，格拉漢爵士。」

File: GNOME: "So, you've come back!  Good for you, Sir Graham!"
檔案: 矮人：「哦，你又回來了！格拉漢爵士，真有你的！」

File: GNOME: "Welcome, Sir Graham.  I have been expecting you."
檔案: 矮人：「歡迎，格拉漢爵士。我一直在等你。」

File: GNOME: "I have something that will be of great use to you.  But first, Sir Graham, you must answer this riddle.  I'll give you three guesses.  What is my name?"
檔案: 矮人：「我有樣東西對你會很有用。不過格拉漢爵士，你得先回答這個謎題。我給你三次機會，猜猜我叫什麼名字？」

File: GNOME: "It's been delightful chatting with you, Sir Graham.   I get so few visitors... Perhaps it's the fault of that thickheaded troll."
檔案: 矮人：「格拉漢爵士，跟你聊天真愉快。我這裡訪客實在不多……也許都要怪那個榆木腦袋的矮精靈。」

File: mad
檔案: 生氣

File: really mad
檔案: 非常生氣

File: It is of no use to keep guessing the gnome's name.
檔案: 再繼續猜矮人的名字也沒有用了。

File: GNOME: "You have only one guess left."
檔案: 矮人：「你只剩最後一次機會了。」

File: GNOME: "You still have two guesses."
檔案: 矮人：「你還有兩次機會。」

File: This is the gnome's spinning wheel.
檔案: 這是矮人的紡車。

File: This is a pile of gold.
檔案: 這是一堆黃金。

File: There is a small pile of straw here.
檔案: 這裡有一小堆稻草。

File: As the troll pushes you back your ring slips off and falls into the river, to be lost forever.
檔案: 矮精靈把你推了回去，戒指滑落，掉進河裡，永遠消失了。

File: The river ripples as it rushes over the rocks.
檔案: 河水沖過岩石，激起陣陣漣漪。

File: You can just walk out of the river.
檔案: 你可以直接走出河流。

File: The swift current is making it impossible to swim.
檔案: 湍急的水流讓你根本無法游泳。

File: Off to one side is a clear blue lake surrounded by a pretty meadow.  A swift river flows into the lake.
檔案: 一旁是一座清澈的藍色湖泊，四周環繞著美麗的草原，一條湍急的河流注入湖中。

File: The pretty meadow surrounds the clear blue lake.
檔案: 美麗的草原環繞著這座清澈的藍色湖泊。

File: The clear blue lake is surrounded by a pretty meadow.
檔案: 這座清澈的藍色湖泊，四周環繞著美麗的草原。

File: The river gets to be rather rough around these parts.
檔案: 河水流到這一帶變得相當湍急。

File: You glance under the old bridge, but see nothing unusual.
檔案: 你瞄了一眼舊橋底下，沒發現什麼異常。

File: There are some large rocks jutting out of the river here.
檔案: 這裡的河面上突出幾塊大石頭。

File: There are rocks and small boulders all along the lakeshore.
檔案: 湖岸邊到處是石頭和小巨石。

File: You see a clear blue lake surrounded by a pretty meadow.
檔案: 你看見一座清澈的藍色湖泊，四周環繞著美麗的草原。

File: The pretty meadow surrounds a clear blue lake.
檔案: 美麗的草原環繞著一座清澈的藍色湖泊。

File: The river, barely visible off to the west, empties into the lake.
檔案: 西邊隱約可見的河流，注入了這座湖泊。

File: A few trees sit near a clear blue lake.
檔案: 幾棵樹佇立在一座清澈的藍色湖泊旁。

File: This is a jumping fish.  You'd jump, too, if you lived in such cold water!
檔案: 這是一條會跳躍的魚。要是你也住在這麼冷的水裡，也會跳個不停！

File: At the moment, you'd only be able to see the fish from underwater!
檔案: 此刻，你只有潛到水裡才看得見這條魚！

File: The fish would do you no good except to attract the attention of every cat in the kingdom!
檔案: 這條魚對你一點用也沒有，頂多只會引來全王國貓咪的注意！

File: In the condition the cottage is in, that might be dangerous.

File: In this large underground cavern, there is one slimy green dead dragon, an opening on one side, and a very large boulder.
檔案: 在這個寬闊的地底洞穴裡，有一條渾身黏液的綠色巨龍已死，一側有個洞口，還有一塊碩大的巨石。

File: There is a dead dragon, a large boulder, and a seemingly ordinary mirror in the cave.
檔案: 洞穴裡有一條死去的巨龍、一塊巨石，還有一面看似平凡無奇的鏡子。

File: The cavern is empty, save for a couple of openings on either side.
檔案: 這個洞穴空無一物，只有兩側各有一個洞口。

File: There is a large granite boulder in the cave, as well as a mirror...a MAGIC mirror!!
檔案: 洞穴裡有一塊巨大的花崗岩巨石，還有一面鏡子……一面「魔鏡」！！

File: In this large underground cavern, there is a ferocious fire-breathing dragon, an opening on one side, and a very large boulder.
檔案: 在這個寬闊的地底洞穴裡，有一條兇猛的噴火巨龍，一側有個洞口，還有一塊碩大的巨石。

File: The ferocious fire-breathing dragon is protecting the magic mirror.
檔案: 這條兇猛的噴火巨龍正守護著魔鏡。

File: Parts of the cave are made impassable by huge, jagged stalagmites.  The craggy limestone stalactites hang menacingly from the roof of the cavern.  It took millenniums for these stalagmites and stalactites to form.
檔案: 洞穴的部分區域被巨大嶙峋的石筍擋住，無法通行。嶙峋的石灰岩鐘乳石從洞頂陰森森地垂掛而下。這些石筍與鐘乳石經過了千萬年才形成。

File: The hole seems to lead further into the cave.
檔案: 這個洞似乎通往洞穴更深處。

File: The faint images of reflected light issue from the entrance.
檔案: 微弱的反射光影從入口透出。

File: There are two entrances to the cave.
檔案: 這個洞穴有兩個入口。

File: In this large cavern, there is a slimy dead dragon.
檔案: 在這個寬闊的洞穴裡，有一條渾身黏液的死去巨龍。

File: The dragon has fled, never to return.
檔案: 巨龍已經逃走，再也不會回來了。

File: The dragon's rough, red pointed tongue protrudes awkwardly from the dead dragon's maw.
檔案: 死去巨龍的嘴裡，粗糙的紅色尖舌尷尬地伸出口外。

File: The dragon's still got it.
檔案: 巨龍依然留著它。

File: It would be easier if the dragon wasn't using it.
檔案: 要是巨龍沒在用它，事情會容易得多。

File: You take the Magic Mirror!  Congratulations!
檔案: 你拿到了魔鏡！恭喜你！

File: Dragon's Tongue is considered a delicacy in some parts of the world, but not in Daventry!
檔案: 龍舌在世界某些地方被視為珍饈，但在戴凡確王國可不是！

File: The dragon took it with him.
檔案: 巨龍把它一起帶走了。

File: This boulder is far too heavy to move.
檔案: 這塊巨石太重了，搬不動。

File: As you slowly and silently return to visibility, the dragon fails to notice you.
檔案: 你緩緩無聲地現出身形，巨龍卻沒有注意到你。

File: There is no one here to receive your offering.
檔案: 這裡沒有人可以接受你的獻禮。

File: The dead dragon does not need anything you have to offer.
檔案: 死去的巨龍不需要你所能奉上的任何東西。

File: The dragon, unaware that you've stolen his great treasure, is not interested in anything you have to offer.
檔案: 巨龍還不知道你已偷走牠的寶物，對你所能奉上的東西毫無興趣。

File: The dragon isn't interested in any of your possessions.  It's already got one of the most valuable treasures in Daventry.
檔案: 巨龍對你身上的任何東西都沒興趣，牠已經擁有戴凡確王國最珍貴的寶物之一。

File: Parts of the cave are made impassable by huge, jagged stalagmites.
檔案: 洞穴裡有些地方被巨大嶙峋的石筍擋住，無法通行。

File: The craggy limestone stalactites hang menacingly from the roof of the cavern.
檔案: 嶙峋的石灰岩鐘乳石從洞頂懸垂而下，看來十分嚇人。

File: Smoking is bad for your health.  That's why there are not many dragons around.
檔案: 抽菸有害健康。這就是為什麼巨龍已經不多見了。

File: The dragon's head is angular, like a pterodactyl's.  Large webbed gill flaps protrude from either side of his face, just underneath his horns.  Smoke curls lazily from his nostrils.
檔案: 巨龍的頭部稜角分明，像翼手龍一樣。臉頰兩側、犄角下方各突出一片巨大的蹼狀鰓瓣，鼻孔裡懶洋洋地冒出裊裊青煙。

File: Green and scaly, the dragon's body is massive and muscular.  A row of serrated armor stretches from the tip of his tail to the base of his neck; his leathery wings are folded tight against his sides, and his webbed claws look sharp and deadly.
檔案: 巨龍全身覆滿綠色鱗片，體型龐大、肌肉結實。一排鋸齒狀的甲殼從尾尖延伸到頸根；牠那對皮革般的翅膀緊緊收攏在身側，蹼狀的爪子看來銳利致命。

File: You should get closer to the mirror.
檔案: 你應該靠近魔鏡一點。

File: The mirror shimmers with its own magical light.
檔案: 魔鏡散發著自身的魔法光芒，微微閃爍。

File: The dragon's long, powerful neck is a slinky mass of sinew and scales. The underside of his throat is pale, fleshy and unprotected by scales.
檔案: 巨龍那條修長強壯的脖子，是一團柔韌的肌腱與鱗片。牠喉嚨下方的皮膚蒼白柔軟，沒有鱗片保護。

File: The dragon lies motionless on the rocky floor of the cavern.
檔案: 巨龍一動也不動地躺在洞穴的岩石地面上。

File: The ferocious fire-breathing dragon may look asleep, but don't be fooled....he's smarter than he looks.
檔案: 這隻兇猛的噴火巨龍看起來像是睡著了，但別被騙了……牠比看起來聰明得多。

File: There is a vicious fire-breathing dragon here!
檔案: 這裡有一隻兇猛的噴火巨龍！

File: Ordinarily, music hath charms to soothe a savage beast but this beast is a little too ferocious to appreciate fiddle music.
檔案: 通常音樂能撫慰凶猛的野獸，但這頭野獸太過兇殘，欣賞不了小提琴的樂聲。

File: This dragon had only one life, and you have already taken it.
檔案: 這隻巨龍只有一條命，而你已經取走了。

File: You don't have anything sharp enough to pierce the dragon's scaly hide!
檔案: 你身上沒有夠鋒利的東西，能刺穿巨龍的鱗皮！

File: Wait and see what the dragon is doing first.
檔案: 先等等，看看巨龍在做什麼。

File: You don't have everything you need to attempt such a feat.
檔案: 你身上還缺少嘗試這項壯舉所需的東西。

File: The dragon's already dead. Shooting him would be a waste of pebbles.
檔案: 巨龍已經死了，朝牠射擊只是浪費鵝卵石。

File: The pebbles are too blunt to deliver a fatal blow to the dragon, maybe a different approach would be better.
檔案: 鵝卵石太鈍了，沒辦法對巨龍造成致命一擊，或許該換個方法。

File: The dragon is dead.  He can no longer hear you.
檔案: 巨龍已經死了，聽不見你說話了。

File: Think again.  When this dragon talks, things have a tendency to catch fire.
檔案: 再想想吧。這隻巨龍一開口說話，東西可是會著火的。

File: The mere thought of retrieving the dagger repulses you.
檔案: 光是想到要去撿回那把短刀，就讓你感到反胃。

File: How?
檔案: 怎麼做？

File: The dragon is dead. He has ceased to be. Bereft of life, he rests in peace. Best to get on with the game and forget this sad creature.
檔案: 巨龍死了。牠已經不在了。失去了生命，安息長眠。還是繼續玩下去，忘了這隻可悲的生物吧。

File: Be careful.  Dragons are very dangerous.
檔案: 小心點，巨龍非常危險。

File: The Fairy Godmother's protective spell has saved you from a fiery fate.
檔案: 教母的守護魔法救了你，讓你逃過一場火劫。

File: The dagger flies through the air and is lost in the cave's darkness.
檔案: 短刀飛過半空，消失在洞穴的黑暗之中。

File: With unerring aim, the dagger streaks through the air and pierces the soft, unprotected skin under the dragon's throat.  The dragon convulses for a moment, and then crashes, lifeless, to the hard cavern floor.
檔案: 短刀精準無比地劃過空中，刺入巨龍喉嚨下方柔軟無鱗的皮膚。巨龍抽搐了片刻，隨即癱軟倒地，重重摔在堅硬的洞穴地面上，沒了氣息。

File: Good shot!  The water hits the dragon square in the face, dousing the dragon's fire.
檔案: 好一擊！水正中巨龍的臉，澆熄了牠的火焰。

File: Unable to defend itself with anything more than harmless clouds of steam, the dragon rolls aside the granite boulder and slinks off in shame, leaving the mirror behind.
檔案: 巨龍除了噴出無害的蒸汽，再也無力自保，只好推開那塊花崗岩巨石，羞愧地溜走，留下了魔鏡。

File: Unable to defend itself with anything more than harmless clouds of steam, the dragon rolls aside the granite boulder and slinks off in shame.
檔案: 巨龍除了噴出無害的蒸汽，再也無力自保，只好推開那塊花崗岩巨石，羞愧地溜走了。

File: You can't do that while you are invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法這麼做。

File: As your nose fills with the aroma of fresh well water, your lungs give out. Don't smell the water!
檔案: 井水清新的氣味灌滿你的鼻腔，你的肺卻撐不住了。別去聞水的味道！

File: It's too late to dive.  At this point, all you can do is drown.
檔案: 已經來不及潛水了，事到如今你只能溺水。

File: You are already doing that!
檔案: 你已經在這麼做了！

File: You need to be swimming first.
檔案: 你得先開始游泳。

File: Too late!  You have already stopped swimming and started drowning.
檔案: 太遲了！你已經停止游泳，開始溺水了。

File: Just walk over to the water.
檔案: 走到水邊就行了。

File: You're already in the water.
檔案: 你已經在水裡了。

File: You've swum too long already!  Your endurance has run out.
檔案: 你游得太久了！體力已經耗盡。

File: You can't do that from under water!
檔案: 你在水底下沒辦法這麼做！

File: There's no reason to climb anything here.
檔案: 這裡沒有什麼好爬的。

File: This isn't the chest you're looking for.
檔案: 這不是你要找的箱子。

File: All you have to do is walk right into the water.
檔案: 你只需要直接走進水裡就行了。

File: What would you like to get into?
檔案: 你想要進去什麼裡面？

File: You take a deep drink of the cold well water.
檔案: 你大口暢飲冰涼的井水。

File: The hinges are rusted, but still very strong.
檔案: 鉸鏈雖然鏽蝕，卻依然十分堅固。

File: This dark pool of water leads to the bottom of the ancient well near King Edward's castle.
檔案: 這片幽暗的水潭，通往愛德華國王城堡附近那口古井的井底。

File: You are too far away to see clearly.
檔案: 你離得太遠，看不清楚。

File: Too late!  Your vision grows blurred as you go down for the third time.
檔案: 太遲了！你第三次沉下水面，視線逐漸模糊。

File: You can see the surface of the water just above you.
檔案: 你看見水面就在你的正上方。

File: You can just see the opening of the well far above you.
檔案: 你隱約看見井口在你頭頂遙遠的上方。

File: You see the low ceiling of the cave just above you.
檔案: 你看見洞穴低矮的頂部，就在你頭頂上方。

File: You can see the bottom of the well below you.
檔案: 你看見井底就在你的下方。

File: You are at the bottom of the well.  Through the plants you spy what seems to be a hole in the side of the well.
檔案: 你正位於井底。透過水草，你瞥見井壁側面似乎有個洞。

File: The cave is dark and very damp.
檔案: 這座洞穴幽暗又十分潮濕。

File: This looks like typical well water.
檔案: 這看起來就是普通的井水。

File: The chest is buried deep in the sand and is too heavy to carry.
檔案: 箱子深埋在沙裡，重得搬不動。

File: The lid's hinges are rusted shut.
檔案: 蓋子的鉸鏈已經鏽死了。

File: The half-buried chest looks as if it has been here for a very long time.
檔案: 這只半埋在沙中的箱子，看起來已經在這裡放了很長一段時間。

File: It looks like this chest has been buried here for a very long time.
檔案: 這只箱子看起來已經埋在這裡很長一段時間了。

File: As you get into the water, the magic ring slips from your finger and vanishes.
檔案: 你進入水中時，魔戒從你的手指上滑落，消失無蹤。

File: This looks like a typical weed.
檔案: 這看起來是一株普通的水草。

File: More curious still, the courtyard is deserted; this area is usually filled with the Ladies and Lords of the castle.
檔案: 更奇怪的是，庭院裡空無一人；這裡平常總是擠滿城堡裡的貴族仕女與紳士。

File: This is highly unusual.  You begin to feel deeply disturbed, as if all is not right within the castle.
檔案: 這實在不尋常。你開始感到一陣不安，彷彿城堡裡出了什麼問題。

File: You can faintly hear a commotion in the King's Chamber to the west.
檔案: 你隱約聽見西邊國王寢宮傳來一陣騷動。

File: DOCTOR:  "There's nothing to be done."
檔案: 御醫：「已經無能為力了。」

File: DOCTOR:  "Our King's melancholy is too much for his heart to bear.  Perhaps if Sir Graham had returned with the three lost treasures of Daventry ..."
檔案: 御醫：「國王陛下的憂鬱，他的心臟已經承受不住了。若是格拉漢爵士能帶回戴凡確王國失落的三件寶物就好了……」

File: SIR GRAHAM:  "Your Highness, I am at your service."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「陛下，臣聽候差遣。」

File: KING:  "Did ... did you succeed in your quest?"
檔案: 國王：「你……你的任務成功了嗎？」

File: SIR GRAHAM:  "I did, Your Majesty."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「成功了，陛下。」

File: SIR GRAHAM:  "Here, as you commanded ..."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「這是遵照您的命令……」

File: SIR GRAHAM:  "...the magic mirror."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「……魔鏡。」

File: SIR GRAHAM:  "...the magic shield."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「……靈盾。」

File: SIR GRAHAM:  "...and the magic chest."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「……還有金盒子。」

File: KING:  "I...I am afraid it is a little too late for me.  But you have done superbly, my Knight.  As I promised, the kingdom is yours."
檔案: 國王：「我……恐怕，對我來說已經太遲了。但你的表現無比出色，我的騎士。如我所承諾的，這個王國從此屬於你。」

File: KING:  "I know you will serve her well."
檔案: 國王：「我知道你會好好守護她。」

File: DOCTOR:  "The King is dead."
檔案: 御醫：「國王駕崩了。」

File: DOCTOR:  "Long live the King!"
檔案: 御醫：「吾王萬歲！」

File: CROWD:  "Long live the King!"
檔案: 群眾：「吾王萬歲！」

File: And thus ended Sir Graham's great quest for the lost treasures of Daventry.  Despite the loss of their beloved King Edward, the people of Daventry grew happy and prosperous and flourished for years to come.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士尋找戴凡確王國失落寶物的偉大冒險，就此告一段落。儘管痛失敬愛的愛德華國王，戴凡確的百姓依然日漸富足安樂，往後多年欣欣向榮。

File: And whenever King Graham looked into his magic mirror, he saw visions of adventures yet to come...for him, for his children, and for Daventry, the land he loved so much.
檔案: 每當格拉漢國王凝視他的魔鏡，總能看見未來冒險的景象……那是屬於他、屬於他的子女，也屬於他深愛的戴凡確王國的冒險。

File: The End.
檔案: 劇終。

File: GASP!
檔案: 「倒抽一口氣！」

File: It's Sir Graham!
檔案: 「是格拉漢爵士！」

File: He's returned!
檔案: 「他回來了！」

File: Did he find the treasures?
檔案: 「他找到寶物了嗎？」

File: Shhhhhh!
Listen!
The giant is lying dead on the ground; beside him is a sturdy chest.
檔案: 巨人倒臥在地上死去，身旁擺著一只堅固的金盒子。

File: The giant is asleep, with a chest lying next to him.
檔案: 巨人正睡著，身旁擺著一只金盒子。

File: The enormous giant has been carrying that heavy chest for longer than he can remember.
檔案: 這個巨大的巨人揹著那只沉重的金盒子，久到他自己都不記得多久了。

File: The giant is lying dead on the ground, slain by a pebble to the forehead.
檔案: 巨人倒臥在地上死去，額頭中了一顆鵝卵石而喪命。

File: The huge giant has fallen asleep and is now snoring loudly.
檔案: 這個巨大的巨人睡著了，正打著響亮的呼嚕。

File: The giant is enormous!  He does look rather stupid, though.
檔案: 這個巨人真是龐大！不過看起來也挺蠢的。

File: A dead giant does not have a lot to say.
檔案: 死去的巨人沒什麼好說的。

File: It is not a good idea to wake a sleeping giant.
檔案: 叫醒沉睡的巨人可不是個好主意。

File: The giant is in no mood for talking.
檔案: 巨人沒心情說話。

File: No matter how much noise you make, you can't wake the dead!
檔案: 不管你製造多大的聲響，都叫不醒死人！

File: This giant is already awake...and he's in a bad mood!
檔案: 這個巨人已經醒了……而且心情很差！

File: Tickling a dead giant?  The thin air up here must be affecting your mind.
檔案: 搔死去的巨人癢？這裡稀薄的空氣，一定影響了你的腦子。

File: The giant isn't ticklish.  And it's a good thing for you that he isn't!
檔案: 這個巨人不怕癢，而這對你來說可是件好事！

File: Getting that close to the giant would be dangerous. Besides, you couldn't reach his weak spot.
檔案: 靠巨人那麼近太危險了。再說，你也碰不到他的弱點。

File: You don't anything sharp enough to even try that.
檔案: 你身上沒有夠鋒利的東西，連試都沒辦法試。

File: You'll need something to help you kill the giant -- if that's how you want to defeat him!
檔案: 如果你想用這種方式打倒巨人，就需要一些工具來幫你！

File: You need some kind of small rock to use the sling.
檔案: 你需要某種小石頭才能使用投石器。

File: With the giant going to sleep, it would be unnecessary and cruel to kill him.
檔案: 巨人已經睡著了，殺他既沒必要又太殘忍。

File: With what?
檔案: 用什麼？

File: If you're trying to knock out the giant, don't bother.  He's already knocked out from chasing you.
檔案: 如果你想打昏巨人，別費心了，他追你追到已經自己昏過去了。

File: Now that he's dead, the giant couldn't care less what you want to give him.
檔案: 巨人已經死了，你想給他什麼，他根本不在乎。

File: The giant does not need anything.  All he wants from you is to grind your bones to dust.
檔案: 巨人什麼都不需要，他對你唯一的念頭，就是把你的骨頭磨成粉。

File: The giant, with his chest, has all the treasure he needs; all he wants from you is to grind your bones to dust.
檔案: 巨人有了他的金盒子，該有的寶物都有了；他對你唯一的念頭，就是把你的骨頭磨成粉。

File: You have no reason to do that.
檔案: 你沒有理由這麼做。

File: You see nothing of interest on the ground.
檔案: 地上沒看到什麼有趣的東西。

File: There is a chest near the sleeping giant.
檔案: 沉睡的巨人身旁有一只金盒子。

File: On the ground near the giant is a magic chest that appears to have been fashioned from ebony and rimmed on the edges with gold.
檔案: 巨人附近的地上，擺著一只金盒子，看起來是用烏木打造，邊緣鑲著金邊。

File: The giant is carrying a chest.
檔案: 巨人身上帶著一只金盒子。

File: There is a chest near the deceased giant.
檔案: 已故巨人的身旁有一只金盒子。

File: The magic chest appears to have been fashioned from a solid block of maple and burnished to a brilliant luster.  The edges are rimmed with gold, as are the clasp and hinges.
檔案: 這只金盒子似乎是用一整塊楓木打造，並且拋光得光亮動人。邊緣鑲著金邊，扣環與鉸鏈也都是金製的。

File: The giant is protecting the magic chest.
檔案: 巨人正守護著這只金盒子。

File: The giant did a smashing job of defeating you.
檔案: 巨人這一擊，把你打得粉身碎骨，乾淨俐落。

File: Slowly, carefully, you take the chest without waking the giant.
檔案: 你小心翼翼、慢慢地拿走金盒子，沒有吵醒巨人。

File: It's easy to take a magic chest from a dead giant.
檔案: 從死去的巨人身上拿走金盒子很容易。

File: The giant squashed the life out of you.  Next time, use your sling from a distance.
檔案: 巨人把你活活壓死了。下次記得從遠處使用你的投石器。

File: Uh-oh.  You happen to be standing in the giant's favorite spot for a snooze.
檔案: 糟了。你剛好站在巨人最愛打盹的地方。

File: The giant is getting tired of looking for you.  Seems like he may be getting ready to take a nap.
檔案: 巨人找你找得累了，看樣子他可能準備要打個盹。

File: Good job!  The huge giant, tuckered out from stomping around, has fallen fast asleep.
檔案: 做得好！這個巨人到處跺步跺得筋疲力盡，已經沉沉睡去。

File: The giant cannot see you since you are invisible.
檔案: 你隱形了，巨人看不見你。

File: Fortunately, you have the magic shield with you.  It's preventing the giant from pulverizing you!
檔案: 幸好你身上帶著靈盾，它擋住了巨人，沒讓你被壓成肉泥！

File: The fairy godmother's spell is protecting you.
檔案: 教母的魔法正保護著你。

File: Talk about overkill--he's dead already!
檔案: 這也太多此一舉了——他已經死了！

File: Not when you're invisible!
檔案: 你隱形的時候可不行！

File: Now that he's asleep, he's completely harmless.  There's no reason to hurt him.
檔案: 他現在睡著了，完全沒有威脅，沒理由傷害他。

File: Not now.
檔案: 現在不行。

File: You see the entrance to a cave within the mountaintop.
檔案: 你看見山頂上有個洞穴入口。

File: It sure is dark in there!
檔案: 裡面可真暗！

File: From outside, you can see the entrance to a cave carved into the side of the mountain.
檔案: 從外面望去，你看見山壁上鑿出的一個洞穴入口。

File: This is the craggy peak of Daventry's mountain.  Amidst the rocks and boulders piled here, there's a dark opening leading into the mountain itself.
檔案: 這裡是戴凡確王國山脈嶙峋的山頂。在這堆滿岩石與巨礫之間，有個通往山內部的黑暗開口。

File: There are some truly stupendous trees up here!
檔案: 這上面有些真正巨大驚人的樹木！

File: You're on top of the clouds!
檔案: 你站在雲端之上！

File: There is a hole at the bottom of one of the trees.
檔案: 其中一棵樹的根部有個洞。

File: You can't see inside the hole from here.
檔案: 從這裡看不到洞裡面。

File: You see a slingshot in the hole.
檔案: 你看見洞裡有一把投石器。

File: The hole is empty.
檔案: 洞裡是空的。

File: What slingshot?
檔案: 什麼投石器？

File: This slingshot is made of very stretchy leather.
檔案: 這把投石器是用非常有彈性的皮革做的。

File: You reach into the hole and pull out the leather slingshot.
檔案: 你把手伸進洞裡，拉出那把皮革投石器。

File: You can't climb down the tree when you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形時沒辦法爬下這棵樹。

File: You should be able to walk on the tree trunk from here, if you're very careful!
檔案: 只要非常小心，你應該能從這裡走上樹幹！

File: Far out on a huge branch, there is a nest.
檔案: 在一根粗大的樹枝遠處，有個鳥巢。

File: Don't look down from here!  You might get dizzy and loose your footing.
檔案: 別往下看！你可能會頭暈而失足。

File: There is a perfect, shimmering golden egg lying in the nest.
檔案: 鳥巢裡躺著一顆完美無瑕、閃閃發光的金蛋。

File: You're too far away from the nest to see it clearly.
檔案: 你離鳥巢太遠，看不清楚。

File: You're looking at an empty nest.
檔案: 你看著一個空鳥巢。

File: You're not close enough to the nest.
檔案: 你離鳥巢不夠近。

File: There's nothing at all in the nest.
檔案: 鳥巢裡什麼都沒有。

File: Among the branches sits a small nest with a beautiful golden egg.
檔案: 樹枝間有個小鳥巢，裡頭放著一顆美麗的金蛋。

File: One of the birds may need it, but you won't.  Leave it alone.
檔案: 也許某隻鳥需要它，但你不需要。別動它。

File: You've already taken the only egg in the nest.
檔案: 你已經拿走了鳥巢裡唯一的蛋。

File: You carefully lift the golden egg out of the nest.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地把金蛋從鳥巢裡取出。

File: As you fall, the magic ring slips from your finger.
檔案: 你墜落時，魔戒從你的手指上滑落。

File: As soon as you entered the gingerbread house, the goat ran off.  Something sure spooked him from this place!
檔案: 你一走進薑餅屋，山羊就跑走了。這地方顯然把他嚇壞了！

File: Your ring mysteriously stops working in here.
檔案: 你的戒指在這裡莫名其妙失去了效力。

File: Off in the distance you hear a high, squeaky voice say, "I can smell someone tasty in my house."
檔案: 遠處傳來一個尖細的聲音說：「我聞到我家裡有個美味的傢伙。」

File: At the moment, it's important NOT to let the witch know you're here.
檔案: 眼下最重要的是別讓巫婆知道你在這裡。

File: Though the outside of this house was tempting, there's nothing inside that seems remotely edible.
檔案: 這間房子外觀雖然誘人，裡頭卻沒有任何看起來能吃的東西。

File: You've killed the witch!
檔案: 你殺死了巫婆！

File: There is no witch here... AT THE MOMENT!!
檔案: 這裡目前沒有巫婆……暫時沒有！！

File: Too late...she sees you, and you're in trouble.
檔案: 太遲了……她看見你了，你麻煩大了。

File: You can't kill the witch now.
檔案: 你現在沒辦法殺死巫婆。

File: There is nothing here that's worth putting in the bucket...certainly not that awful green goop.
檔案: 這裡沒有什麼值得放進水桶的東西……那攤噁心的綠色黏液肯定不算。

File: You don't have the bucket.
檔案: 你身上沒有水桶。

File: In contrast to its delightful exterior, the inside of the gingerbread house looks dark and ominous.
檔案: 和討人喜歡的外觀相反，薑餅屋內部看起來陰暗又不祥。

File: It looks like an ordinary bedroom.
檔案: 這看起來像是一間普通的臥室。

File: You can't see much from where you are.
檔案: 你從這個位置看不到什麼。

File: All you see are a few gingerbread crumbs lying on the floor of the cage.  You wonder about this.
檔案: 你只看見鐵籠地板上散落著幾片薑餅屑，讓你不禁納悶。

File: Yech!!!!
The sickening stench from the pot is everywhere.
檔案: 鍋子散發出的惡臭瀰漫四周。

File: Since there's no door here, you don't have anything to open.
檔案: 這裡沒有門，你沒有東西可以打開。

File: The bars are far too strong for you to bend.
檔案: 這些鐵欄杆太堅固了，你沒辦法弄彎。

File: It is already open.
檔案: 已經是開著的了。

File: It is already closed.
檔案: 已經是關著的了。

File: There isn't any here.
檔案: 這裡沒有。

File: The pot is hot enough to burn your hand.  The fire must have been burning for a long time.
檔案: 鍋子燙得足以燙傷你的手，這火想必已經燒了很久。

File: You briefly consider diving into the foul brew, but your desire to remain alive prevails over your rather strange inclination.
檔案: 你一度考慮跳進這鍋噁心的濃湯裡，但求生的欲望戰勝了這個奇怪的念頭。

File: You wouldn't want to sleep on a witch's bed.
檔案: 你不會想睡在巫婆的床上。

File: You may have seen a bed in the other room, but I am not sure.
檔案: 你或許在另一個房間看過一張床，但我不太確定。

File: The ring does not seem to work in the witch's house.
檔案: 戒指在巫婆的屋子裡似乎不管用。

File: Now is not a good time to try and start a conversation!
檔案: 現在不是找人聊天的好時機！

File: The witch is in the other room.
檔案: 巫婆在另一個房間。

File: This ugly old witch is one of the most hideous sights you have ever seen.  Her eyes are dark and evil, and her crooked smile twitches hungrily.  She's not to be trusted.
檔案: 這個醜陋的老巫婆，是你見過最駭人的景象之一。她的雙眼陰暗邪惡，歪斜的笑容飢渴地抽動著。她絕對信不過。

File: The fire is very, very hot.  It's best to leave it alone.
檔案: 這把火非常非常燙，最好別去碰它。

File: As the green liquid is terribly goopy, the fire must have been burning underneath it for quite some time.
檔案: 這攤綠色液體黏稠得可怕，下面的火想必已經燒了好一段時間。

File: That smoke smells... and even LOOKS evil!
檔案: 那股煙聞起來……看起來都邪惡極了！

File: The cabinet on the wall is rather plain and simple.
檔案: 牆上的櫥櫃相當樸素簡單。

File: There is nothing but a bare shelf here.
檔案: 這裡只有一個空蕩蕩的架子。

File: Sitting on the shelf is a delicious piece of Swiss cheese.
檔案: 架子上放著一塊美味的瑞士乳酪。

File: It's just a stool.
檔案: 這只是一張凳子。

File: You don't see a note here.
檔案: 你在這裡沒看到紙條。

File: Your eyes are not sharp enough to see it from here.
檔案: 你的視力不夠好，沒辦法從這裡看清楚。

File: It is written in a familiar language.
檔案: 上面寫的是你熟悉的語言。

File: You see a note on the table by the bed.
檔案: 你看見床邊的桌上有張紙條。

File: Be thankful that you are invisible or the witch may have stuck around to try and catch you!
檔案: 慶幸自己是隱形的吧，不然巫婆可能會留下來抓你！

File: Be thankful that you have a protective spell or the witch may have stuck around to try and catch you!
檔案: 慶幸自己有守護魔法吧，不然巫婆可能會留下來抓你！

File: You take the cheese from the cabinet.
檔案: 你從櫥櫃裡拿出乳酪。

File: You grab the note from the table.
檔案: 你從桌上拿起紙條。

File: Rats! She has cast some spell to keep you from escaping! The witch remarks, "Oh, how nice of you to come for dinner (cackle, cackle)!"
檔案: 糟了！她施了某種魔法讓你逃不掉！巫婆說道：「喔，你能來吃晚餐真是太好了（咯咯笑）！」

File: She looks you over carefully, then states, "You're a little too scrawny for my appetite, but I think you're going to make a lovely dessert!"
檔案: 她仔細打量你一番，然後說：「你瘦了點，不合我的胃口，不過我想你會是道美味的甜點！」

File: You need to get closer.  But be careful!
檔案: 你得靠近一點，但要小心！

File: It would be easier if you were standing.
檔案: 你站著的話會容易一些。

File: There has to be a better way to get rid of this evil old hag!
檔案: 一定有更好的辦法能除掉這個邪惡的老太婆！

File: Perhaps you could shoot her if you had a gun and a silver bullet, but you'll find neither of those items in this game. Try to find another way.
檔案: 如果你有槍和銀色子彈，或許能一槍解決她，但這款遊戲裡沒有這兩樣東西，想想別的辦法吧。

File: The witch mutters, "I am going to get my cauldron ready to cook someone for dinner (yum)."
檔案: 巫婆喃喃道：「我要去把大鍋準備好，煮個人來當晚餐（嗯，真香）。」

File: The witch mumbles, "After I get the cauldron nice and hot, I will be ready to have someone for dinner (giggle)."
檔案: 巫婆嘀咕著：「等我把大鍋燒得夠熱，就能請人來吃晚餐了（咯咯）。」

File: The witch mutters, "The cauldron is heating up nicely.  I wonder who will be my dinner guest!"
檔案: 巫婆喃喃道：「大鍋燒得正好，不知道誰會是我的晚餐貴客呢！」

File: The witch says, "My cauldron is now the perfect temperature.  It is time to invite someone for dinner (cackle, cackle)!"
檔案: 巫婆說：「我的大鍋現在溫度剛剛好，是時候邀請誰來吃晚餐了（咯咯笑）！」

File: The witch sees you!
檔案: 巫婆看見你了！

File: D..d..did you see that? Nah! You're imagining things.
檔案: 你……你剛剛看到了嗎？不會吧！是你自己在胡思亂想。

File: You can't do that while you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法這麼做。

File: You need to be a little closer for a good look.
檔案: 你得靠近一點才能看清楚。

File: That's in the other room.
檔案: 那個在另一個房間。

File: With a mighty shove, you courageously push the wicked witch into the pot.  Her wild screams are suddenly cut off as she melts away into the oily green slime in the pot.  Congratulations!
檔案: 你用力一推，勇敢地把邪惡的巫婆推進鍋裡。她狂亂的尖叫聲戛然而止，融化成鍋裡油膩的綠色黏液。恭喜你！

File: The oily green slime spilled over when you pushed the witch into the pot.
檔案: 你把巫婆推進鍋裡時，油膩的綠色黏液溢了出來。

File: The cage is made from strong, thick iron bars.  They look a little rusty, but they're solid through and through.
檔案: 這個鐵籠是用堅固厚實的鐵欄杆做成的。看起來有點生鏽，但從頭到尾都十分堅固。

File: The witch's bed looks hard and uncomfortable.
檔案: 巫婆的床看起來又硬又不舒服。

File: It is just a plain, wooden bedside table.
檔案: 這只是一張樸素的木製床頭桌。

File: It looks like there is a note lying on top of it.
檔案: 上面看起來放著一張紙條。

File: That is the table where the witch eats her food, whatever... or WHOever...that is!
檔案: 那是巫婆用餐的桌子，不管吃的是什麼東西……或者是什麼人！

File: There aren't any spider webs in here, as far as you can see.
檔案: 就你所見，這裡沒有任何蜘蛛網。

File: There is a spider web above the door.
檔案: 門的上方有張蜘蛛網。

File: You can't open that.
檔案: 你沒辦法打開那個。

File: There is a large cave here.  It continues deeper into the mountain.
檔案: 這裡有個寬敞的洞穴，向著山的更深處延伸。

File: You have come from deep inside the mountain.  There is a door here.
檔案: 你從山的深處來到這裡，這裡有扇門。

File: You'd cut your hands to ribbons trying to climb these rocky walls.
檔案: 想爬上這些岩壁，你的手會被割得傷痕累累。

File: This is a heavy oaken door set into the side of the cave.
檔案: 這是一扇嵌在洞壁上的厚重橡木門。

File: Try moving closer to the door.
檔案: 試著再靠近門一點。

File: The walkway is made from large wooden planks, attached firmly to the cave's walls and floor.
檔案: 這條步道是用粗大的木板搭成，牢牢固定在洞穴的牆壁與地面上。

File: The suspended walkway seems to wind forever down into the very bowels of the mountain.
檔案: 這條懸空步道彷彿無止盡地蜿蜒而下，通往山的最深處。

File: There is no dwarf here.
檔案: 這裡沒有矮人。

File: Suddenly, a small dwarf runs out of the shadows and approaches you.
檔案: 突然，一個矮小的矮人從陰影中衝出來，朝你走近。

File: It's a good thing you are protected by a spell.  That little dwarf likes to steal treasures.
檔案: 幸好你受到魔法保護，那個矮人最愛偷寶物了。

File: Being invisible has protected you, and your treasures, from the dwarf.
檔案: 隱形保護了你和你的寶物，沒讓矮人得逞。

File: The sneaky little dwarf came by to see what you had...but nothing caught his fancy.
檔案: 這個鬼鬼祟祟的矮人跑來看看你有什麼……但沒有一樣入得了他的眼。

File: The sneaky little dwarf caught you by surprise.  Did he steal anything from you?
檔案: 這個鬼鬼祟祟的矮人趁你不備突然出現，他有沒有偷走你什麼東西呢？

File: The walkway is made from large wooden planks, attached firmly to the cave's walls and floor, and suspended from the ceiling.
檔案: 這條步道是用粗大的木板搭成，牢牢固定在洞穴的牆壁與地面上，並從天花板懸吊而下。

File: You see the goat below you, wandering off to explore Daventry on his own.
檔案: 你看見山羊在你下方，獨自四處遊蕩探索戴凡確王國。

File: The view of Daventry from up here is stunning.  There are gently rolling hills and valleys as far as the eye can see.  Off in the distance, clouds float far above the land.
檔案: 從這裡俯瞰戴凡確王國的景色美不勝收。放眼望去盡是起伏平緩的丘陵與山谷，遠方雲朵飄浮在大地之上。

File: The goat wasn't about to risk his life climbing that huge beanstalk!  You see him wandering away.
檔案: 山羊可不打算冒著生命危險爬上那根巨大的豆莖！你看見他徑自走開了。

File: There is no goat anywhere in sight.
檔案: 放眼望去哪裡都沒有山羊。

File: Nervously, you look down. You can see the beautiful Daventry countryside spread out beneath you. However, looking down makes you a little dizzy, so you turn your attention back to the task at hand.
檔案: 你緊張地往下看，看見美麗的戴凡確王國鄉間在腳下展開。不過往下看讓你有點頭暈，於是你把注意力轉回眼前的事情上。

File: The beanstalk disappears up into the clouds.
檔案: 豆莖向上延伸，消失在雲層之中。

File: You are too high to see anything below you in detail.
檔案: 你的位置太高了，看不清楚下方的細節。

File: It is a mighty beanstalk which descends to the ground far below.
檔案: 這是一株雄偉的豆莖，一路延伸到遙遠下方的地面。

File: You are much too high to see anything below you in any detail.
檔案: 你的位置太高了，看不清楚下方的任何細節。

File: You're too busy
檔案: 你正忙著呢

File: All you can hear is the quiet drip of water from the roof of the cave.
檔案: 你只聽得見洞頂滴落的水滴聲，靜悄悄的。

File: This cave smells musty and damp.
檔案: 這個洞穴聞起來又霉又潮濕。

File: You catch a few falling drops of water in your hand, barely enough to moisten your lips.
檔案: 你用手接住幾滴落下的水，勉強夠潤濕嘴唇。

File: You don't have that! But there is enough light in this cave for you to see clearly.
檔案: 你身上沒有那個！不過這個洞穴裡的光線足夠讓你看清楚。

File: The walls of this cave are damp and moldy.
檔案: 這個洞穴的牆壁又濕又發霉。

File: The walls of this shadowy cave are too damp and steep for you to climb.
檔案: 這個陰暗洞穴的牆壁又濕又陡，你爬不上去。

File: Apparently you're getting a little lightheaded.
檔案: 看來你有點頭暈了。

File: You're not that hungry.
檔案: 你沒那麼餓。

File: You're not going to need that, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你用不到那個。

File: When you look closely, you can see that the mold on the cave walls is glowing faintly.
檔案: 你仔細一看，發現洞壁上的霉斑微微發著光。

File: These are of no use to you, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，這些對你沒有用。

File: These rock formations were slowly created over thousands of years.
檔案: 這些岩石地形是經過數千年慢慢形成的。

File: Brackish water drips slowly from the stalactites on the ceiling.
檔案: 帶著鹹味的水緩緩從天花板的鐘乳石滴落。

File: You can see the vague, shadowy outline of a tunnel leading to the south.
檔案: 你可以看見一條模糊陰暗的隧道輪廓，通往南方。

File: You can see the hole that you fell through in the roof of the cave, far above you.
檔案: 你可以看見自己摔落的那個洞口，就在頭頂遙遠的洞頂上。

File: The rocky floor of the cave is covered with rotting leaves and mold.
檔案: 洞穴的石質地面覆滿了腐爛的落葉與霉斑。

File: You are standing in a shadowy cavern. This cave is murky and damp, and smells of mold and rotted leaves.
檔案: 你站在一個陰暗的洞穴裡。這個洞穴昏暗潮濕，散發著霉味與腐葉的氣味。

File: There is a single torch on the wall, illuminating this shadowy cave.
檔案: 牆上有一支火把，照亮了這個陰暗的洞穴。

File: The farther you get from the light, the mustier it becomes.
檔案: 你離光源越遠，霉味就越重。

File: The torch is too hot to touch.
檔案: 火把太燙了，摸不得。

File: The rat grins crookedly, his long, pointed fangs glistening in the torchlight. His sense of smell alerts him of your presence.
檔案: 大老鼠咧嘴歪笑，長而尖的獠牙在火光下閃著光。牠靈敏的嗅覺察覺到你的存在。

File: The rat grins crookedly, his long, pointed fangs glistening in the torchlight.
檔案: 大老鼠咧嘴歪笑，長而尖的獠牙在火光下閃著光。

File: RAT: "That's right, mister, just walk a little closer...."
檔案: 大老鼠：「沒錯，老兄，再靠近一點……」

File: Whatever makes you think there's a rat in here?
檔案: 你怎麼會覺得這裡有隻老鼠？

File: What would you like to give the rat?
檔案: 你想給大老鼠什麼？

File: Mouse?
檔案: 老鼠？

File: RAT: "Hey, pal, this is no mouse you're talking to here!"
檔案: 大老鼠：「嘿，老兄，你面前這位可不是什麼老鼠！」

File: You see a giant rat with matted fur and dripping teeth.
檔案: 你看見一隻巨大老鼠，毛髮糾結，牙齒滴著口水。

File: Unfortunately, his teeth are larger than yours.
檔案: 可惜牠的牙齒比你的大多了。

File: RAT: "Hey, friend.  You wanna go through this door, make me an offer, and I promise I'll letcha breeze right through."
檔案: 大老鼠：「嘿，朋友。你想通過這扇門的話，給我點好處，我保證讓你輕鬆過關。」

File: RAT: "You're not fooling me with that ol' ring of invisibility trick!  I've seen that one a million times...er, I mean, I HAVEN'T seen that one a million times!  I can smell you there!
檔案: 大老鼠：「你那套隱形戒指的把戲騙不了我！這招我看過上百萬次了……呃，我是說，我才沒看過上百萬次咧！我聞得到你在那裡！

File: RAT: "Hello there, my friend.  You looking for anything in particular?"
檔案: 大老鼠：「你好啊，朋友。你在找什麼特別的東西嗎？」

File: RAT: "You wanna pass through my little door here, right?  Well, maybe we can work somethin' out.  What's it worth to you?"
檔案: 大老鼠：「你想通過我這扇小門，對吧？嗯，或許我們可以談談。你願意出多少代價？」

File: Keeping in mind the rat's remarkable agility and even more remarkable fangs, you decide not to risk an attack.
檔案: 想到大老鼠驚人的敏捷身手，還有更驚人的獠牙，你決定不冒險攻擊。

File: RAT: "I know you're gonna want what's behind this door. But what's in it for me?"
檔案: 大老鼠：「我知道你想要這扇門後面的東西。但我能得到什麼好處？」

File: Since you and all you carry are invisible, the rat can't possibly see what you're trying to show him.
檔案: 既然你和你身上帶的東西都隱形了，大老鼠根本不可能看見你想給牠看的東西。

File: The giant rat's lips quiver in anticipation at the odor of the cheese. Watch it, though, you don't want to tease this rat.
檔案: 巨鼠聞到乳酪的氣味，嘴唇興奮地顫抖著。不過小心點，你可不會想招惹這隻老鼠。

File: The rat is a dangerous character, teasing him with that might get you into trouble.
檔案: 這隻老鼠是個危險角色，拿那個逗牠可能會給你惹上麻煩。

File: You throw your last pebble at the rat, but in this dim light, you can't see well enough to hit your target.
檔案: 你朝大老鼠丟出最後一顆鵝卵石，但光線昏暗，你看不清楚，無法擊中目標。

File: You throw a pebble at the rat, but in this dim light, you can't see well enough to hit your target.
檔案: 你朝大老鼠丟出一顆鵝卵石，但光線昏暗，你看不清楚，無法擊中目標。

File: What's left to throw the pebble at?
檔案: 還有什麼東西可以丟鵝卵石？

File: You don't have anything like that in your inventory.
檔案: 你的物品欄裡沒有那樣東西。

File: You don't have a bucket of water.
檔案: 你身上沒有一桶水。

File: You aren't close enough yet.
檔案: 你還不夠靠近。

File: The rat grins, showing long, pointed teeth. "That's right, mister, just walk a little closer...."
檔案: 大老鼠咧嘴一笑，露出長而尖的牙齒。「沒錯，老兄，再靠近一點……」

File: In the dim light, your aim would suffer.  Better to find a less violent way to get past this dirty rat.
檔案: 在這昏暗的光線下，你的準頭會大打折扣。最好找個不那麼暴力的方法通過這隻髒老鼠。

File: There's no reason to do that, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，沒有理由這麼做。

File: RAT: "Come a little closer.  I can't reach it!"
檔案: 大老鼠：「再靠近一點。我搆不到！」

File: You have nothing the rat wants.
檔案: 你身上沒有大老鼠想要的東西。

File: Whaddaya tryin' to do, cheat me with that measly offering?  What an insult.
檔案: 你這是想幹嘛，用這種寒酸的東西來騙我？真是侮辱人。

File: I'm not sure who or what you want to bite.
檔案: 我不確定你想咬的是誰、或是什麼東西。

File: Who do you want to talk to?
檔案: 你想跟誰說話？

File: Who do you want to throw at?
檔案: 你想朝誰丟東西？

File: Who?
檔案: 誰？

File: When you attempt to count your fingers, you're horrified to see that your whole hand is missing!  Then you sheepishly remember your invisibility.
檔案: 你試著數自己的手指，卻驚恐地發現整隻手都不見了！接著你才不好意思地想起，自己正處於隱形狀態。

File: Amazingly enough, you still have all your fingers!
檔案: 說也神奇，你的手指一根不少！

File: You nervously count your fingers and find, to your relief, that your hand is unharmed.
檔案: 你緊張地數著手指，鬆了一口氣，發現自己的手完好無損。

File: All you can hear is the quiet drip of water from the roof of the cave and the giant rat slavering and licking his lips.
檔案: 你只聽得見洞頂滴水的靜謐聲響，還有巨鼠流著口水舔嘴唇的聲音。

File: This cave smells of mold and giant rat.
檔案: 這個洞穴聞起來又是霉味又是巨鼠的氣味。

File: Are you sure you want to do that right now?  This water looks and smells awful!
檔案: 你確定現在要這麼做嗎？這水看起來、聞起來都糟糕透了！

File: The walls of this shadowy cave are too steep for you to climb.
檔案: 這個陰暗洞穴的牆壁太陡了，你爬不上去。

File: You're kidding, right?
檔案: 你在開玩笑吧？

File: Do you really think you're going to need that on your quest, Sir Graham?
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你真的覺得這趟冒險會用到那個嗎？

File: The floor of this cave is damp with mold.
檔案: 這個洞穴的地面又濕又長滿了霉斑。

File: You are standing in a cavern, with a wooden door directly across from you. A giant mouse is standing in front of the door.
檔案: 你站在一個洞穴裡，正前方是一扇木門。一隻巨大的老鼠站在門前。

File: RAT: "Hey, I ain't no mouse, capishe?"
檔案: 大老鼠：「嘿，我才不是什麼老鼠，懂沒？」

File: You are standing in a cavern, with a wooden door directly across from you.
檔案: 你站在一個洞穴裡，正前方是一扇木門。

File: To whom do you wish to give it?
檔案: 你想把它給誰？

File: It looks like a sturdy old door.
檔案: 這看起來是一扇堅固的老舊木門。

File: Just walk over to it.
檔案: 只要走過去就行了。

File: You'll need to be much closer to do that, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你得靠得更近才能這麼做。

File: This is a big, hungry-looking rat with slavering jaws and long, sharp claws.
檔案: 這是一隻體型巨大、看起來飢餓的老鼠，下顎流著口水，還有又長又尖的爪子。

File: The rat's gigantic fangs look incredibly sharp, as if they could rip through unprotected flesh like a hot knife through butter.  His mouth waters and his lips quiver in anticipation of the meal he may make of you.
檔案: 大老鼠碩大的獠牙看起來鋒利無比，彷彿能像熱刀切奶油一樣，輕易撕裂沒有防護的血肉。牠垂涎三尺，嘴唇興奮地顫抖著，期待著把你當成一頓大餐。

File: The rat's sharp, pointed claws look as deadly as his teeth!
檔案: 大老鼠尖銳的爪子，看起來和牠的牙齒一樣致命！

File: The rat is now dripping wet.  Although he doesn't seem to mind the dampness, you haven't gotten any closer to your goal.
檔案: 大老鼠現在渾身濕透。雖然牠似乎不介意這股潮濕，但你距離目標並沒有更接近。

File: RAT: "Cheese?  Well, yeah, now that you mention it, I guess I am kinda hungry...."
檔案: 大老鼠：「乳酪？嗯，這麼一說，我好像是有點餓了……」

File: RAT: "Some sort of treasure?  Now you're talkin', mister.  Lemme see some of that treasure."
檔案: 大老鼠：「什麼寶物？這才像話嘛，老兄。讓我瞧瞧那些寶物。」

File: Using his sense of smell as a guide, the rat quickly snatches it from your hand.  You might want to count your fingers.
檔案: 大老鼠靠著嗅覺，迅速從你手中把東西搶走。你也許該數數自己的手指還在不在。

File: The rat uses his strong sense of smell as a guide and takes the treasure from your hand.
檔案: 大老鼠靠著靈敏的嗅覺，從你手中拿走了那件寶物。

File: The rat drools at the sight of the cheese, and snatches it from your hand.  You might want to count your fingers.
檔案: 大老鼠一看到乳酪就流口水，一把從你手中搶走。你也許該數數自己的手指還在不在。

File: The rat takes the treasure from your hand.
檔案: 大老鼠從你手中拿走了那件寶物。

File: Using his sense of smell to guide him, the rat attacks you. In the scuffle, your ring falls off, making you visible again.
檔案: 大老鼠靠著嗅覺攻擊你。一陣拉扯之間，你的戒指脫落，你再次現形。

File: The leprechauns' magical powers detect your unseen presence.
檔案: 地穴人的魔法察覺到你隱形的存在。

File: This is one tight squeeze the mushroom will not get you out of.
檔案: 這回的窘境，蘑菇可救不了你。

File: There are no leprechauns here.
檔案: 這裡沒有地穴人。

File: They are tiny people dressed all in green.
檔案: 他們是一群身形嬌小、渾身穿著綠衣的人。

File: This door separates the rat's warren from the domain of the Leprechaun King.
檔案: 這扇門將大老鼠的巢穴與地穴人國王的領地隔開。

File: You are in the antechamber of the Hall of the Leprechaun King.
檔案: 你站在地穴人國王大殿的前廳。

File: There are leprechauns in the room with you.
檔案: 房間裡還有其他地穴人陪著你。

File: Leave the door open.  Perhaps a draft will clear out some of the musty old rat smell.
檔案: 讓門開著吧。也許有風吹進來，能把那股老鼠的霉味散一散。

File: Unfortunately, you don't speak the language of the little folk.
檔案: 可惜你不會說這些嬌小族人的語言。

File: Don't even try it.  They're more agile than you are, and they outnumber you.
檔案: 想都別想。他們比你敏捷得多，而且人數也比你多。

File: The Leprechaun King absolutely, positively forbids violence or weapons of any sort in his throne room.  With thoughts of the sling in your mind, you seem unable to turn those thoughts into movement.
檔案: 地穴人國王絕對、明確禁止在他的王座廳內使用暴力或任何武器。儘管你心裡想著投石器，卻怎麼也無法把念頭化為行動。

File: The Leprechaun King's magic does not permit you to use weapons in the Throne Room.  Thus, while the sling is still in your pocket, you seem entirely unable to put it in your hand.
檔案: 地穴人國王的魔法不允許你在王座廳內使用武器。因此，儘管投石器還放在你的口袋裡，你卻完全無法把它拿在手上。

File: Oh, no!  Now what are you going to do?
檔案: 糟了！現在你該怎麼辦？

File: This looks like a bad situation.  Perhaps you should do something!
檔案: 情況看起來不妙。也許你該做點什麼！

File: With a genuine four-leaf clover in your possession, the leprechauns fear and respect you.  Rather than risk offending you, they decide to leave you entirely alone.
檔案: 你身上帶著一株真正的幸運草，地穴人們對你既畏懼又敬重。他們寧可完全不理你，也不願冒險冒犯你。

File: The guards catch you.  You spend the rest of your days peeling potatoes for the King of the Leprechauns.
檔案: 衛兵抓住了你。你餘生都在替地穴人國王削馬鈴薯度過。

File: You can't play the fiddle while you're invisible.
檔案: 你隱形的時候沒辦法演奏小提琴。

File: Wonderful job!  Leprechauns find fiddle music irresistible.  The moment they hear the music, they begin dancing a frenzied jig.
檔案: 做得好極了！地穴人對小提琴的樂聲毫無抵抗力。他們一聽見音樂，立刻跳起狂熱的吉格舞。

File: Finally, swept away by the snappy music, the Leprechaun guards poof right out of the room.
檔案: 最後，衛兵們被輕快的音樂沖昏了頭，一陣煙就從房間裡消失不見。

File: Carved into the top of this stone pillar is a huge four-leaf clover. Apparently the leprechauns who inhabit this underground sanctuary greatly fear and respect the power of the four-leaf clover!
檔案: 這根石柱頂端雕刻著一株巨大的幸運草。看來居住在這處地底聖殿的地穴人，對幸運草的力量既畏懼又敬重！

File: Please don't move the carpet.  It hides the Dandelion Wine stains on the floor.
檔案: 請不要移動這張地毯。它遮住了地上蒲公英酒的污漬。

File: What!?  And sit on the jewelled sceptre?!?
檔案: 什麼！？坐在那根鑲滿珠寶的王杖上？！

File: You don't have time for that, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你沒時間做那件事。

File: Eating the mushroom can get you out of a tight spot, but not at the moment.
檔案: 吃下蘑菇能讓你脫離險境，但現在還不是時候。

File: This luxurious carpet is the product of the Leprechaun's magical weaving talents.
檔案: 這張華麗的地毯，是地穴人神奇織藝的產物。

File: The King of the Leprechauns is sitting on his stone throne, sceptre in hand.
檔案: 地穴人國王坐在他的石座上，手裡握著王杖。

File: This is a rather simple stone throne, upon it sits the leprechaun kings jewelled sceptre.
檔案: 這是一座相當樸素的石座，上面放著地穴人國王那根鑲滿珠寶的王杖。

File: This is a rather simple stone throne, compared to King Edward's.
檔案: 比起愛德華國王的王座，這座石座顯得相當樸素。

File: There is no sceptre here.
檔案: 這裡沒有王杖。

File: The sceptre is fashioned from gold and silver, and accented with emeralds.
檔案: 這根王杖以金銀打造，並鑲嵌著翡翠點綴。

File: You can see a sceptre from where you are standing
檔案: 從你站的位置可以看見一根王杖。

File: The shield is made of titanium and is rimmed with jewels.
檔案: 靈盾以鈦金屬打造，邊緣鑲著珠寶。

File: You can see a shield from where you are standing.
檔案: 從你站的位置可以看見靈盾。

File: This is the throne room of the Leprechaun King.
檔案: 這裡是地穴人國王的王座廳。

File: The king has a sceptre.
檔案: 國王手裡有一根王杖。

File: The king has a sceptre and there is a shield near the throne.
