File: There is a sceptre on the throne.
檔案: 王座上放著一根王杖。

File: There is a sceptre and shield near the throne.
檔案: 王座附近有一根王杖和一面靈盾。

File: There is a shield near the throne.
檔案: 王座附近有一面靈盾。

File: The leprechaun King is not here.
檔案: 地穴人國王不在這裡。

File: By playing your fiddle,  the leprechaun King dances merrily away.
檔案: 你演奏起小提琴，地穴人國王便歡快地跳著舞離開了。

File: The King of the Leprechauns is sitting on his throne.
檔案: 地穴人國王坐在他的王座上。

File: Unfortunately, you do not speak the language of the little folk.
檔案: 可惜你不會說這些嬌小族人的語言。

File: There are no Leprechauns here to talk to.
檔案: 這裡沒有地穴人可以交談。

File: The Leprechaun King is not here.
檔案: 地穴人國王不在這裡。

File: The Leprechaun King, not understanding your words, ignores you.
檔案: 地穴人國王聽不懂你的話，沒理你。

File: You take the magic shield.  Congratulations!
檔案: 你拿到了靈盾。恭喜！

File: The Leprechaun King took his sceptre with him.
檔案: 地穴人國王把他的王杖也一起帶走了。

File: You take the Leprechaun King's jewelled sceptre.
檔案: 你拿到了地穴人國王鑲滿珠寶的王杖。

File: The Leprechaun King is just too cute to hurt.
檔案: 地穴人國王實在太可愛了，你下不了手傷害他。

File: Overhearing the fiddle music you played in the hallway, the Leprechauns have begun to dance!  As they do, they pop away in a fit of merrymaking.
檔案: 聽見你在走廊上演奏的小提琴聲，地穴人們跳起舞來！跳著跳著，他們在一陣狂歡中一個個消失無蹤。

File: The Leprechauns, sensing the power of your four-leaf clover, begin to vanish.
檔案: 地穴人們感受到你手中幸運草的力量，開始漸漸消失。

File: The King of the Leprechauns is dancing away!  Even the King enjoys a good party.
檔案: 地穴人國王也跳著舞離開了！看來就連國王也喜歡熱鬧的派對。

File: The small hole leads to the outside world.
檔案: 這個小洞通往外面的世界。

File: This is a small cave with a path on one side and a very small hole on the other side.
檔案: 這是一個小洞穴，一側有小徑，另一側有個非常小的洞。

File: The path is very steep and narrow.
檔案: 這條小徑又陡又窄。

File: Go ahead.  Walk right in.
檔案: 儘管走吧，直接走進去就行了。

File: You are much too big to fit through that small hole.
檔案: 你的身形太大了，鑽不過那個小洞。

File: If there was something of value in there, the woodcutter and his wife would not be starving to death.
檔案: 要是裡頭有什麼值錢的東西，樵夫夫妻倆就不會快餓死了。

File: The woodcutter is mildly impressed with your appearance, but he is too concerned with the plight of his poor wife to make idle chatter.
檔案: 樵夫對你的到來略感訝異，但他滿心掛念著可憐妻子的處境，沒心思閒聊。

File: The woodcutter is surprised by your sudden appearance, but quickly he recognizes you.
檔案: 樵夫被你的突然出現嚇了一跳，但很快就認出你來。

File: You have already helped the woodcutter and his wife as much as you are able.
檔案: 你已經盡你所能幫助過這對樵夫夫妻了。

File: That would be a very nice gesture.  But how do you intend to do that?
檔案: 這確實是個很好的心意，但你打算怎麼做呢？

File: The woodcutter is feeding his wife the hearty stew.  Thanks to your generosity, the woodcutter's wife will make a full recovery.  They are both very happy...and very grateful to you.
檔案: 樵夫正餵妻子喝那碗豐盛的燉肉。多虧你的慷慨，樵夫的妻子將會完全康復。他們倆都非常高興……也非常感激你。

File: The woodcutter has fed his wife the hearty stew.  Thanks to your generosity, the woodcutter's wife will make a full recovery.  They are both very happy...and very grateful to you.
檔案: 樵夫已經餵妻子喝下那碗豐盛的燉肉。多虧你的慷慨，樵夫的妻子將會完全康復。他們倆都非常高興……也非常感激你。

File: A woman is laying in bed, pale and still.  Her husband is seated on the bed, holding her hand.
檔案: 一名女子躺在床上，臉色蒼白、一動也不動。她的丈夫坐在床邊，握著她的手。

File: This house looks as shabby and tumbledown inside as it does outside, but it's surprisingly neat and tidy.  The sagging bed fills most of the room, and a fire burns cheerfully in the old stone fireplace. A large wooden table and a smaller nightstand are nearby; above the nightstand is a small cabinet.
檔案: 這間屋子裡外一樣破舊搖晃，卻出乎意料地整潔乾淨。一張下陷的床幾乎佔滿了整個房間，古老的石造壁爐裡爐火歡快地燃燒著。附近還有一張大木桌與一個較小的床頭櫃，床頭櫃上方有個小櫥櫃。

File: An earthenware pitcher sits on the nightstand.
檔案: 床頭櫃上放著一個陶製水壺。

File: The old nightstand is nothing more than a small table at the foot of the bed.
檔案: 這個老舊的床頭櫃，不過是床尾的一張小桌子罷了。

File: There are no drawers in this nightstand.
檔案: 這個床頭櫃沒有抽屜。

File: The nightstand won't be of any help to you on your quest.
檔案: 這個床頭櫃對你的冒險沒有任何幫助。

File: The woodcutter and his wife have gone to great pains to make their shabby home as neat and clean as possible.
檔案: 樵夫夫妻倆費盡心思，把這個簡陋的家打理得盡量整潔乾淨。

File: What are you going to do, dive onto the bed?  Not with the woodcutter's wife in bed, you're not!
檔案: 你打算怎麼做，撲到床上去嗎？樵夫的妻子還躺在床上呢，你不能這麼做！

File: The bed is already occupied. Neither the woodcutter nor his wife would look kindly upon your intrusion on their personal space.
檔案: 床上已經有人了。不論是樵夫還是他的妻子，都不會樂見你闖入他們的私人空間。

File: You should not steal from these poor people, Sir Graham!
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你不該偷這些窮苦人家的東西！

File: The woodcutter offered you his fiddle, which is all he can spare.  It would be unknightly to take anything else from these poor people.
檔案: 樵夫已經把他僅有的小提琴送給你了，那是他能拿得出的一切。再從這對窮苦夫妻身上拿走別的東西，有失騎士風範。

File: The woodcutter's wife is too polite to speak with her mouth full!
檔案: 樵夫的妻子嘴裡還有東西，太有禮貌了，不會邊吃邊說話！

File: The woodcutter's wife is too fatigued to speak, but you can see in her eyes that she's very grateful...and happier than she's been in a long time.
檔案: 樵夫的妻子疲憊得說不出話，但你能從她的眼神中看出，她心懷感激……也是好久以來最開心的時候。

File: The woodcutter's poor wife appears to be near death.
檔案: 樵夫可憐的妻子看起來已瀕臨死亡。

File: The woodcutter is startled by the voice that appears to come from nowhere, but quickly returns to tending his wife.
檔案: 樵夫被這彷彿憑空傳來的聲音嚇了一跳，但很快又回頭去照顧妻子。

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Please, Sir Knight, take my fiddle as a small token of thanks."
檔案: 樵夫：「騎士大人，請收下我的小提琴，聊表一點謝意。」

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Thank you, Sir Knight!"
檔案: 樵夫：「謝謝你，騎士大人！」

File: The woodcutter, still holding his wife's hand and gazing at her pale face, does not seem to hear you.
檔案: 樵夫仍握著妻子的手，凝視著她蒼白的臉，似乎沒聽見你說話。

File: It doesn't respond, but that shouldn't be surprising.
檔案: 它沒有任何反應，不過這也不奇怪。

File: with whom do you wish to talk, Sir Graham?
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你想跟誰說話呢？

File: The poor woman is too weak to even notice.
檔案: 這可憐的女子虛弱得連察覺都做不到。

File: What stew?  There is no stew in your bowl.
檔案: 什麼燉肉？你的碗裡根本沒有燉肉。

File: Move a little closer, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，再靠近一點。

File: You don't have the stew.  You were kind enough to give it away for the woodcutter wife's speedy recover.
檔案: 你身上沒有燉肉了。你早已心懷善意，把它送出去讓樵夫的妻子早日康復。

File: It would be terribly cruel to eat in front of these poor, starving people.  Your conscience prevents you from being so inconsiderate.
檔案: 在這對可憐挨餓的夫妻面前吃東西，實在太殘忍了。你的良心不允許你這麼冷酷無情。

File: You don't have one of those to give.
檔案: 你身上沒有那樣東西可以給。

File: You have already given the woodcutter a bowl filled with stew.  To help him now, you must hurry and complete your mission.
檔案: 你已經給過樵夫一碗盛滿燉肉的碗了。要繼續幫助他，你得趕緊完成你的任務。

File: The woodcutter has already given the fiddle to you. It would be rude to return it.
檔案: 樵夫已經把小提琴送給你了，把它退回去會很失禮。

File: The woodcutter gratefully accepts the walnut, but is too weak to open it.
檔案: 樵夫感激地收下了胡桃，但虛弱得打不開它。

File: The woodcutter has little use for that.
檔案: 那東西對樵夫沒什麼用處。

File: You wouldn't want to hurt them.
檔案: 你不會想傷害他們的。

File: The woodcutter's wife is in the bed, sitting up and and eating hearty stew by the spoonful.
檔案: 樵夫的妻子坐在床上，正一匙一匙地吃著豐盛的燉肉。

File: The woodcutter's wife is getting a bit of color back in her cheeks.  With your help, she'll be making a full recovery.
檔案: 樵夫的妻子臉頰漸漸恢復了些血色。有你的幫助，她將會完全康復。

File: The woodcutter's wife lies in bed.  Years of struggle and poverty have taken their toll on her; she looks much older than she really is.
檔案: 樵夫的妻子躺在床上。多年的艱苦與貧困在她身上留下了痕跡，讓她看起來比實際年齡蒼老許多。

File: The woodcutter sits on the edge of the bed, next to his wife.  Ever since the woods became too dangerous to venture into, he has not been able to earn a decent living.
檔案: 樵夫坐在床邊，陪著妻子。自從森林變得太危險、無法進入之後，他就再也無法靠正當方式謀生。

File: The woodcutter has the magic bowl you've given him; at the moment, it's filled with hot, savory stew.
檔案: 樵夫拿著你送給他的魔法碗；此刻碗裡盛滿了熱騰騰、香氣四溢的燉肉。

File: The woodcutter's most treasured possession, a fine old fiddle, lies on the table.
檔案: 桌上放著樵夫最珍視的寶貝——一把精美的老舊小提琴。

File: A large fire burns merrily in the fireplace, providing some warmth in the drafty old cottage.
檔案: 壁爐裡熊熊燃燒著旺盛的爐火，為這間四處透風的老舊小屋帶來些許暖意。

File: An old earthenware pitcher sits on the table.
檔案: 桌上放著一個老舊的陶製水壺。

File: It's empty.
檔案: 它是空的。

File: A cracked old bowl sits beside the pitcher on the table.
檔案: 桌上水壺旁放著一個裂了縫的舊碗。

File: The woodcutter speaks with joy in his voice.
檔案: 樵夫的話語中透著喜悅。

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Sir Knight, bless you!  Even now, my wife is recovering due to your kindness."
檔案: 樵夫：「騎士大人，願上天保佑你！多虧了你的善心，我妻子現在正在康復。」

File: The woodcutter speaks, his voice broken with sorrow.
檔案: 樵夫開口說話，聲音因悲傷而顫抖。

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Oh, Sir Knight, you have returned.  But I fear that my wife grows weaker still for lack of food.
檔案: 樵夫：「喔，騎士大人，你回來了。但我恐怕，我妻子因為缺乏食物，正變得更加虛弱。

File: The woodcutter speaks to you, his voice broken with sorrow.
檔案: 樵夫對你說話，聲音因悲傷而顫抖。

File: WOODCUTTER:  "We would welcome you to our home, Sir Knight, but we have had no food for so long, my beautiful wife cannot even rise from her bed.  I fear she may die soon."
檔案: 樵夫：「我們很樂意歡迎你來到我們家，騎士大人，但我們已經斷糧太久了，我美麗的妻子連下床都做不到。我怕她恐怕就快要不行了。」

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Sir Knight, an empty bowl will not help us now."
檔案: 樵夫：「騎士大人，一個空碗現在幫不了我們什麼。」

File: The woodcutter is overwhelmed with joy.
檔案: 樵夫喜極而泣。

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Thank you, thank you, Sir Knight!  We shall never forget your kindness and generosity."
檔案: 樵夫：「謝謝你，謝謝你，騎士大人！我們永遠不會忘記你的善心與慷慨。」

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Please, take my fiddle as a small token of our thanks."
檔案: 樵夫：「請收下我的小提琴，聊表我們的一點謝意。」

File: The woodcutter gratefully accepts the treasure.
檔案: 樵夫感激地收下了這件寶物。

File: The woodcutter accepts your meager gift of food.
檔案: 樵夫收下了你送來的微薄食物。

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Thank you, Sir Knight, but I fear that only a gift of food will save my poor wife from starvation."
檔案: 樵夫：「謝謝你，騎士大人，但我恐怕只有食物才能救我可憐的妻子免於餓死。」

File: WOODCUTTER:  "Thank you, Sir Knight.  This will help... for a while."
檔案: 樵夫：「謝謝你，騎士大人。這能撐一陣子……。」

File: There is a sturdy old plank table here.  The food it once held is long gone, but there appears to be a fiddle on the table.
檔案: 這裡有一張堅固的老木板桌。桌上曾經擺放的食物早已不見蹤影，但桌上似乎放著一把小提琴。

File: There is a sturdy old plank table here.  The food it once held is long gone.
檔案: 這裡有一張堅固的老木板桌。桌上曾經擺放的食物早已不見蹤影。

File: The woodcutter and his wife are on the bed.
檔案: 樵夫和他的妻子都在床上。

File: You can't do that while you're invisible, Sir Graham.
檔案: 格拉漢爵士，你隱形的時候沒辦法做這件事。

File: You see the goat far, far below you, wandering off to explore Daventry on his own.
檔案: 你看見山羊在你腳下老遠的地方，獨自漫遊，探索著戴凡確王國。

File: Shall we really begin the adventure from the very beginning?
檔案: 你真的要從頭開始這場冒險嗎？

File: Dost thou truly wish to cease our adventuring?
檔案: 汝當真欲就此終止吾等之冒險乎？

File: Use the arrow keys then enter or mouse to select option.
檔案: 使用方向鍵後按 Enter，或用滑鼠選取選項。

檔案: 簡介

檔案: 開始遊戲

File: Credits
檔案: 製作名單

File: Continue Game
檔案: 繼續遊戲

File: OUCH!
檔案: 哎呦！

File: As the wicked witch flew over her cottage, she dropped you straight through the roof and into her cage.  Who knows what sinister plans she has in store for you?
檔案: 邪惡的巫婆飛過她的小屋上空時，把你直接從屋頂扔了下去，落進她的籠子裡。天曉得她心裡正打著什麼陰險的算盤等著你？

File: You are Sir Graham, the bravest and most honorable knight in the troubled realm of Daventry.
檔案: 你是格拉漢爵士，這個多災多難的戴凡確王國中，最勇敢、最光榮的騎士。

File: King Edward the Benevolent, aged ruler of Daventry, has summoned you to the castle for reasons unknown.
檔案: 仁慈的愛德華國王，戴凡確王國年邁的統治者，召你前往城堡，理由不明。

File: CASTLE GUARD: "Greetings, Sir Graham. The King is expecting you. Allow me to escort you to His Majesty's throne room."
檔案: 城堡衛兵：「你好，格拉漢爵士。國王正等著你。請容我護送你前往陛下的王座廳。」

File: SIR GRAHAM: "Thank you, Sir Knight."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「謝謝你，騎士大人。」

File: CASTLE GUARD: "Raise the portcullis!"
檔案: 城堡衛兵：「升起閘門！」

File: SIR GRAHAM: "I am at your service, my King."
檔案: 格拉漢爵士：「臣聽候陛下差遣。」

File: KING EDWARD: "I am an old man, Sir Graham.  Perhaps too old to carry the weight of this crown."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「格拉漢爵士，朕已年邁，或許已老得扛不動這頂王冠的重量了。」

File: KING EDWARD: "My bones ache, my hands tremble.  I'm afraid my time on Earth grows short."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「朕骨頭作痛，雙手顫抖。恐怕在世的時日已經不多了。」

File: KING EDWARD: "But enough about me."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「不過，朕的事就先說到這裡。」

File: KING EDWARD: "Great misfortunes have befallen Daventry since the loss, years ago, of three magical treasures."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「多年前，三件魔法寶物遺失以來，戴凡確王國便屢遭大難。」

File: KING EDWARD: "I have chosen you, the finest knight in all of Daventry, to search for these lost treasures."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「朕選中了你——戴凡確王國最出色的騎士——去尋回這些失落的寶物。」

File: KING EDWARD: "Only then can this kingdom be restored to its former glory."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「唯有如此，這個王國才能恢復昔日的榮光。」

File: KING EDWARD: "And only then may I rest with the knowledge that my people are safe."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「也唯有如此，朕才能安心，知道子民都平安無事。」

File: KING EDWARD: "The first treasure is a magic mirror that foretells the future."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「第一件寶物，是一面能預知未來的魔鏡。」

File: KING EDWARD: "The second is a magical shield that protects the bearer from all mortal harm."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「第二件，是一面能護持配戴者免受一切致命傷害的靈盾。」

File: KING EDWARD: "The third and last is an enchanted chest that is forever filled with gold."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「第三件，也是最後一件，是一個永遠裝滿黃金的魔法金盒子。」

File: KING EDWARD: "I know that what I ask is difficult ...nay, perhaps impossible.  The dangers are many."
檔案: 愛德華國王：「朕明白這個請求十分艱難……不，或許根本是不可能的任務。危險重重。」

File: KING EDWARD: "But you are brave and pure of heart.  That is why I chose you to volunteer."

檔案: 山羊不想沿著繩索滑下去。

File: The goat is afraid of heights and refuses to jump down the well.
檔案: 山羊有懼高症，不肯跳下井去。

File: Carefully... Oh no!  The sides were too slippery... you've fallen into the well!
檔案: 小心翼翼……噢不！井壁太滑了……你掉進井裡了！

File: Somebody has cut the rope;  there's no way for you to get the bucket to the well's bottom.
檔案: 有人把繩索割斷了，你沒辦法把水桶弄到井底去。

File: Sorry, all the water is at the bottom of the well.
檔案: 抱歉，所有的水都在井底。

File: The long piece of rope falls to the bottom of the well.
檔案: 那條長繩落到了井底。

File: There is no useful rope left to cut.
檔案: 已經沒有可用的繩索可以割了。

File: There is no useful rope to get.
檔案: 沒有可用的繩索可以拿。

File: You should be more careful the next time you try  climbing ropes.
檔案: 下次爬繩索時你應該更小心一點。

File: There is not enough rope left to lower.
檔案: 剩下的繩索不夠放下去了。

File: Look out for that wolf -- he can run very fast!   Don't let him catch you!
檔案: 小心那隻狼——牠跑得非常快！別讓牠追上你！

File: You are very fortunate that your protective spell is still working.
檔案: 算你走運，你的守護魔法還在發揮作用。

File: Fortunately, you are invisible and the wolf can't see you.
檔案: 幸好你是隱形的，狼看不見你。

File: The wolf sees that menacing goat by your side and decides to keep his distance.
檔案: 狼看見你身旁那隻兇猛的山羊，便決定保持距離。

File: You, fortunately, have the magic shield which will protect you.
檔案: 幸好你有靈盾保護著你。

File: Yes, it's a wolf and it's very fast.  Now do something!
檔案: 沒錯，是一隻狼，而且跑得非常快，快做點什麼！

File: You don't have time to do that right now!
檔案: 你現在沒時間做那件事！

File: It seems the wolf caught up with you and is discussing dinner arrangements.
檔案: 看來狼追上你了，正在盤算晚餐的安排。

File: Are you crazy?
檔案: 你瘋了嗎？

File: There's no wolf here.
檔案: 這裡沒有狼。

File: Now that the goat is gone, you'll have to take care of yourself!
檔案: 山羊已經不在了，你得自己保護自己了！

File: The wolf is in no mood for conversion.
檔案: 狼沒心情跟你聊天。

File: This is a very pretty maple tree.
檔案: 這是一棵非常漂亮的楓樹。

File: This is a very large oak tree with branches stretching to the sky.
檔案: 這是一棵非常高大的橡樹，枝椏伸向天際。

File: You can't climb a tree here!
檔案: 你在這裡沒辦法爬樹！

File: This tree is too hard to climb.
檔案: 這棵樹太難爬了。

File: OK
檔案: 好

File: There is a very large oak tree here with branches stretching to the sky.
檔案: 這裡有一棵非常高大的橡樹，枝椏向天空伸展。

File: This is a relatively low, rustic stone fence which runs along the left and rear sides of the garden.
檔案: 這是一道相對低矮、質樸的石牆，沿著花園的左側和後側延伸。

File: There is no reason to climb the fence.
檔案: 沒有理由要爬這道圍籬。

File: You can go around the fence.
檔案: 你可以繞過這道圍籬。

File: You do not have a carrot to eat.
檔案: 你身上沒有胡蘿蔔可以吃。

File: You see an old stone wall surrounding a well kept garden.
檔案: 你看見一道古老的石牆，圍繞著一座整理得很好的花園。

File: This is a neat little carrot patch.  The plump carrots  look tempting.
檔案: 這是一小片整齊的胡蘿蔔園，飽滿的胡蘿蔔看起來十分誘人。

File: It is a relatively low, native stone and masonry fence to the right and rear of a garden.
檔案: 這是一道相對低矮的天然石砌圍籬，位於花園的右側和後側。

File: You pluck a delicious looking carrot from the fertile soil.
檔案: 你從肥沃的土壤裡拔起一根看起來美味的胡蘿蔔。

File: They are buried in the ground.  You must get closer to see them.
檔案: 它們埋在地底下，你得靠近一點才能看清楚。

File: You cannot do that from here.
檔案: 你在這裡沒辦法這麼做。

File: You carefully fill the bucket with water.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地把水桶裝滿了水。

File: This is a clear mountain lake with some steep cliffs surrounding it.
檔案: 這是一座清澈的山中湖泊，四周環繞著陡峭的懸崖。

File: Wandering on the banks of the lake, you see a cute little elf.
檔案: 你在湖畔漫步，看見一個可愛的小精靈。

File: The cold water gushes into the old bucket.
檔案: 冰冷的水湧進了那個舊水桶。

File: There is nothing to compare with that refreshing taste.
檔案: 沒有什麼比得上那沁涼的滋味。

File: There is a very pretty lake nearby with a small little elf running along its shore.
檔案: 附近有一座非常美麗的湖泊，一個嬌小的小精靈正沿著湖岸奔跑。

File: This is a small elf.  He looks very friendly.
檔案: 這是一個嬌小的小精靈，看起來十分友善。

File: There's no elf here.
檔案: 這裡沒有小精靈。

File: The elf, impressed by your friendliness, gives you a magic ring.  "Kind person, know that once, only once, this ring will make you invisible," he says and then disappears.
檔案: 小精靈被你的友善打動，送你一枚魔戒。他說：「善良的人啊，記住，這枚戒指只能讓你隱形一次，僅僅一次。」說完便消失無蹤。

File: The elf has left since you were not very cordial to him.
檔案: 由於你對他不夠親切，小精靈已經離開了。

File: There is a clear mountain lake and some trees here.
檔案: 這裡有一座清澈的山中湖泊和幾棵樹。

File: It is a huge wooden door built right into the bottom of a small mountain!  It has a large keyhole.
檔案: 這是一扇巨大的木門，直接嵌建在一座小山的山腳下！門上有一個大鎖孔。

File: You can't fool me!  You don't have a key.
檔案: 你騙不了我！你身上沒有鑰匙。

File: The door is already unlocked.
檔案: 這扇門已經解鎖了。

File: Using the gold key, you unlock the huge door.
檔案: 你用金鑰匙打開了這扇巨大的門。

File: The door is already locked.
檔案: 這扇門已經鎖上了。

File: You lock the massive door with the heavy gold key.
檔案: 你用那把沉重的金鑰匙把這扇巨大的門鎖上了。

File: You need a key to do that.
檔案: 你需要一把鑰匙才能這麼做。

File: You strike the door with all your might!  To no avail.
檔案: 你使盡全力猛擊這扇門！卻毫無用處。

File: There aren't many keyholes in the ground here.
檔案: 這裡的地上沒有幾個鎖孔。

File: There seems to be a door built into the mountainside.
檔案: 山腰上似乎有一扇門。

File: There is no need to unlock an already open door.
檔案: 門已經開著了，沒有必要解鎖。

File: You need to close the door before you can lock it.
檔案: 你得先把門關上，才能把它鎖上。

File: The door is already open.
檔案: 這扇門已經開著了。

File: You fill up your bucket with sparkling water.
檔案: 你把水桶裝滿了晶瑩的水。

File: This is a small alpine lake.
檔案: 這是一座小小的高山湖泊。

File: It's a witch swooping through the sky... She's trying to catch you!  Look out!
檔案: 是一個巫婆從天而降……她想抓住你！小心！

File: There is a witch in the area, but since you have that menacing goat with you, she will keep her distance.
檔案: 這一帶有巫婆出沒，但因為你帶著那隻凶猛的山羊，她會保持距離。

File: There is a witch in the area, but with the shield no harm will come to you.
檔案: 這一帶有巫婆出沒，但有了靈盾，你不會受到任何傷害。

File: Jumping here would put you in even greater danger from that witch!
檔案: 在這裡跳躍會讓你陷入那個巫婆帶來的更大危險之中！

File: Your protection is gone and you best look out for the witch!
檔案: 你的防護已經消失了，最好小心那個巫婆！

File: With the goat now dead, you are fair game for the witch.
檔案: 山羊已經死了，你現在成了巫婆眼中的獵物。

File: There's no witch here.
檔案: 這裡沒有巫婆。

File: There is no way to kill a flying witch!
檔案: 沒有辦法殺死一個會飛的巫婆！

File: The witch swoops down, grabs you by the neck, and carries you off to a fate worse than death.
檔案: 巫婆俯衝而下，一把抓住你的脖子，把你帶去承受比死更慘的下場。

File: The witch missed you, this time.
檔案: 這一次，巫婆沒抓到你。

File: The witch can feel your protective spell and bids a hasty retreat.
檔案: 巫婆感應到你身上的守護魔法，匆忙撤退了。

File: Lucky for you that you are invisible, the witch can't find you.
檔案: 幸好你是隱形的，巫婆找不到你。

File: There is no way you can now.
檔案: 你現在沒辦法這麼做。

File: There is no reason to jump now.
檔案: 現在沒有理由要跳。

File: Oh NO!!  She's back!!!
檔案: 喔不！！她回來了！！！

File: High up in the sky you see a very large, friendly bird.
檔案: 你看見天空高處有一隻非常巨大、友善的鳥。

File: This is a big condor.  Its graceful flight appears effortless.
檔案: 這是一隻大兀鷲，牠的飛行姿態優雅、毫不費力。

File: There is no bird.
檔案: 這裡沒有鳥。

File: The bird is too high to kill.  Besides, it looks like a nice bird.
檔案: 這隻鳥飛得太高了，殺不到。再說，牠看起來是隻善良的鳥。

File: You would hit your head on the top of the cave if you jumped now!
檔案: 你要是現在跳起來，會撞到洞穴頂部！

File: High up in the sky you see a very large, friendly bird, but it is afraid to come near you because of the goat.
檔案: 你看見天空高處有一隻非常巨大、友善的鳥，但因為那隻山羊，牠不敢靠近你。

File: Where could this giant bird be taking you?
檔案: 這隻巨鳥會把你帶到哪裡去呢？

File: This bird doesn't talk much.
檔案: 這隻鳥不太愛說話。

File: The clear mountain water pours into the bucket.
檔案: 清澈的山泉水注入了水桶。

File: Ahhh!  That water sure hit the spot!
檔案: 啊～那口水喝得真是暢快！

File: You see the mountains and trees reflected in the mirror-like water.
檔案: 你看見群山與樹木倒映在如鏡般的水面上。

File: These cattails look soft and fuzzy.
檔案: 這些香蒲看起來又軟又毛茸茸的。

File: There is a small patch of clover under the tree.
檔案: 樹下有一小片三葉草。

File: Off in the distance you see a patch of clover.
檔案: 在遠處，你看見一片三葉草叢。

File: You already have the only four-leaf clover here.
檔案: 你已經拿到這裡唯一的幸運草了。

File: The clover is soft, yet you sense a strange strength in it.
檔案: 這株幸運草很柔軟，但你感覺到它裡頭蘊藏著一股奇異的力量。

File: You really don't want any of the three-leaf clovers.
檔案: 你其實不會想要任何三葉草。

File: You had, and lost, the only four-leaf clover  around.  You really don't want a three-leaf clover.
檔案: 你原本擁有這附近唯一的幸運草，卻弄丟了。你其實不會想要一株三葉草。

File: There is a clover patch in this meadow.
檔案: 這片草地上有一片三葉草。

File: As you start to cross the bridge, a wretched troll appears.
檔案: 你正要走上橋時，一個可惡的矮精靈出現了。

File: It is a well known fact that goats hate trolls intensely. You should move aside and let the goat take care of this nasty troll.
檔案: 眾所皆知，山羊對矮精靈恨之入骨。你應該讓到一旁，讓山羊去對付這隻討厭的矮精靈。

File: This is the ugliest, meanest troll I have ever seen.
檔案: 這是我見過最醜陋、最兇惡的矮精靈。

File: This troll is a real fighter.  Better not even try it.
檔案: 這隻矮精靈很能打，你最好想都別想。

File: Fortunately for you, you have nothing to kill the  troll with.
檔案: 算你幸運，你身上沒有能殺死矮精靈的東西。

File: The troll demands a treasure for passage across his bridge.
檔案: 矮精靈要求你交出一件寶物，才准你通過他的橋。

File: You throw the dagger and the old -- but quick -- troll catches it.  Now what are your plans?
檔案: 你擲出短刀，那隻上了年紀卻手腳俐落的矮精靈接住了它。你現在打算怎麼辦？

File: You push the troll as hard as you can but he doesn't budge an inch.
檔案: 你使盡全力推那隻矮精靈，可惜他紋風不動。

File: The troll has a heart of stone.
檔案: 這隻矮精靈鐵石心腸。

File: The troll appears to be upset about your attempt to cross his bridge.
檔案: 矮精靈似乎對你試圖跨過他的橋感到不悅。

File: Trolls have bad hearing, so you will have to get closer.
檔案: 矮精靈的聽力不好，你得再靠近一點。

File: You throw, and lose the dagger.
檔案: 你擲了出去，短刀就這麼弄丟了。

File: There is no troll around here.
檔案: 這附近沒有矮精靈。

File: What type of treasure would you like to give the old troll?
檔案: 你想給這隻老矮精靈什麼樣的寶物？

File: You have no treasure to give the troll.
檔案: 你沒有寶物可以給矮精靈。

File: You can't give it if you don't have it.
檔案: 你沒有的東西，沒辦法給人。

File: The troll doesn't want just a plain walnut.
檔案: 矮精靈才不要一顆普通的胡桃。

File: You are not close enough to the river.
檔案: 你離河邊不夠近。

File: This is an old, rickety bridge.
檔案: 這是一座老舊、搖搖欲墜的橋。

File: This placid looking stream is actually quite dangerous... the current is stronger than it looks.  You can't keep your head above water.
檔案: 這條看似平靜的溪流其實相當危險……水流比看起來湍急得多。你的頭沒辦法一直露出水面。

File: The troll greedily grabs the treasure and disappears  under the bridge.
檔案: 矮精靈貪婪地一把抓過寶物，消失在橋下。

File: The goat butts the troll right off the bridge, never to be seen in these parts again.
檔案: 山羊一頭把矮精靈頂下橋，從此再也沒人在這一帶見過他。

File: You could never win a fight with a troll.
檔案: 你不可能打贏矮精靈。

File: As you start to cross the bridge, a wretched troll appears.  Even though you are invisible, he will not let you cross his bridge.
檔案: 你正要走上橋時，一個可惡的矮精靈出現了。即使你是隱形的，他也不會讓你跨過他的橋。

File: This placid looking stream is actually quite dangerous.... the current is stronger than it looks.  You can't keep your head above water.
檔案: 這條看似平靜的溪流其實相當危險……水流比看起來湍急得多。你的頭沒辦法一直露出水面。

File: The bank is too steep to allow access to the river's edge.
檔案: 河岸太陡了，沒辦法靠近河邊。

File: It is old and rotted.
檔案: 它又老舊又腐朽。

File: There is an attractive meadow dotted with trees.
檔案: 這裡有一片迷人的草地，點綴著幾棵樹。

File: It is just a hole in an empty, old stump.
檔案: 那只是一個空心老樹樁上的洞。

File: What are you doing that for?  There's nothing here.
檔案: 你這麼做是為了什麼？這裡什麼也沒有。

File: You must be getting nervous!  I see no witch here!
檔案: 你一定是緊張過頭了！我在這裡沒看到什麼巫婆！

File: The windows are made from translucent, hardened sugar.  It's difficult to see through them.
檔案: 這些窗戶是用半透明的硬糖做成的，很難透過它們看清楚。

File: The windows are hard to break.
檔案: 這些窗戶很難打破。

File: This is the sweetest little gingerbread house you ever saw.  The walls are cake, the roof is frosting, the chimney looks delicious, and the candy path and cookie fence are unbearably tempting!
檔案: 這是你見過最甜美的小薑餅屋。牆壁是蛋糕做的，屋頂是糖霜，煙囪看起來也是美味可口，糖果小徑和餅乾圍籬更是誘人得讓人受不了！

File: The house looks tempting, but you need to get closer.
檔案: 這間房子看起來很誘人，但你得靠近一點。

File: The goat is suspicious of this witch's house and  refuses to go in.
檔案: 山羊對這間巫婆的房子起了疑心，不肯進去。

File: The door is made from graham crackers held together  with chocolate drop nails.
檔案: 這扇門是用全麥餅乾做的，用巧克力豆當釘子固定住。

File: The path is around the corner.
檔案: 小徑在轉角那邊。

File: Be careful!  Nearby is a sorcerer.  His mystical powers can leave you immobilized and helpless!
檔案: 小心！附近有個巫師。他的神秘力量能讓你動彈不得、無力反抗！

File: The magic shield will protect you from this dangerous  sorcerer.
檔案: 靈盾能保護你免受這個危險巫師的傷害。

File: You're so afraid of the sorcerer that your knees are locked.
檔案: 你太害怕這個巫師了，雙腳都僵住動不了。

File: This sorcerer exudes mystery and danger.
檔案: 這個巫師散發著神秘又危險的氣息。

File: There's no sorcerer here.
檔案: 這裡沒有巫師。

File: The sorcerer casts a spell, freezing you to the spot. I hope no dangerous creatures drop by!
檔案: 巫師施了一道法術，把你定在原地動彈不得。希望別有什麼危險的生物剛好經過！

File: The sorcerer's spell has expired; now you can move  again.  Whew!
檔案: 巫師的法術已經失效了，你現在又能動了。呼！

File: You are immobilized!  You can't jump or duck now!
檔案: 你被定住了！現在沒辦法跳躍或蹲下！

File: OK.  But you just lost your dagger.
檔案: 好吧。不過你剛剛弄丟了短刀。

File: The sorcerer only speaks in the language of the Mystics.
檔案: 這個巫師只說神秘族的語言。

File: This sorcerer's magic is no match for your fairy godmother's.
檔案: 這個巫師的法力比不上你教母的法力。

File: The sorcerer sees the goat and decides to leave.
檔案: 巫師看見那隻山羊，決定離開。

File: Being invisible has protected you from this sorcerer.
檔案: 隱形保護了你，讓這個巫師傷不到你。

File: These are some of the finest walnuts you have ever seen.
檔案: 這些是你見過最上等的胡桃。

File: You look around and decide these plain walnuts won't do. You want a gold walnut!
檔案: 你環顧四周，覺得這些普通的胡桃不合用。你要的是金胡桃！

File: You pluck a nice walnut from the tree.
檔案: 你從樹上摘下一顆漂亮的胡桃。

File: They are very small and hard to see from here.
檔案: 它們很小，從這裡很難看清楚。

File: The walnuts are over by the walnut tree.
檔案: 胡桃就在那棵胡桃樹旁邊。

File: This is a very colorful ceramic bowl.
檔案: 這是一個色彩繽紛的陶碗。

檔案: 你撿起了那個陶碗。

File: It looks like an interesting, colorful bowl.
檔案: 這看起來是個有趣又色彩繽紛的碗。

File: That is impossible from here.
檔案: 在這裡辦不到那件事。

File: There may have been a bowl here at one time, but it is not here now!
檔案: 這裡曾經有過一個碗，但現在已經不在了！

File: Oh No!  That's such a dangerous river... the current is too strong... you won't be able to escape!
檔案: 糟了！這是條危險的河流……水流太強……你逃不掉的！

File: The bank is dangerously steep;  there are safer ways to  reach water.
檔案: 河岸陡峭危險；還有更安全的方法可以取水。

File: This is a Raging River filled with boulders and rapids.
檔案: 這是怒河，河中滿是巨石與急流。

File: You carefully fill the bucket at the river's edge.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地在河邊把水桶裝滿。

File: You drink deeply of the cold river water.
檔案: 你大口暢飲冰冷的河水。

File: You are not close enough to the Raging River.
檔案: 你離怒河不夠近。

File: Your swimming attempt proved fatal!  The raging current drags you under....
檔案: 你這次游泳嘗試要了你的命！洶湧的水流把你拖入水底……

File: The river is dangerous and powerful.  There is a delta of pebbles on its edge.
檔案: 這條河既危險又湍急，岸邊有一片鵝卵石灘。

File: As you fill the bucket, the river almost rips it from your grasp.
檔案: 你裝水時，河水幾乎把水桶從你手中扯走。

File: The pebbles are round and smooth.
檔案: 這些鵝卵石又圓又光滑。

File: You must venture closer to the river.
檔案: 你得再靠近河流一些。

File: The only pebbles worth getting are already gone.
檔案: 值得撿的鵝卵石都已經被拿走了。

File: From here it looks like an ordinary delta of pebbles.
檔案: 從這裡看，這只是一片普通的鵝卵石灘。

File: Your swimming attempt proved fatal!  The raging current drags you under... you are lost....
檔案: 你這次游泳嘗試要了你的命！洶湧的水流把你拖入水底……你就此消逝……

File: There are many smooth pebbles next to the river.
檔案: 河邊有許多光滑圓潤的鵝卵石。

File: There is a small dwarf close by.  It would be a good idea to be careful.
檔案: 附近有個小矮人，你最好小心一點。

File: That little dwarf caught you by surprise.  Is your treasure still OK?
檔案: 那個小矮人偷襲了你一下，你的寶物還在嗎？

File: The quick, little dwarf came by to see what you had -- nothing interested him.
檔案: 動作靈巧的小矮人湊過來看看你身上有什麼——結果什麼都沒引起他的興趣。

File: Dwarfs are quick, little guys who will try to take your treasure.
檔案: 矮人們動作靈巧、身形嬌小，總想搶走你的寶物。

File: He's too quick for you to catch.
檔案: 他的動作太快，你根本抓不到。

File: No time to talk to him.  He's in too much of a hurry!
檔案: 沒時間跟他說話，他趕著要走呢！

File: The dwarf sees the goat and decides to leave.
檔案: 矮人看見山羊，決定離開。

File: Being invisible has protected you from the dwarf.
檔案: 隱形保護了你和你的寶物，沒讓矮人得逞。

File: When looking in this small hole, you see a faint green glow.
檔案: 你往這個小洞裡望去，看見一絲微弱的綠光。

File: Very cautiously, you reach into the hole, and to your dismay, find nothing.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地把手伸進洞裡，卻讓你失望的是，裡頭什麼也沒有。

File: From here it looks like a typical, large rock.
檔案: 從這裡看，這只是一塊普通的大石頭。

File: There are several pretty trees in the area and a few rocks.  One rock has a small hole in its base.
檔案: 這一帶有幾棵漂亮的樹木和幾塊岩石，其中一塊岩石的底部有個小洞。

File: You feel a stretching sensation... Oh, you're back to your original size.  You can't get out of the small  cave!
檔案: 你感覺到一陣拉伸感……啊，你恢復原本的大小了。你沒辦法從這個小洞穴裡出去！

File: One rock has a small hole in its base.
檔案: 有塊岩石的底部有個小洞。

File: You notice a hole in the base of a large moss covered rock.
檔案: 你注意到一塊布滿青苔的大岩石底部有個洞。

File: The bucket fills with the somewhat swampy water.
檔案: 水桶裝滿了帶點沼澤氣息的水。

File: In your thirst, even swamp water is satisfying.
檔案: 你渴得厲害，就連沼澤水喝起來都很滿足。

File: This lake looks refreshing, but a little swampy.
檔案: 這座湖看起來清涼宜人，但帶點沼澤氣息。

File: This is a very interesting tree, growing in the middle of the lake.
檔案: 這棵樹長在湖中央，十分有意思。

File: What a pretty bed of wild flowers.
檔案: 好一片美麗的野花花圃。

File: It would be a shame to pick the lovely wild flowers.
檔案: 摘下這些可愛的野花實在太可惜了。

File: As you approach the bridge, a mean, ugly troll appears and refuses to let you cross his bridge.
檔案: 你走近橋邊，一隻凶惡醜陋的矮精靈突然出現，不准你踏上他的橋。

File: Caution and steep banks advise against getting water here.
檔案: 河岸陡峭危險，最好別在這裡取水。

File: You are too far from the river.
檔案: 你離河流太遠了。

File: The wooden bridge is old and weather beaten.
檔案: 這座木橋又老又飽經風霜。

File: The stream may not be safe to cross.
檔案: 這條溪流可能不太安全，不宜涉水而過。

File: Do you really think you can do that?
檔案: 你真的以為自己做得到嗎？

File: Fortunately for you, you have no way to do that.
檔案: 算你走運，你根本沒辦法這麼做。

File: You throw the dagger and the quick old troll catches it.
檔案: 你擲出短刀，動作敏捷的老矮精靈一把接住。

File: You push the troll as hard as you can; he won't budge.
檔案: 你使盡全力推那隻矮精靈，他卻紋風不動。

File: Trools have no sympathy.
檔案: 矮精靈可沒有同情心。

File: There may be something trollish around, but you're not close enough to do anything about it.
檔案: 附近或許有什麼與矮精靈有關的東西，但你離得不夠近，做不了什麼。

File: You throw the dagger and it lands in the stream, lost forever.
檔案: 你擲出短刀，短刀落入溪流，永遠消失了。

File: I don't see a troll.
檔案: 你沒看見矮精靈。

File: Is there a troll?
檔案: 這裡有矮精靈嗎？

File: To what?
檔案: 給什麼？

File: What precious treasure would you like to give to the  old troll?
檔案: 你想把哪件珍貴的寶物送給那隻老矮精靈？

File: If you don't have it, how can you give it to the troll?
檔案: 你身上沒有它，要怎麼交給那隻矮精靈？

File: The troll grabs the treasure and vanishes.
檔案: 矮精靈抓起寶物，瞬間消失無蹤。

File: It seems to me that by now you would have learned to be more careful.  You are stuck in the mud at the bottom of this river and sinking fast.
檔案: 看來事到如今，你早該學乖、更加小心才是。你陷進河底的泥沼裡，正迅速下沉。

File: You see a crotchety old gnome pacing around his lean-to.
檔案: 你看見一個脾氣古怪的老侏儒矮人，正在他的窩棚附近踱步。

File: That is very close but not quite right!
檔案: 非常接近了，但還不完全正確！

File: You have the right idea, but your thinking is just a little bit off.
檔案: 你的想法沒錯，只是差了那麼一點點。

File: That's right!!!  You've guessed it!!  Here are some magic beans for your outstanding accomplishment!
檔案: 答對了！！！你猜中了！！這是給你的魔豆，獎勵你這番出色的成就！

File: The old gnome tells you he has something that may be very useful to you.  Your task is to guess his name in three guesses and his gift will be yours.  Good luck!  What is your first guess?
檔案: 老侏儒矮人告訴你，他有樣東西也許對你很有用。你的任務是在三次機會內猜中他的名字，猜中禮物就是你的。祝你好運！你的第一個猜測是什麼？

File: You still haven't guessed my name!
檔案: 你還沒猜中我的名字呢！

File: The gnome is old and bent under the weight of years, but a playful wisdom still brightens his eyes.
檔案: 這個侏儒矮人年事已高、被歲月壓彎了腰，但眼中仍閃著一絲頑皮的智慧光芒。

File: They look like beans.  Interesting.
檔案: 看起來像豆子，真有意思。

File: It is a heavy, gold, skeleton key.
檔案: 這是一把沉甸甸的萬能金鑰匙。

File: It would be unwise to kill a gnome.
檔案: 殺害侏儒矮人可不是明智之舉。

File: Being careful that you get every one of them, you place the beans in your pocket.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地一顆不漏，把豆子全放進口袋裡。

File: It is heavy and cold.
檔案: 它又沉又冰冷。

File: The gnome can't hear you from there.
檔案: 你站在那裡，侏儒矮人聽不見你說話！

File: You should get a little closer.
檔案: 你應該再靠近一點。

File: There are no beans here.
檔案: 這裡沒有豆子。

File: The key to your problems is elsewhere.
檔案: 能解決你問題的鑰匙不在這裡。

File: There is no gnome here.
檔案: 這裡沒有侏儒矮人。

File: That's too far away.
檔案: 那太遠了。

File: Where did you get that idea?  That's not even close!
檔案: 你這想法是打哪來的？差得遠呢！

File: You know that's not right!
檔案: 你自己也知道那不對！

File: What is your next guess?
檔案: 你的下一個猜測是什麼？

File: You didn't guess the gnome's name, but he left you a gold key anyway.  Better luck next time!
檔案: 你沒猜中侏儒矮人的名字，但他還是留了一把金鑰匙給你。祝你下次好運！

File: There is no place to safely get a drink.
檔案: 這裡沒有能安全喝水的地方。

File: There is no place to safely get water.
檔案: 這裡沒有能安全取水的地方。

File: You slip down the bank into the river far below.  Your cries for help are not heard.
檔案: 你從河岸滑落，跌進下方遙遠的河水裡。你的呼救聲沒人聽見。

File: The gnome's lean-to doesn't look very sturdy.
檔案: 侏儒矮人的窩棚看起來不太堅固。

File: As you approach the bridge, a mean, ugly troll appears.  He will not let you cross his bridge.
檔案: 你走近橋邊，一隻凶惡醜陋的矮精靈出現了。他不准你踏上他的橋。

File: The old goat seeing the troll, the archenemy of all goats, charges the troll and butts him into oblivion!  The bridge is now yours.
檔案: 老山羊一看見矮精靈——山羊們的頭號宿敵——立刻朝他猛衝過去，一頭把他撞得魂飛魄散！這座橋現在是你的了。

File: This bridge is the only way to cross the river here.
檔案: 這座橋是這裡唯一能過河的路。

File: The river runs swiftly between steep banks.
檔案: 河水在陡峭的兩岸之間湍急流動。

File: Don't do it!  The bank is steep, muddy, and dangerous.
檔案: 別這麼做！河岸又陡又泥濘，十分危險。

File: You can't reach the river from here.
檔案: 你在這裡搆不到河流。

File: This troll is big, strong, and mean-looking.  Don't mess with this troll!
檔案: 這隻矮精靈體型高大、力氣過人，看起來凶惡無比。別去招惹他！

File: It's just about impossible to kill a troll.
檔案: 要殺死矮精靈幾乎是不可能的事。

File: It's lucky you don`t have any way to try that!
檔案: 算你走運，你根本沒辦法試試看！

File: He demands a treasure for passage across his bridge.
檔案: 他要求你獻上寶物，才准你過橋。

File: The dagger sings through the air... to a perfect catch by the troll.  "Nice dagger, but it ain't no treasure!" he growls.
檔案: 短刀劃破空氣飛出……穩穩落入矮精靈手中。他咆哮道：「短刀是不錯，可這不算什麼寶物！」

File: You try very hard to push the ugly troll, but you can't budge him.
檔案: 你使盡全力推那隻醜陋的矮精靈，卻絲毫推不動他。

File: Trolls have no sympathy.
檔案: 矮精靈可沒有同情心。

File: He isn't there!  Try the bridge.
檔案: 他不在那裡！去橋上找找看。

File: You throw the dagger and it falls into the flowing stream.
檔案: 你擲出短刀，短刀落入流動的溪水中。

File: Good news: no troll.
檔案: 好消息：沒有矮精靈。

File: What priceless treasure are you giving the old troll?
檔案: 你要把哪件無價的寶物送給那隻老矮精靈？

File: You don't have any.
檔案: 你身上沒有。

File: You would have to throw it from here!
檔案: 你得從這裡把它丟出去！

File: Grasping the precious treasure in a dirt-covered paw, the troll disappears under the bridge.
檔案: 矮精靈用沾滿泥土的爪子抓起珍貴的寶物，消失在橋下。

File: You have slipped down the muddy bank and lodged in the  river's bed.  Good knight.
檔案: 你從泥濘的河岸滑落，卡進了河床裡——晚安了，好騎士。

File: You have fallen in the raging current and are swept under.  I'm afraid your end has come.
檔案: 你跌進洶湧的水流，被捲入水底。恐怕你的大限已至。

File: It is an old stone bridge dating to ancient times.
檔案: 這是一座古老的石橋，年代久遠。

File: Very carefully, the bucket fills with water from the  rapid river.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地讓水桶裝滿湍急的河水。

File: Being careful not to slip in, you drink deeply of the cool water.
檔案: 你小心不讓自己滑落水中，大口暢飲清涼的河水。

File: You are too far from the water.
檔案: 你離水太遠了。

File: It tastes very refreshing to a thirsty wanderer.
檔案: 對一個口渴的旅人來說，這滋味十分沁涼解渴。

File: The crystal clear water fills up the bucket.
檔案: 清澈見底的水注滿了水桶。

File: When you look in the doorway, you see a poor, starving woodcutter and his wife.
檔案: 你朝門口望去，看見一位可憐挨餓的樵夫和他的妻子。

File: How are you going to use the ax when you can't even get it out of this stump?
檔案: 你連斧頭都拔不出樹樁，要怎麼用它？

File: The trees were cut from these stumps long ago.
檔案: 很久以前，這些樹木就是從這些樹樁上砍下的。

File: When you look in the window, you see a poor, starving woodcutter and his wife.
檔案: 你從窗戶望進去，看見一個貧窮挨餓的樵夫和他的妻子。

File: Watch out!!!  There is an ogre nearby!  He will crush you in his strong arms if he catches you.
檔案: 小心！！！附近有隻鬼怪！要是被他抓到，他會用強壯的雙臂把你壓碎。

File: With the magic shield, no harm will come to you.
檔案: 有了靈盾護身，你不會受到任何傷害。

File: Fortunately, you are invisible and the ogre can't see you.
檔案: 幸好你是隱形的，鬼怪看不見你。

File: The ogre's vision is not keen enough to see you.
檔案: 鬼怪的視力不夠敏銳，看不見你。

File: The ogre can see you now!
檔案: 鬼怪現在看得見你了！

File: The dagger is of little use against such a mean creature.  I would save it if I were you.
檔案: 短刀對付這種凶惡的生物沒什麼用。換作是我，會把它留著。

File: OK.  You drop the dagger.
檔案: 好，你放下了短刀。

File: That is a ferocious looking beast.  Please keep your distance!
檔案: 那是隻看起來凶猛駭人的野獸，請保持距離！

File: There is no ogre here.
檔案: 這裡沒有鬼怪。

File: Ogres are practically indestructible.
檔案: 鬼怪幾乎是打不死的。

File: At one time these were very pretty trees.
檔案: 這些樹木曾經十分漂亮。

File: Do you really want to try that?
檔案: 你真的想試試看嗎？

File: The delightful wild flowers brighten up your day.
檔案: 這些迷人的野花讓你心情愉快了起來。

File: Their perfume is joyful, sweet, and light.
檔案: 它們的香氣輕盈甜美，教人心曠神怡。

File: Ogres don't talk, they growl!
檔案: 鬼怪不會說話，只會咆哮！

File: You were warned to be careful around this fierce creature!  Maybe next time you will be able to elude the beast.
檔案: 你已經被警告要小心這隻凶猛的生物了！也許下次你就能躲過那頭野獸。

File: Lucky for you that ogres are afraid of goats. This one decides to leave you alone.
檔案: 算你走運，鬼怪害怕山羊。這隻鬼怪決定放你一馬。

File: You need to be a little closer to smell the flowers.
檔案: 你得再靠近一點，才能聞到花香。

File: This is sad.  You are not the first to fail your quest in the Raging River... I hope you may be the last.
檔案: 真令人難過。你不是第一個在怒河痛失冒險的人……但願你是最後一個。

File: This is the wild Raging River filled with boulders and rapids.
檔案: 這是狂野的怒河，河中滿是巨石與湍流。

File: It would be dangerous to try and jump across the river on the boulders.
檔案: 踩著巨石跳過這條河太危險了。

File: This mushroom is large and aromatic.
檔案: 這朵蘑菇又大又香。

File: You reach down and pick a fat mushroom.
檔案: 你彎下腰，摘了一朵肥美的蘑菇。

File: You see the familiar side of the Raging River.
檔案: 你看見怒河你熟悉的這一岸。

File: The colorful mushroom is in the distance.
檔案: 遠處有一朵色彩鮮豔的蘑菇。

File: You need to get closer to do that.
檔案: 你得靠近一點才能這麼做。

File: The river is so swift it is a battle to fill the bucket.
檔案: 河水湍急，想裝滿水桶得費一番力氣。

File: The water from this swift river is cold and sweet.
檔案: 這條湍急河流的水，冰涼又甘甜。

File: You see King Edward's castle on the horizon.
檔案: 你看見愛德華國王的城堡矗立在地平線上。

File: This lovely meadow is split by the Raging River.
檔案: 這片美麗的草原被怒河一分為二。

File: There is no mushroom here.
檔案: 這裡沒有蘑菇。

File: OUCH
檔案: 哎呦

File: I can see you need a little practice climbing rope!
檔案: 看來你爬繩索還需要多練習！

File: You should be more careful before trying that next time!
檔案: 下次嘗試之前，你應該要更小心一點！

File: Your arms are like lead... from swimming.  You find it impossible... to swim any longer.  You sink to the bottom... of the well....
檔案: 你的雙臂因游泳而變得沉重如鉛……你發現自己再也……游不動了。你沉入……井底……

File: The rope is out of reach.
檔案: 繩索搆不著。

File: You cannot climb the sides of the well.  They are too steep and slippery.
檔案: 你沒辦法爬上井壁，它們又陡又滑。

File: When you look upwards, you see the top of the well far, far above.
檔案: 你抬頭望去，看見井口遠遠在你頭頂上方。

File: Although you can only see the bottom of the bucket, it looks like a very nice bucket.
檔案: 雖然你只能看見水桶的底部，但看起來是個相當不錯的水桶。

File: How are you going to get the bucket?
檔案: 你打算怎麼拿到那個水桶？

File: This is murky well water.
檔案: 這是井裡的混濁井水。

File: The water does not taste as good as you expected.
檔案: 這水的味道不如你預期的好。

File: In the midst of your activities, you fill the bucket with well water.
檔案: 忙碌之中，你把水桶裝滿了井水。

File: The knot is tied very tightly.
檔案: 這個結打得非常緊。

File: The rope is secured to the well with a very tight knot.
檔案: 繩索用一個很緊的結固定在井邊。

File: The thick rope resists your efforts.
檔案: 這條粗繩不為所動，你使不上力。

File: You have nothing to cut the rope with.
檔案: 你沒有辦法割斷繩索。

File: Just before slitting the rope, you realize that it is not a very wise move at this time.
檔案: 就在你要割斷繩索前，你意識到現在這麼做並不明智。

File: There is no reason to cut the rope.
檔案: 沒有理由割斷這條繩索。

File: You reach up out of the well water and cut the thick rope that holds the bucket.
檔案: 你從井水中伸出手，割斷了固定水桶的粗繩。

File: You have other things to think about right now.
檔案: 你現在該想的是別的事。

File: A person in your position is in no position to raise or lower anything.
檔案: 以你目前的處境，實在沒辦法拉起或放下任何東西。

File: I don't think that getting in the bucket right now will do you very much good.
檔案: 我認為現在爬進水桶裡，對你不會有什麼好處。

File: You need to be closer to the water to drink.
檔案: 你得再靠近水邊一點。

File: There is no way for you to get water now.
檔案: 你現在沒辦法取水。

File: Now is not the time to try diving.
檔案: 現在不是嘗試潛水的時候。

File: It is a very long, sturdy rope.
檔案: 這是一條又長又堅固的繩索。

File: It is empty except for a huge boulder opposite the opening.
檔案: 這裡是空的，只有洞口對面一塊巨大的岩石。

File: It is a rather large, vacant cave.
檔案: 這是一個相當寬敞的空洞穴。

File: There is a large granite boulder and a magic mirror!! in the cave.
檔案: 洞穴裡有一塊巨大的花崗岩，還有一面魔鏡！！

File: A green, scaly dragon breathing hot fire and smoke is protecting the mirror.
檔案: 一條渾身綠鱗、噴著熾熱火焰與濃煙的巨龍，正在守護著這面魔鏡。

File: In this large cavern, there is a slimy dead dragon, an opening on one side, and a large boulder in the other.
檔案: 在這個寬闊的洞穴裡，有一條渾身黏液的巨龍已經死去，一側有個洞口，另一側則有一塊大岩石。

File: There is no dragon here.
檔案: 這裡沒有巨龍。

File: This ferocious, fire-breathing dragon with sharp, green scales and a long tail is protecting the magic mirror. Watch out for the flames!
檔案: 這條凶猛的噴火巨龍渾身是鋒利的綠鱗，還有條長尾巴，正守護著魔鏡。小心牠的火焰！

File: You see the once powerful dragon lying lifeless before you.
檔案: 你看見那條曾經威猛的巨龍，如今毫無生氣地倒在你面前。

File: A strange watery light issues from the hole.
檔案: 一道奇異、如水波般的光芒從洞裡透出來。

File: This dragon had only one life and you have taken it.
檔案: 這條巨龍只有一條命，而你已經取走了它。

File: With that dragon here?  No way!
檔案: 那條巨龍還在這裡？想都別想！

File: This dragon does not respond to reason.
檔案: 跟這條巨龍講道理是沒有用的。

File: You throw your bucket on the cavern floor.
檔案: 你把水桶扔在洞穴地面上。

File: The dragon is protecting the magic mirror.
檔案: 這條巨龍正在守護那面魔鏡。

File: The magic mirror is framed with ornate mahogany wood, polished to a high sheen.
檔案: 魔鏡的邊框以華麗的桃花心木打造，拋光得閃閃發亮。

File: There is no mirror here.
檔案: 這裡沒有鏡子。

File: Carefully, you pick up the magic mirror.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地拾起魔鏡。

File: I do not think that you can get close enough to the magic mirror with the dragon here.
檔案: 巨龍還在這裡，我想你沒辦法靠近魔鏡。

File: You could get a much better view if you were closer.
檔案: 你要是再靠近一點，視野會清楚許多。

File: You are not close enough to reach it.
檔案: 你離得不夠近，搆不到它。

File: You don't have any water.
檔案: 你身上沒有水。

File: You have nothing with which to douse a dragon.
檔案: 你沒有東西可以拿來澆熄巨龍的火焰。

File: You can't do that from here.!
檔案: 你在這裡沒辦法這麼做！

File: The dagger sings through the air, but falls short of the dragon.  You should have been closer.
檔案: 短刀劃破空氣飛出，卻沒能擊中巨龍。你應該再靠近一點才對。

File: You throw your water, but to no avail.  It lands on the floor and is quickly absorbed.
檔案: 你把水潑了出去，卻毫無作用。水落在地上，很快就被吸乾了。

File: The water hits the dragon squarely in the mouth, extinguishing its roaring flames.  No fire!  How mortified and embarrassed the dragon is!  Moving a huge boulder in leaving, the dragon creeps off to sulk.
檔案: 水正中巨龍的嘴巴，澆熄了牠猛烈的火焰。沒了火焰！巨龍又羞又惱！牠搬開一塊巨石，悻悻然地爬走生悶氣去了。

File: Nervously, you throw the dagger at the dragon and strike it in the heart.  Death for the dragon is instant.
檔案: 你緊張地把短刀擲向巨龍，正中牠的心臟。巨龍當場斃命。

File: How do you wish to accomplish that?
檔案: 你打算怎麼做到這件事？

File: You are too busy looking around to even think about that.
檔案: 你正忙著四處張望，根本沒空想那件事。

File: You should know about these fire-breathing dragons!  Maybe next time you will be a little more careful!
檔案: 你早該知道這些噴火巨龍的厲害！也許下次你會小心一點！

File: Your shield melted from the intensity of the dragon's flames!  You should know about these fire-breathing dragons!  Maybe next time you will be a little more careful!
檔案: 你的盾牌被巨龍熾烈的火焰給熔化了！你早該知道這些噴火巨龍的厲害！也許下次你會小心一點！

File: I think you found the dragon!
檔案: 看來你找到那條巨龍了！

File: Not even you can hold your breath forever.  The well bottom has become your eternal resting place.
檔案: 再怎麼厲害的人也沒辦法永遠憋氣。井底如今成了你長眠之地。

File: It looks like this bottle has been here for a very long time.
檔案: 這只瓶子看起來已經放在這裡很長一段時間了。

File: This is just an old, junky bottle.  You don't want it.
檔案: 這只是個又舊又破爛的瓶子，你用不著。

File: It is very difficult to tell where the hole might lead.
檔案: 很難看出這個洞通往哪裡。

File: The rusty old can has been here awhile.
檔案: 這個生鏽的舊罐子已經放在這裡好一陣子了。

File: You have no use for this old can.
檔案: 這個舊罐子對你沒什麼用處。

File: Thrashing around in the water has caused you to lose the magic ring and become visible again.
檔案: 你在水中拚命掙扎，害你弄丟了魔戒，也讓你再次現形。

File: Even as you are reaching for your medevial flamethrower, the King's agents descend upon you.  You are taken away to be torched at dawn.
檔案: 就在你伸手去拿中古世紀的噴火器時，國王的侍衛突然撲向你。你被帶走，將於黎明時被處以火刑。

File: King Edward the Benevolent is a very wise, but elderly monarch.  His frail body is almost lost in the large throne.
檔案: 仁慈的愛德華國王睿智卻也年邁。他孱弱的身軀幾乎要淹沒在那張碩大的王座裡。

File: The King's throne is made of solid gold, accented with rubies.  It will be yours if you complete your quest.
檔案: 國王的王座以純金打造，鑲著紅寶石。只要你完成任務，它終將屬於你。

File: When you bow to King Edward, his pleased smile warms you.
檔案: 你向愛德華國王鞠躬，他滿意的笑容讓你心頭一暖。

File: The King, though very ill, seems happy to see you.
檔案: 國王雖然病得很重，看見你似乎仍感到高興。

File: It is proper to stand directly in front of, and a few paces back from King Edward when addressing His Eminence.
檔案: 與愛德華國王陛下說話時，理應站在他正前方，並保持幾步的距離。

File: You bow, but you are the only one who knows it.
檔案: 你鞠了躬，但只有你自己知道這件事。

File: Go, Sir Graham!  Go and bring me back these treasures!
檔案: 去吧，格拉漢爵士！去把這些寶物給我帶回來！

File: Welcome back from your quest, Sir Graham.
檔案: 歡迎歸來，格拉漢爵士。

File: Why, Sir Graham, have you failed me and returned without accomplishing your task?  Go, and complete your quest!!
檔案: 怎麼回事，格拉漢爵士？你辜負了我，任務未成就回來了？去吧，完成你的使命！！

File: Before exposing your flamethrower, you decide the King is just beyond the range of your obsolete flamethrower.
檔案: 在亮出噴火器之前，你判斷國王正好在這具老舊噴火器的射程之外。

File: You are not close enough to see him clearly.
檔案: 你離得不夠近，看不清楚他。

File: King Edward the Benevolent is sitting on the throne, waiting for you.
檔案: 仁慈的愛德華國王坐在王座上，等著你。

File: It would show more respect if you were closer and in front of King Edward.
檔案: 若你能靠近一點、站在愛德華國王面前，會顯得更有禮貌。

File: He bids you to approach so he can hear you.
檔案: 他示意你靠近一點，好讓他聽得見你說話。

File: The King is walking towards you to commend you.
檔案: 國王正朝你走來，準備嘉獎你。

File: Your heart also aches with pain as you watch the King.
檔案: 看著國王的模樣，你的心也跟著揪痛起來。

File: The King is lying motionless on the ground.
檔案: 國王一動也不動地躺在地上。

File: You are the only King here!
檔案: 這裡只有你才是國王！

File: That's not a bad idea, but the custom in Daventry is to bow.
檔案: 這主意倒也不差，不過戴凡確王國的習俗是鞠躬行禮。

File: To kill King Edward would mean immediate execution!
檔案: 殺害愛德華國王等同於立即處決自己！

File: The throne is already occupied.
檔案: 王座上已經有人了。

File: You will have to do that yourself.
檔案: 這件事你得自己來。

File: This huge, tapestried room echoes every sound.
檔案: 這間掛滿織錦的大廳，任何聲響都會迴盪不已。

File: You move aside as the King steps from his throne.
檔案: 國王起身離開王座時，你讓到一旁。

File: As you approach the throne, the King himself rises to commend  you for a job well done.
檔案: 你走近王座時，國王親自起身，嘉勉你這趟任務完成得漂亮。

File: Oh!... Oh!!  the King proclaims in pain!
檔案: 「喔！……喔喔！！」國王痛苦地喊道！

File: From the seemingly lifeless King you hear these words:   "Well done, Sir Graham.  You have been a good and faithful servant.  Your reward is well deserved.  My kingdom is now yours."
檔案: 你從看似已無生氣的國王口中，聽見這些話：「做得好，格拉漢爵士。你一直是個忠誠盡責的臣子，這份獎賞你當之無愧。我的王國，如今就是你的了。」

File: With those words, King Edward the Benevolent dies.
檔案: 說完這番話，仁慈的愛德華國王便與世長辭。

File: The experiences of your quest will be invaluable to you as you begin your reign as King of Daventry!!
檔案: 這趟冒險的經歷，將在你開始統治戴凡確王國、成為新王之際，成為你無價的養分！！

File: As you are leaving, your agents remind you that you must remain here now, where it is safe.
檔案: 你正要離開時，侍衛提醒你，如今你必須留在這裡，這才是安全之處。

File: When you speak to King Edward,
檔案: 當你和愛德華國王說話時，

File: he sighs and says,
檔案: 他嘆了口氣，說道：

File:
Sir Graham, I am an old man. I fear	「格拉漢爵士，我已經年邁，恐怕
 my end is near.  I have chosen you to	 大限將近。我選中了你，要你
 prove yourself worthy of the throne.	 證明自己配得上這個王座。
As you know, our kingdom is weak and	你也知道，我們的王國積弱
 poor.  I have knowledge of the	 貧困。我得知
 existence of three things that would	 有三件寶物的存在，
 make our kingdom wealthy and strong.	 能讓我們的王國富強起來。
Somewhere within our kingdom, there is	我們王國境內的某處，藏著
 a magic mirror that tells the future.	 一面能預知未來的魔鏡。
 There is a magic shield that will	 還有一面能夠
 protect the bearer from mortal harm.	 保護持有者免於致命傷害的靈盾。
 Finally, there is a magic chest that	 最後，還有一個
 is always filled with gold coins.	 永遠裝滿金幣的金盒子。
Go, Sir Graham!  Go and bring me	去吧，格拉漢爵士！去把

If you succeed, you will inherit the	若你成功，你將繼承
 throne.
檔案: 王座。

File: Press any key to continue.
檔案: 請按任意鍵繼續。

File: There is no need to bow again.
檔案: 不需要再鞠躬了。

File: Your concern for the old king won't allow you to move.
檔案: 你對這位老國王的擔憂讓你動彈不得。

File: Thank you for playing             King's Quest                     from               Ken and Roberta Williams     Sol Ackerman   Chris Iden           Jeff Stephenson                 Mark Crowe            Bob Ballew   Mikel Knight     Susan Lee    Russ Truelove         Larry Weissenborn
檔案: Thank you for playing             King's Quest                     from               Ken and Roberta Williams     Sol Ackerman   Chris Iden           Jeff Stephenson                 Mark Crowe            Bob Ballew   Mikel Knight     Susan Lee    Russ Truelove         Larry Weissenborn

File: The king cannot talk right now.
檔案: 國王現在無法交談。

File: That is no way to try and address King Edward.
檔案: 你不能用這種方式對愛德華國王說話。

File: The spell to make you invisible has expired and you are once again visible.
檔案: 隱身魔法已經失效，你再次現形了。

File: That man is the King.
檔案: 那個人就是國王。

File: The light from the oil lamp is rather dim in the dark interior of the castle.
檔案: 油燈的光線在城堡幽暗的內部顯得相當微弱。

File: The long marble hall has a cold, dreary feeling.
檔案: 這條長長的大理石走廊給人一種冰冷、陰鬱的感覺。

File: There is nobody in the armor.
檔案: 盔甲裡沒有人。

File: This is the armor of one of King Edward's knights from years ago.
檔案: 這是愛德華國王麾下一名騎士多年前留下的盔甲。

File: The armor is firmly mounted to the wall.
檔案: 這副盔甲牢牢固定在牆上。

File: You should know you can't walk on clouds.
檔案: 你應該知道，人是無法走在雲上的。

File: These flowers look different than any you have ever seen before.
檔案: 這些花朵看起來和你以前見過的都不一樣。

File: You'll have to keep yourself out of the clouds!
檔案: 你得讓自己遠離雲朵才行！

File: These are very unusual looking trees.
檔案: 這些樹看起來非常不尋常。

File: You are fortunate that you have the magic shield or this giant would cause problems for you.
檔案: 幸虧你有靈盾在身，否則這個巨人會給你帶來大麻煩。

File: The magic chest appears to have been fashioned from ebony and rimmed on the edges with gold.
檔案: 這只金盒子似乎是用烏木打造，邊緣鑲著金邊。

File: There is no chest around here to get.
檔案: 這附近沒有盒子可以拿。

File: Very carefully, you slip the magic chest from the sleeping giant's arms.
檔案: 你小心翼翼地，從熟睡巨人的懷裡抽出了金盒子。

File: There is no way you can get the chest from here!
檔案: 你沒辦法從這裡拿到那個盒子！

File: You put the pebble in the sling, take careful aim, and luckily hit the giant in the forehead!  He falls down dead.
檔案: 你把鵝卵石放進投石器，仔細瞄準，幸運地擊中了巨人的額頭！他應聲倒地身亡。

File: It would be rather cowardly of you to kill a giant while he is asleep!
檔案: 趁巨人熟睡時殺他，未免太卑鄙了！

File: You have no sling!
檔案: 你身上沒有投石器！

File: I don't believe it!  How could you miss something so big?
檔案: 真不敢相信！這麼大的目標你怎麼會射不中？

File: You have no dagger!
檔案: 你身上沒有短刀！

File: There is no reason to kill the giant.
檔案: 沒有理由殺這個巨人。

File: The giant has been slain by a little pebble to the forehead.
檔案: 巨人被一顆小小的鵝卵石擊中額頭，就此喪命。

File: Be a little more careful next time.  This giant is mean!
檔案: 下次小心一點。這個巨人很兇惡！

File: You know you can't walk on clouds.
檔案: 你知道人是無法走在雲上的。

File: What luck!  The huge giant fell fast asleep!
檔案: 運氣真好！巨大的巨人沉沉睡去了！

File: The giant is sleeping with a chest.
檔案: 巨人抱著一只盒子睡著了。

File: The giant lies dead on the ground and there is a chest beside him.
檔案: 巨人倒臥在地上死了，身旁還有一只盒子。

File: The giant is to close for the slingshot to be effective.  I would suggest you RUN!
檔案: 巨人離你太近了，投石器派不上用場。我建議你快跑！

File: The dark cave burrows its way into a steep mountain.
檔案: 這個黑暗的洞穴深入陡峭的山中。

File: The mountain is too steep to climb.
檔案: 這座山太陡峭，無法攀爬。

File: You are near the top of a very high mountain.  It steeply descends toward a valley floor.
檔案: 你正身處一座高山的頂端附近，山勢陡峭地向下延伸至山谷。

File: You are in the Land of the Clouds.  It is rumored that a giant lives here.
檔案: 你身處雲之國，傳說有個巨人住在這上面。

File: Oops, you've missed the edge and fallen through the  clouds.
檔案: 哎呀，你沒踩穩邊緣，摔穿雲層掉了下去。

File: These are the most unusual looking trees.
檔案: 這些樹看起來奇特無比。

File: These are unusual looking flowers.
檔案: 這些花朵看起來很不尋常。

File: You should know that it is not possible to walk on clouds!
檔案: 你應該知道，人是不可能走在雲上的！

File: This is very strange vegetation.
檔案: 這是非常奇特的植物。

File: Oops!  You've missed the edge and fallen through the clouds.
檔案: 哎呀！你沒踩穩邊緣，摔穿雲層掉了下去。

File: Its trunk has a large hole in the base.
檔案: 樹幹底部有一個大洞。

File: You notice a sling in the hole in the tree.
檔案: 你注意到樹洞裡有一把投石器。

File: It is empty.
檔案: 裡面是空的。

File: This sling is made of very stretchy leather.
檔案: 這把投石器是用非常有彈性的皮革做的。

File: You reach into the hole and pull out the leather sling.
檔案: 你把手伸進洞裡，拉出那把皮革投石器。

File: You can't see into the hole from here.
檔案: 你從這裡看不進那個洞裡。

File: Why?  What sling?
檔案: 為什麼？什麼投石器？

File: You've fallen through the clouds!  Cloud walking is for the birds.
檔案: 你摔穿雲層掉了下去！走在雲上這種事，還是留給鳥兒吧。

File: These are strange looking trees.
檔案: 這些樹看起來很奇怪。

File: You need to be closer to try.
檔案: 你得靠近一點才能嘗試。

File: There is a rather large bird's nest here.
檔案: 這裡有一個相當大的鳥巢。

File: There is a pure golden egg lying in the nest!
檔案: 鳥巢裡躺著一顆純金打造的蛋！

File: The nest is empty.
檔案: 鳥巢是空的。

File: The golden egg is smooth and shiny.
檔案: 這顆金蛋光滑又閃亮。

File: You already have the golden egg from the nest.
檔案: 你已經拿到鳥巢裡的金蛋了。

File: There is no egg here to get.
檔案: 這裡沒有蛋可以拿。

File: The golden egg is so heavy you almost drop it.
檔案: 這顆金蛋重得你差點沒拿穩。

File: You can't get the egg from here!
檔案: 你沒辦法從這裡拿到那顆蛋！

File: Apparently you lost your grip while climbing this tree and you fall to the hard earth below.
檔案: 看來你爬這棵樹時沒抓穩，摔到了下方堅硬的地面上。

File: So you're walking on clouds, huh?  Unfortunately, that's an impossible task that cost you your life!
檔案: 所以你想走在雲上，是吧？可惜，這是件不可能的任務，也讓你賠上了性命！

File: As the wicked witch flew over her house, she dropped you... into her cage!  If you can't get out, you may become the secret ingredient in this witches' brew!
檔案: 邪惡的巫婆飛過她的房子上空時，把你丟了下去……正好落進她的籠子裡！要是逃不出去，你可能會變成這鍋巫婆濃湯裡的神秘配料！

File: Surprise!  Surprise!  The wicked witch is home and now she's after you!
檔案: 沒想到吧！沒想到吧！邪惡的巫婆在家，現在她盯上你了！

File: This is not a good place to give up your protection!
檔案: 這裡可不是放棄你護身之物的好地方！

File: The witch mutters, "I am going to get my oven ready to cook someone for dinner (yum)."
檔案: 巫婆喃喃道：「我要去把烤爐準備好，煮個人來當晚餐（嗯，真香）。」

File: The witch mumbles, "After I get the oven nice and hot, I will be ready to have someone for dinner (giggle)."
檔案: 巫婆嘀咕著：「等我把烤爐燒得夠熱，就能請人來吃晚餐了（咯咯）。」

File: The witch mutters, "The oven is heating up nicely.  I wonder who will be my dinner guest!"
檔案: 巫婆喃喃道：「烤爐燒得正好，不知道誰會是我的晚餐貴客呢！」

File: The witch says, "My oven is now the perfect temperature. It is time to invite someone for dinner (cackle, cackle)!"
檔案: 巫婆說：「我的烤爐現在溫度剛剛好，是時候邀請誰來吃晚餐了（咯咯笑）！」

File: Rats!  She has cast some spell to keep you from escaping!. The witch remarks, "Oh, how nice of you to come for dinner (cackle, cackle)"
檔案: 糟了！她施了某種魔法讓你逃不掉！巫婆說道：「喔，你能來吃晚餐真是太好了（咯咯笑）」

File: She pokes and pinches you, then states, "This one is too scrawny, so it's into the cage until you fatten up (smack, yum)!"
檔案: 她戳了戳你、又捏了捏你，接著說：「這個太瘦了，先關進籠子養胖再說吧（咂嘴，真香）！」

File: With a flash, you hear her joyously exclaim, "This has made me feel like flying!"
檔案: 一陣閃光中，你聽見她欣喜地喊道：「這讓我感覺自己要飛起來了！」

File: Courageously, you manage to push the witch into the oven where she flashes and melts away into a harmless blob. Congratulations!
檔案: 你鼓起勇氣，把巫婆推進了烤爐，她閃了一下，融化成一團無害的軟泥。恭喜你！

File: Try as you will to escape, your labor will be in vain.
檔案: 任憑你怎麼掙扎逃脫，都是白費力氣。

File: It is fastened with a very strong lock.  There is no way for you to open it.
檔案: 它被一個非常堅固的鎖鎖著，你沒辦法打開它。

File: This ugly old witch is one of the most hideous sights you have ever seen.  I would never trust her.
檔案: 這個醜陋的老巫婆，是你見過最駭人的景象之一。我絕不會相信她。

File: There is no witch here.
檔案: 這裡沒有巫婆。

File: You pluck the Swiss cheese from the shelf.
檔案: 你從架上取下瑞士乳酪。

File: I don't see any here.
檔案: 這裡沒看到。

File: You cannot see it from here.
檔案: 你從這裡看不到它。

File: This cage will be your new home for the rest of your life.
檔案: 這個籠子將成為你餘生的新家。

File: You look for a way to escape, but there is none.
檔案: 你四處尋找逃脫的辦法，卻找不到任何出路。

File: It is an old wood stove, and very hot.  The fire must have been burning for some time.
檔案: 這是一個老舊的柴爐，非常燙。爐火想必已經燒了一段時間。

File: It is made from rusty, but strong, iron bars.
檔案: 它是用生鏽但堅固的鐵條做的。

File: You may have seen one in the other room, but I am not sure.
檔案: 你或許在另一個房間見過一個，但我不太確定。

File: The oven is very, very hot.  Someone must have just put some wood in it.
檔案: 烤爐非常非常燙，一定有人剛加了柴進去。

File: You open the door and see a roaring fire burning in the oven.
檔案: 你打開爐門，看見烤爐裡烈火熊熊。

File: You are in no position to do that!
檔案: 你現在沒辦法做這件事！

File: You are not close enough to touch it.
檔案: 你離它不夠近，碰不到。

File: From here it would be rather difficult to open the oven.
檔案: 從這裡要打開烤爐相當困難。

File: There is a note lying on top of it.
檔案: 上面放著一張紙條。

File: That is the table where she eats her (gulp) food.
檔案: 那是她（吞口水）吃飯的桌子。

File: The bed is not here.
檔案: 床不在這裡。

File: You see the forest outside.
檔案: 你看見外頭的森林。

File: There is little to see from here.
檔案: 從這裡看不到什麼。

File: The note was here at one time, but now you can`t seem to locate it.
檔案: 紙條原本在這裡，但現在你似乎找不到它了。

File: You cannot reach it from here.
檔案: 你從這裡搆不到它。

File: You don't have the note.
檔案: 你身上沒有那張紙條。

File: If I were you, I wouldn't try it!  This witch is mean!
檔案: 如果我是你，我才不會嘗試呢！這個巫婆很兇惡！

File: The little house is surprisingly neat considering a wicked witch lives here.
檔案: 考慮到這裡住著一個邪惡的巫婆，這間小屋出乎意料地整潔。

File: There is no witch here...RIGHT NOW!!
檔案: 這裡沒有巫婆……目前是沒有！！

File: The witch is dead.
檔案: 巫婆死了。

File: As soon as you entered the house the goat ran away.
檔案: 你一走進屋裡，山羊就跑掉了。

File: You need to be more specific.
檔案: 你需要說得更具體一點。

File: The old goat is afraid of the dark and decides to stay outside.
檔案: 老山羊害怕黑暗，決定留在外面。

File: The stairs go up into the heart of the mountain.
檔案: 階梯向上通往山的核心。

File: Oops!  Those stairs are pretty slippery, aren't they?
檔案: 哎呀！這些階梯挺滑的，是吧？

File: The stairs are moss-covered and slippery.
檔案: 階梯上長滿青苔，很滑。

File: Darn!  You slipped on the steep stairs.
檔案: 糟糕！你在陡峭的階梯上滑倒了。

File: The stairs seem to go on forever.
檔案: 這些階梯似乎沒有盡頭。

File: This is a shy little dwarf.  He is too quick to catch.
檔案: 這是個害羞的小矮人，他動作太快，抓不到。

File: Look out!  You are too close to the edge!  Oh, oh, you fell!
檔案: 小心！你離邊緣太近了！啊，糟了，你摔下去了！

File: The quick, little dwarf came by to see what you had-- nothing interested him.
檔案: 動作敏捷的小矮人跑來看你有什麼東西——但沒有一樣讓他感興趣。

File: There is nobody here but you.
檔案: 這裡除了你沒有別人。

File: The dwarf is not here for idle conversion.
檔案: 矮人不是來這裡閒聊的。

File: The stairs descend into the lower reaches of the mountain.
檔案: 階梯向下通往山的深處。

File: You can see sky, light, and smell clouds through the opening.
檔案: 你能透過開口看見天空、光線，還能聞到雲的氣味。

File: Oh dear!  With a slip of the foot, you fall head over heels down the long stairway.
檔案: 糟了！你腳下一滑，一路翻滾摔下這條長長的階梯。

File: If you were to jump or duck here you might fall.
檔案: 你要是在這裡跳躍或蹲下，可能會摔下去。

File: With a wrong move, you fall dizzyingly to the ground.
檔案: 一個錯誤的動作，你便天旋地轉地摔到地上。

File: The goat was quite hesitant about climbing that huge beanstalk!  You may have lost the goat.
檔案: 山羊對爬上那根巨大的豆莖相當猶豫！你可能已經把山羊弄丟了。

File: You can no longer see the bottom... it seems to go  on forever!
檔案: 你已經看不見底部了……看來這裡深不見底！

File: You have to be careful when you get so high on the foliage!
檔案: 爬到葉叢這麼高的地方，你得小心一點！

File: Whoops!  You fall toward a distant earth.
檔案: 哎呀！你朝著遙遠的地面墜落。

File: Your heart thuds.  Dare you climb into the clouds?
檔案: 你的心怦怦直跳。你敢爬進雲層裡嗎？

File: It is a long, long way down....
檔案: 那可是好長、好長的一段路……

File: It is amazing that you actually climbed up this high!
檔案: 你居然爬到這麼高的地方，真是令人驚訝！

File: It is hard to believe those seeds you planted grew this high.
檔案: 真難以置信，你種下的種子居然長得這麼高。

File: You are in the Land of the Clouds.  It is rumored a giant lives up here.
檔案: 你身處雲之國，傳說有個巨人住在這上面。

File: While falling through the hole, the magic ring fell off your finger.  Dangerous creatures can see you now!
檔案: 你掉落洞穴的途中，魔戒從你的手指上滑落了。危險的生物現在能看見你了！

File: The warm sunlight falls through the hole in the ceiling.  Unfortunately, you can't reach it.
檔案: 溫暖的陽光從天花板的洞口灑落下來，可惜你搆不著。

File: The dark tunnel leads off to the south.
檔案: 這條黑暗的隧道通往南方。

File: When you fell through the hole, you felt a streching sensation and are back to your normal size.
檔案: 你掉落洞穴時感到一陣拉伸的感覺，恢復成原本的大小了。

File: The further you get from the light, the darker and mustier it becomes.
檔案: 你離光源越遠，這裡就變得越昏暗、越潮濕發霉。

File: Being invisible won't hide you from this rat's keen sense of smell.
檔案: 就算隱形，也躲不過這隻大老鼠敏銳的嗅覺。

File: There is no rat here.
檔案: 這裡沒有大老鼠。

File: It is a big rat with dripping teeth and small, greedy eyes.
檔案: 這是一隻大老鼠，牙齒滴著口水，眼睛小而貪婪。

File: It is very dark and dreary.  The rat seems to like it here.
檔案: 這裡又暗又陰森，那隻大老鼠似乎很喜歡待在這裡。

File: It is very dark and dreary in here.
檔案: 這裡又暗又陰森。

File: This is no mouse, this is a big, ugly rat!
檔案: 這可不是老鼠，這是一隻又大又醜的大老鼠！

File: The door slowly opens.
檔案: 門緩緩打開了。

File: The door is closed.
檔案: 門已經關上了。

File: Be careful around this rat next time!  He's dangerous!!
檔案: 下次小心那隻大老鼠！牠很危險！！

File: The door appears to be stuck and won't close.
檔案: 這扇門似乎卡住了，關不上。

File: Get closer if you want to try.
檔案: 想試試看的話，先靠近一點。

File: You can't.  He moves too quickly.
檔案: 你辦不到，牠的動作太快了。

File: The rat rasps, "Treasure!  Treasure!  Give treasure, or no go door!  Give treasure NOW!"
檔案: 大老鼠沙啞地說：「寶物！寶物！交出寶物，不然別想過門！現在就交出寶物！」

File: You have no treasure to give the rat.
檔案: 你身上沒有寶物可以給那隻大老鼠。

File: The rat doesn't want an ordinary walnut.
檔案: 大老鼠不想要一顆普通的胡桃。

File: The rat doesn't want a tattered pouch.
檔案: 大老鼠不想要一個破爛的皮袋。

File: What kind of treasure would you like to give the  greedy rat?
檔案: 你想給這隻貪心的大老鼠什麼樣的寶物？

File: The huge rat takes the treasure you have offered and scuttles away.
檔案: 那隻巨大的老鼠接過你獻上的寶物，飛快地跑走了。

File: It appears you are afraid of the rat!  You must get closer to give anything to this rat!
檔案: 看來你很怕那隻大老鼠！你得靠近一點，才能把東西交給牠！

File: You do not have any.
檔案: 你身上沒有這東西。

File: The rat drools at the sight of the cheese... and snatches it from your hand.  You might want to count your fingers.
檔案: 大老鼠一看到乳酪就流口水……一把從你手中搶走。你也許該數數自己的手指還在不在。

File: The rat scrambles to the wall and seems to magically merge with it.
檔案: 大老鼠竄向牆壁，彷彿被魔法融進牆裡消失了。

File: That is a good idea, but you do not have any cheese.
檔案: 這主意不錯，可惜你身上沒有乳酪。

File: You count your fingers and are relieved to see you still have all of them.
檔案: 你數了數自己的手指，鬆了口氣，發現十根都還在。

File: The leprechauns' magic powers detect your unseen presence.
檔案: 地穴人的魔法察覺到你隱形的存在。

File: The leprechauns do not like your invasion of their territory.  They may not let you get any further.
檔案: 地穴人不喜歡你入侵他們的地盤，他們可能不會讓你再往前一步。

File: The leprechauns revere the power of the fourleaf clover. With it in your possession they will leave you absolutely alone.
檔案: 地穴人敬畏幸運草的力量，只要你身上帶著它，他們就絕對不會來打擾你。

File: Leprechauns love fiddle music!  Have you ever seen such frenzied dancing?
檔案: 地穴人最愛小提琴的音樂！你看過這麼瘋狂的舞蹈嗎？

File: Totally involved in the music, they dance right out of the room.
檔案: 他們完全沉浸在音樂裡，一路跳著舞離開了房間。

File: The leprechaun catches you and holds you with his small,  but strong arms.  I don't think the leprechaun will ever let go.
檔案: 地穴人抓住了你，用他矮小卻強壯的雙臂緊緊抱住你。我想他大概永遠不會放手了。

File: You are in the antechamber of the Hall of the Leprechaun King.  There are leprechauns in the room with you.
檔案: 你身處地穴人國王大廳的前廳，房間裡還有其他地穴人。

File: I can think of no good reason to close the door.
檔案: 我實在想不出關門的理由。

File: I would not try talking to the leprechauns.  You might say the wrong thing.
檔案: 我勸你別跟地穴人搭話，你可能會說錯話。

File: You would not get all of them before they got you.
檔案: 你還沒抓到他們全部，他們就先抓住你了。

File: There are not any leprechauns here.
檔案: 這裡沒有地穴人。

File: You are already playing the fiddle.
檔案: 你已經在拉小提琴了。

File: You find playing the fiddle here very fun, but the dance floor is in the other room.
檔案: 在這裡拉小提琴挺有趣的，不過舞池在隔壁房間。

File: You play a little tune on the fiddle to amuse yourself.
檔案: 你拉了一小段曲子自娛自樂。

File: It is very difficult to play a fiddle if you do not have one.
檔案: 沒有小提琴，很難拉得出曲子。

File: The little green men do not seem to be noticing you; perhaps because of the fourleaf clover.
檔案: 這些綠色小人似乎沒注意到你，也許是幸運草的緣故。

File: There aren't any leprechauns here.
檔案: 這裡沒有地穴人。

File: The King of the leprechauns is sitting on the stone throne. The magic shield is next to the throne.
檔案: 地穴人國王坐在石造王座上，靈盾就放在王座旁邊。

File: The King of the leprechauns is sitting on the stone throne.
檔案: 地穴人國王坐在石造王座上。

File: The King is leaving.
檔案: 國王正要離開。

File: The King of the leprechauns is no longer here.
檔案: 地穴人國王已經不在這裡了。

File: The stairs go up a narrow tunnel.
檔案: 階梯通往一條狹窄的隧道。

File: To see the stairs, you have to get closer.
檔案: 你得靠近一點，才能看清楚那道階梯。

File: The leprechaun King ignores your words.

檔案: 那個地穴人在同伴的協助下抓住了你，說什麼也不肯放手。我看你要在這裡待上好長一段時間了。

File: The King's magic prevents you from getting close enough to harm him.

File: This is the throne room of the leprechaun King.  There is a shield next to the throne.

File: The stairs are very steep and narrow.

File: You dare not jump here or you would go through the floor!
檔案: 你可不敢在這裡跳，不然會直接摔穿地板！

File: The cottage is run-down and sparsely furnished.  The only nice possession seems to be a fiddle in the corner.
檔案: 這間小屋破舊不堪，家具寥寥無幾，唯一像樣的東西似乎是角落那把小提琴。

File: The cottage is run-down and sparsely furnished.

File: This family is so poor, they can't even repair the floor.
檔案: 這戶人家窮到連地板都修不起。

File: This is the woodcutter's fiddle.
檔案: 這是樵夫的小提琴。

File: The woodcutter is thin and dressed in rags.
檔案: 樵夫瘦骨嶙峋，衣衫襤褸。

File: The woodcutter's wife is skinny and poorly dressed.
檔案: 樵夫的妻子骨瘦如柴，衣著寒酸。

File: The woodcutter and his wife are sitting at the old oak table.
檔案: 樵夫和他的妻子坐在那張老橡木桌旁。

File: Welcome to my humble abode.
檔案: 「歡迎來到寒舍。」

File: She replies, "I'd like to offer you something, but we do not even have food for ourselves."
檔案: 她回答道：「我很想招待你，可是我們連自己的食物都不夠了。」

File: Make yourself at home in our humble home.
檔案: 「請把這寒舍當自己家吧。」

File: That would be very nice.  How do you want to help them?
檔案: 這真是個好主意，你想怎麼幫助他們呢？

File: What an abominable idea!  You should be ashamed of yourself for even suggesting such a thing!
檔案: 這主意真是可惡！你居然想得出這種點子，該感到羞愧！

File: It is closed, but in this house, all the cabinets are bare.
檔案: 櫃子關著，不過在這戶人家裡，所有的櫥櫃都是空的。

File: The cabinet is all but bare.
檔案: 這個櫥櫃幾乎是空的。

File: The beautiful scenery outside is in contrast to the dreariness inside.
檔案: 屋外的美麗景色，和屋內的淒涼景象形成強烈對比。

File: You should have more sympathy for these poor folks!
檔案: 你應該多同情一下這些可憐人！

File: You have given the bowl to these poor people and it is now theirs.  You have no right to take it back.
檔案: 你已經把碗送給這對可憐的夫妻了，它現在是他們的東西，你沒有權利拿回來。

File: The woodcutters admire the bowl as it sits on their table.
檔案: 樵夫夫妻欣賞著放在桌上的那只碗。

File: What treasure do you wish to donate to them?
檔案: 你想捐贈什麼寶物給他們？

File: The woodcutter and his wife very gratefully accept the treasure.  "This will help us for awhile," says the woodcutter.
檔案: 樵夫和他的妻子滿懷感激地收下了寶物。樵夫說：「這能幫我們撐一陣子了。」

File: This is a nice thought, but unfortunately you have nothing to give these poor people.
檔案: 這番心意很好，可惜你身上沒有東西能給這對可憐的夫妻。

File: The woodcutter and his wife kindly accept your gift of food.  They offer a heartfelt "Thank you."
檔案: 樵夫和他的妻子親切地收下了你贈送的食物，由衷地向你道謝。

File: Puzzled, the couple wonders why you have given them a bowl.
檔案: 這對夫妻一頭霧水，不明白你為什麼給他們一只碗。

File: The woodcutter family is very grateful that you have given them a bowl of stew.  Now they will have at least one last meal.  As a token of their gratitude, they offer their last earthly possession, the woodcutter's fiddle.
檔案: 樵夫一家對你送上的這碗燉肉萬分感激，這下他們至少能吃上最後一餐了。為了表達謝意，他們獻上了僅剩的財產——樵夫的那把小提琴。

File: Eat stew from an empty bowl?  The woodcutters are beginning to question your authenticity.
檔案: 從空碗裡吃燉肉？樵夫夫妻開始懷疑你是不是有問題。

File: The stew looks delicious, but it is no longer yours.  Now you will have to do without.
檔案: 這碗燉肉看起來很美味，可惜已經不是你的了，你現在只能餓著了。

File: The couple is amazed and delighted as the bowl miraculously fills with a bubbling stew.  As a token of their gratitude, they offer their last earthly possession, the woodcutter's fiddle.
檔案: 這對夫妻又驚又喜，眼看著碗裡奇蹟般地冒出滾燙的燉肉。為了表達謝意，他們獻上了僅剩的財產——樵夫的那把小提琴。

File: The couple does not understand.
檔案: 這對夫妻聽不懂。

File: The fiddle is a beautiful instrument made of polished wood.
檔案: 這把小提琴是用打磨光亮的木材製成的精美樂器。

File: You cannot take their last precious possession!
檔案: 你不能拿走他們僅剩的珍貴財產！

File: The polished wood feels like satin -- it seems to still vibrate from the last song it played.
檔案: 打磨過的木頭摸起來像緞子一樣光滑——彷彿還殘留著上一首曲子的餘韻在震動。

File: What a terrible suggestion!  These people are poor and starving and you want to steal one of their last earthly possessions.
檔案: 這主意真是糟透了！這些人又窮又餓，你居然想偷走他們僅剩的財產之一。

File: You cannot see it very well from here.
檔案: 從這裡看不太清楚。

File: I doubt that you will get away with it, but you will have to get closer to try.
檔案: 我不認為你能得逞，不過你得先靠近一點才能試試看。

File: These poor people can't even afford to repair the floor!  Sorry about that.
檔案: 這對可憐的夫妻連地板都修不起！抱歉了。

檔案: 你一走進屋子，那隻老山羊就跑掉了。
